'gro ba'i don mdzad pa mdo las gsungs te/ 'di nas de bzhin 96)nyid der gshegs// gdal khyab chen po'i zig na bzhugs// sems kyi dkyil 'khor 'od gsal nas// de bzhin nyid du rnam par snang*// byis pa'i ched du cho 'phrul dag /me tog bkod pa'i 'jig rten na// ma grags pa zhes bya bar snang*// zhes pa dang*/ gsang snying las/ sangs rgyas mya ngan yongs mi 'da'// chos kyang nub par mi 'gyur te// mi rtag smin mdzad 'dul ba'i phyir// byung nas mya ngan 'da' bar ston/ zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa rag bzhin shugs kyi thugs rje skye ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje nyi ma'i snying po ltar/ 'bad rtsol med par rang bzhin gyis sems can la don 'byung ba yin te/ nges don 'dus pa las/ ye shes gsang ba'i ngang nyid nas// thugs rje nam mkha'i mtha' ltar gdal// thugs rje chen po nyid 'od ltar// 'gro 'ong med par rang bzhin 'char/ zhes pa dang*/ mdo las/ ci bzhin nyid la bzhugs pas 97)na// 'di zhes tshig tu ma gsungs kyang*// khyab pa gcig pa'i byin brlabs kyis// ci ltar 'dod pa so sor gsal/ zhes pas/ dper na/ nam mkha' la nyi ma shar bas sa la dro ba 'byung zhing*/ chu'i snod tha dad pa'i nang du gzugs brnyan 'char ba ltar/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa chos nyid kyi ngang las ma g.yos par/ zhing khams gzhal du med pa rnams su rnam par 'phrul pa dpag tu med pa 'dzin rten du 'byung ba rnams dang*/ de bzhin du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ zhing khams gzhal du med rnams su rnam par 'phrul pa dpag tu med pa 'jig rtain du 'byung ba rnams dang*/ de bzhin du chos kyis 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul ston pa la sogs pa'i mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab par/ sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis rtsol med du shugs kyis 'byung ba yin te/ sdud pa las/ ci ltar bhe dur sngon po'i rang bzhin la// lha dbang lus kyi gzugs brnyan shar ba bzhin// de bzhin gdul bya'i chu snod dag pa la// thub pa'i dbang po'i sku yi gzugs brnyan 'char/

zhes 98)gsungs so// gsum pa yul dang 'phrad nas thugs rje skye ba ni/ spyir sku lngas 'khor lnga la don mdzad pa dang*/ bye brag tu sku gsum gyi thugs rje don mdzad pa'o// dang po ni/ ye shes rgya mtsho'i 'khor rnams la/ ston pa chos kyi sku'i rig pa'i byin rlabs sam/ skye mche don gyi gsung gi don mdzad do// rgyud ye shes gsang ba las/ chos kun nam mkha'i mtha' kun mnyam// chos nyid 'byung ba spros med pas// ye shes sku la spros med gsal// des na byin gyi rlabs kyis bshad// ces gsungs so// sa la gnas pa'i byang sems la sogs pa'am/ smin pa rgya mtsho'i 'khor rnams la/ ston pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur snang nas/ sku mdun dang rgyab med par zhal pho 'gyur kun tu thal le bas/ dgongs pa brda'i sgo nas don mdzad de/ snying po las/ 'og min bla mad gnas mchog tu// sku ni rnam par snang mdzad tshul// byang chub sems dpa'i 99)'khor rnams la// de bzhin gsung mchog mi smra ste// sku'i chos rnams mjal bar ston// me long bstan pa'i tshul bzhin du// dngos kyi mdog ngag thams cad sel/ zhes pa dang*/ mdo las/ stug po bkod pa'i rgyal ba yang*// chos sku snying por gyur pas na// de'i 'gro ba mi smin phyir// gzugs skur bstan nas tshig ces pas// gdul bya smin cing dag pa rnams la/ gong ltar longs skur snang zhing*/ ma dag pa rnams la sprul skur snang nas don mdzad do// spyir 'jig rten gyi khams bsam gyi mi khyab par snang bar gsungs te/ snying po las// longs spyod zad med rin chen gter// sprul pa bye ba bsam mi khyab// mtshan dang dpe byad thams cad rdzogs// ces pa dang*/ bye rag tu/ sbyor lam pa dang*/ mthong lam pa la/ sprul sku mtshan dang dpe byed dang ldan pas dngos su gsung gis don mdzad de/ sdud pa las/ 100) sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan dang mthu stobs pha mtha' yas/

sems can rnams la chos rab ston cing sgrod par byed/ ces gsungs so// ma dag pa rnams la 'gro ba rang rang gi snang tshul dang mthun par gang la gang 'dul du don mdzad de/ mdo las/ skye ba thams cad gzugs su snang ba ni/ bya rog dang me khyer la sogs pa'i srog chags gang yin pa de dang*/ de'i gzugs su snang bar mdzad cing*/ de dag gi cha bye rnams kyis/ gang ci ltar mos pa rnams la de bzhin du snang ste/ ces gsungs so// de yang phyogs re tsam mchon na/ sngon tu tra la thugs rje bskyed de btul ba lta bu'am/ rkang chags lag rdum la sogs pa la thugs rje skye ba lta bu'o// gsum pa bskul zhing gsol ba btab pa la brten nas thugs rje skye ba ni/ spyir bskul zhing gsol ba btab pa dang*/ bye brag tu bskul zhing gsol ba btab pa la brten nas skye ba'o// dang po la gnyis te/ 'og min du bskul zhing gsol ba btab pa dang 101)mi yul du bstan pa 'byung bar bskul zhing gsol ba btab pa'o// snga ma ni/ bde chen gdal khyab chen po'i zhing khams/ 'og min chis kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du/ sku lnga lhun grub kyis sangs rgyas la sogs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dgongs pa ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs shing*/ chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas par mkhyen nas/ dgongs pa mnyam nyid du bzhugs pa la/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis yum pha rol du phyin ma la sogs pa'i 'khor rnams kyis dbyings las bskul ba'i sgra byung bas/ chos kyi sku las gzugs kyi skur bzhengs so// bskul ba'i sgra ni/ mdo las/ yod med stong pa shin du rnam 'byor mthus// nam mkha' bzhengs nas dam tshig nye bar bshed// ye shes rgya mtsho'i rnam par grol ba'i klong*// mi gnas mi dmigs nam mkha'i dbyings nas bzhengs// ces pa sogs kyi sgra byung nas/ chos kyi sku la 102)gzugs kyis skur bzhengs nas bzhugs pa la/ dngos 'khor rnams kyis/

mgrin gcig tu gsol ba btab pa ste// rgyud 'di go brtogs kyis skal dang ldan pa rnams la bshad du gsol// 'di nyid go brtogs kyis skal ba dang mi ldan pa rnams la/ lam stegs kyis theg pa bshad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab ste/ mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis thugs chen po// ye shes snying po don gyis don mchog ldan// rnal 'byor theg chen rdo rje theg chen lung*// 'dus pa'i tshogs la rgya cher bshad du gsol/ zhes pa dang*/ ye shes bting rdzogs las// de tshe rdo rje sems dpas gang zhus pa// sangs rgyas kun gyis dgongs pa nges pa'i don// mnor ma bcos rang byung chos sku ste/ sems can blo yis nges par rtogs pa'i thabs// kun rig ston pa thugs rje bshad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ 'og min la 103)sogs par ston pa chos kyi sku las gzugs kyi skur bzhengs nas/ 'khor thun mong ma yin pa rnams la/ gsang sngags 'bras bu'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te gsungs tshul dang*/ mi 'ched 'jig rten gyis khams la sogs pa'i zhing khams dpag tu med par/ sprul sku thub pa drug la sogs pa dpag tu med pas/ 'khor thun mong pa rnams la/ bstan pa sde snod gsum la sogs pa'i gang mtshams pa rnams gsungs so// gnyis pa mi yul du/ bstan pa 'byung bar gsol ba btab pa ni/ rgyu'i chos 'byung bar gsol ba btab pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i chos 'byung bar gsol ba btab pa'o// snga ma ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dga' ldan nas byon pa dang*/ bdud btul ba dang*// sangs rgyas japa'i tshul bstan te/ grong khyer du chos 'byung bar dgongs nas gsungs pas/ shākya'i rigs rnams kyis/ rigs 104)mnyam pa la chos nyan pa dang*/ dpon du byed pa mi 'ong zhes nyan du ma 'dod do// des gzhan rnams nyan cing go bar ma byung ste/ rgya cher rol pa las/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos shig bdag gis rnyed// su la bstan kyang go bar mi 'dug pas// mi smra nags 'dab nyid du gnas par bya'o// ces gsungs shing*/

sgrol rgyu'i tshul du chos ma gsungs pa bzhugs pa'i tshe/ tshong dpon ga go la dang bzang skyong gnyis kyis glang po ches lam du 'gro bar ma 'dod par/ rtsa'i skyil po gcig la kha gtad nas 'dug pa la ltas pas/ bcom ldan 'das bzhugs par mthong nas/ tshong dpon gyis yon bdag byas nas chos ston drangs/ der thams cad kyis chos zhus pas ma gnang pa la/ tshangs pa 'khor dang bcas pas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa phul nas/ ye shes 105)chen po mchog gis dkyil 'khor bsgrub nas ni/ smra ba'i nyi ma ci slad deng 'dir btang snyoms bzhugs// dam pa chos kyi rnga bo che ni rdung du gsol// chos kyis mchod sdong chen po dus 'dir sbreng du gsol/ zhes pa la sogs pa'i gsol ba btab pas/ sngon la mdo shis pa brjod par gsungs so// de nas wa ra ṇa se las sogs par bka' dang po bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba dang*/ bya rgod phung po'i ri la mtshan nyid med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba dang*/ yul yangs pa can dang*/ grong khyer rtsa mchog la sogs par/ don dam par nges pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba'o// gnyis pa gsang sngags 'bras bu'i chos 'byung bar gsol ba btab pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das mya ngan la 'da' khar gsang sngags phyis 'byung bar lung bstan te/ mdo las/ nga ni 'di nis mi snang bar// lo ni brgya dang bcu gnyis 106)dang*// lha gnas gsum du grags pa yis// bstan pa'i snying po dam pa zhig /'dzam gling shar gyis phyogs mtshams kyis// mi las skal ldan rigs can te// rgyal po dza zhes bya ba la// sngon gyis ltar snang bar 'gyur// drag shul can zhes bya ba'i rigs// grogs kyis sems dpa' dman pa'i lus// lang ka'i bdag po la sogs pa// lag na rdo rje ston par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ de la rgyud lung man ngag gsum las/ rgyud ni/ bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyer brgyad nas/

rgyal po la rmi ltas rnam pa bdun byung ste/ mdo las/ sku gsung thugs rtags thim pa dang*// glegs bam char du babs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas sa la lung bstan no// zhes so/ 107)/de dus lha tshangs pa/ klu 'jog po/ gnod sbyin skra mda' gtong*/ srin po lang ka mgrin bcu/ mi li rtsa byi dri med grags pa ste/ dam pa'i rigs can lnga la bcom ldan 'das kyi lung bstan pa ltar/ lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad nas/ ri ma la ya gnam lcags yod pa'i rtse mor lhags nas/ phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegs pa thams cad yid la bya ste/ kye ma kya hud kye ma klong*/ ston pa sgron me 'od nub na/ 'jig rtan mun pa gang gis sel// zhes pa la sogs pa'i gdung tshig nyi shu rtsa gsum ston pas/ bder gshegs thams cad kyis/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rja bskul te/ kyai gsang ba'i bdag po khyod// sngon gyis go cha yal lam ci// 'jig rten gdung ba mi sel lam// snying pos sa la babs nas kyang*// 'jig rten gdung ba gsal bar rigs// ces bskul bas/ gsang bdag gis gsung bar zhal gyis bzhes/ 108)thog ma tha ma med pa ru// bskul ba'i dus ni gang byung kyang*// bdag kyang de bzhin cho 'phrul snang*// zhes gsungs nas/ ri ma la ya'i rtser byon nas/ dam pa'i rigs can lnga la/ mdo dgongs 'dus la sogs pa gsungs tshul lo// de'i tshe rgyal po in dra bho dhis ri ma la ya'i sked par/ gsang sngags phyi rgyud yo ga'i bsgrub pa mdzad pa'i dus su/ gong bzhin rmis ltas bdun byung ba'i tha ma la/ nang par sgrub khang gi thog tu ltas pas/ gser gyis glegs bam la beḍūrya zhun ma bris pa'i gsang sngags kyis rgyud sde mang po dang*/ phyag rdor gyis sku gcig kyang byon 'dug go /de rnams la gzigs pas gzhan gang yang shes pa ma byung*/ rdo rje sems dpa' thugs sgyu 'phrul 'dra ba'i le'u shes te/ de nyid kyis sgo nas bsgrubs shing*/ sku de nyid la gsol ba btab pas/

gsang bdag dngos su byon nas/ tan tra chen 109)po sda bco brgyad pa sgyu 'phrul phyag rgya chen po'i rgyud sde rnams gsungs tshul lo// bka' rdzogs pa chen po rgyu 'bras kyis chos thams cad rdzogs nas/ sum cu rtsa gsum du/ ru kun dga' snying po la/ rmi ltas rnam pa bzhi byung ste/ thub pa drug gi bskor ba byas te rul la thim pa dang*/ bdud dang khyab 'jug gu lang gyur mig tu zos pa dang*/ phyag tu nyi zla thogs te 'jig rten khams kyis mun pa gsal ba dang*/ nam mkha' la sprin gser gis mdog lta bu las char babs te/ rtsi thog rgyas par smin nas/ lha'i dbang po rgya byin la bshad pas/ lha'i dbang pos rtsol med kyis bstan pa 'byung bar shes te/ rgyal ba rnams la rtsol med kyis bstan pa bshad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ nam mkha' mtha' mnyam las/ kye dus gsum gshegs pa rgyal ba yis// rtsol bcas theg pa mthar bstan te// rtsol med 110)'dus pa'i 'khor rnams la// rtsol med theg pa bshad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rgyal ba rnams kyis rdo rje sems dpa' bskul nas/ rdo rje sems dpas phyag na rdo rje thugs kar sprul nas/ chos 'chad pa'i skyes bur dbang bskur te/ mdo las/ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyis// gsang ba'i 'khor lo gter 'dzin zhing*// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba las// khyod ni smra ba'i seṅge ste// rtsol med 'dus pa'i gang zag la// lhun grub theg pa gsungs su rtsol med kyis theg pa gsungs tshul dang*/ de nas gsang bdag phyag na rdo rjes/ sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje gsang ba rdzogs pa chen po'i bdag por bdag por dbang bskur nas/ u rgyan dha na ko sha'i gling du/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la sogs 111)pa rnams la/ rtsol med rdzogs pa chen po'i chos gsungs tshul lo// de dag rgyas par rang rang gis skabs bzhin shes par bya'o// gnyis pa bye brag tu skyes tshul ni/

bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba btab pas/ byin rlabs 'byung ba yin te/ dang po bla ma mos gus kyis spyi bor bhai las gsol ba btab na/ dgongs pa mnyam nyid du 'gyur zhing*/ sangs rgyas pas kyang lhag par gsungs te/ a ti bkod pa'i rgyud las/ bskal pa 'bum gyis sangs rgyas bas// bla ma gnyen par shes par bya// ces pa dang*/ gces 'phreng gis mod las/ des na bla ma spyi bor bhai// rdo rje slob dpon bhai pa ni// mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa'i lha// 'bum bhai pa yi bsod nams kyis// bla ma bhai pa'i 'bum char min// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro zhing 112)gsol ba btab pas/ thugs rje dang byin rlabs 'byung zhing*/ skyabs 'og tu tshud pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dpag tu med par gsungs te/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i mdo las/ gang gis dkon mchog gsum po la// skyabs su 'gro bar byas nas ni// yon tan de la gzugs mchis na// nam mkha' 'di yang snod du chung*// zhes gsungs so// yid kyis lha bhai zhing gsol ba btab na/ dus nam zhig nas zhal mthong gsung thos pa la sogs pa'i byin rlabs kyi 'byung ste/ rgyud sgyu 'phrul lags las/ lha dang lha ru mchod byas nas// lha dag gnyis su med par 'gyur/ ces pa dang*/ bdag nyid lha dang mnyam sbyor nas/ yon tan chung yang 'grub par 'gyur// theg pa thams cad kyis shan 'byed/ nyi 'od rab gsal las/ thugs rje skye tshul bstan pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// ༈ lnga ba thugs skyes 113)nas don mdzad tshul ni gsum ste/ don mdzad pa' tshul dang*/ rnam grangs dang*/ bka' dang rgyud man ngag gis khog dbub pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ rten can gyis don mdzad pa dang*/ rten med kyis don mdzad pa dang*/ ngo bo nyid kyis don mdzad pa'o// dang po ni/ sems tsam kri yog sde gsum la sogs pa'i lugs kyis/ sangs rgyas nyid kyis gzugs sku rang 'od sgo re ba gcig 'on min na yod la/

de dang de'i sprul pas don mdzad par 'dod de/ rgyas par 'og nas theg pa rang gzhung nas ston par gyur ro// gnyis pa ni/ dbu ma pa'i lugs kyis/ mthar thug chos kyis sku/ dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pas las spang bya blo bur gyi dri ma dag pa'i/ dag pa gnyis kyi bdag nyid du bzhugs la/ de la gzugs sku rnam pa gnyis byung nas don mdzad par 'dod pa'o// yang chos sku stong pa la byas 114)nas/ gzugs sku gnyis gdul bya'i snang ngor tsam du 'dod pa yang yod de/ de ni sngon gyis smon lam gyis stobs las 'byung bar 'dod de/ chos sku nam mkha' lta bu las/ longs sku sprin lta bu 'byung nas/ de las sprul sku char lta bu 'byung nas/ don mdzad zer ba yang yod do// rgyas par 'og nas ston par 'gyur ro// gsum pa ngo bo nyid kyis don mdzad pa ni/ sangs rgyas dang*/ gdul bya sems can gnyis dbyer med cing*// ma 'dres la yongs su rdzogs par don mdzad pa'o// ye shes gting rdzogs las/ chos kun rang byung ston pa'i mchog /der 'dus 'khor dang bcas pa dag /nyid las mi zhen rang byung nyid// ces pa dang*/ gong gis mkhyen pa'i lung tshig bzhin no// gnyis pa rnam grangs ni/ spyir sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ gang la gang 'dul ci ltar mtshams pa ltar du don mdzad cing*/ 115)bye brag ni/ rgyu mtshan nyid pa ltar na/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pas don mdzad par gsungs te/ rgyud bla ma las/ skye ba mngon par skye ba dang*// dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang*// lhums su bzhugs dang bltams pa dang*// bzo'i gnas la mkhas pa dang*// btsun mo'i 'khor gyis bskor ba dang*// rol rtsed chen po mdzad pa dang*// nges 'byung dka' ba spyad pa dang*// byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang*// bdud sde chan po btul ba dang*// byang chub chos 'khor mya ngan 'das// ces so// rgyud mahā yo ga'i lugs kyis kun tu sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/

de bzhin du gsung dang thugs dang yon tan dang 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pas don mdzad par gsungs so// mdo'i lugs kyis phyin ci log gis gdul bya rgyud nas dag pa'i don la 'dren pas/ thabs mkhas pa'i mdzad pa 116)dang*// grong khyer gsum gyi don du sku gsum du snang nas don mdzad pa ni yul dang mthun pa'i mdzad pa dang*/ sprul pa'i sku des drangs don gyi chos gsungs nas/ 'da' khar gsang sngags kyis chos phyis 'byung bar lung bstan pas/ rmad 'byung che ba dang*/ gdul bya theg pa gsum/ gdul thabs gsum gyis gnas skabs dang mthar thug gis las rgyun gcod pa'i mdzad pa dang*/ ston pa 'chad pa'i mdzad pa dang lngas don mdzad par gsungs/ rgyas par rang rang gis gzhung bzhin no// rdzogs pa chen po ni/ 'gro drug gis snang tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bstun nas don mdzad pa dang*/ thabs mkhas theg pa sna tshogs kyis don mdzad pa'o// snga ma ni/ 'gro drug gis snang ba dang bstun nas don mdzad pa dang*/ 'byung ba lnga dang*/ 'dod yon lngar snang nas don mdzad pa dang*/ phyi nang gi skal pa zung gsum ya drug gis 117)don mdzad pa'o// snga ma ni/ mdo bcu las/ lha dang lha min gnas rigs su// che ba nga rgyal 'joms par bstan// shes pa mi yi gnas rigs su// dge sdig rgyu 'bras sde snod bshad// gti mug byol song gnas rigs su// rig pa shes pa'i chos kyang bstan// bkres skom yi dwags gnas rigs su// bkres 'phongs sel ba'i chos kyang bstan// sdug bsngal dmyal ba'i gnas rigs su// snga phyi dran pa'i zhen pa bzlog /ces gsungs so// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ 'byung ba rnam pa lnga dang*/ 'dod yon lngar snang nas kyang rang bzhin gyis don mdzad pa yin te/ rin chen klong dgu las/ sa dang chu dang me dang rlung*// 'dod lnga kun tu sbyor bas yang*// sangs rgyas thugs rje rol par shar// thugs rje nam mkha'i mtha' ltar shar// zhes so// gsum pa ni/

phyi nang gis bskal pa zung 118)gsum ya drug tu snang nas las ngan gyis rgyun gcod pa yin te/ mdo las/ nad dang mu ge mtshon nyid dang*// me chu rlung gis bskal pa stong*/ /de dag rims par gyis bstan pa// thugs rje rmad 'byung rol pa yis// gdul bya'i thabs su ston pa yin/ zhes gsungs so// thabs mkhas theg pas don mdzad pa la gnyis te/ rtsol ba'i rim pa theg pa brgyad kyis don mdzad pa dang*/ rtsol med a tis don mdzad pa'o// de dag gang 'chad kyang*/ rang rang gis skabs dang sbyar nas bshad do// gsum pa rgyud dag man ngag gis khog dbub pa la gnyis te/ bka' dang bstan bcos kyis khyad par dang*/ rgyud lung man ngag gis khog dbub pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ go ba'i khyad par dang*/ bye brag so so'i dbye ba'o// snga ma ni/ lha'i bus zhus pa'i mdo las/ chos rnams thams cad bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis su 119)'dus/ legs par bshad dang de'i dgongs 'grel dang*// de'i dbang gis shākya'i bstan pa ni// 'jig rten khams 'dir yun ring gnas par 'gyur/ zhes pas/ legs par gsung pa ni bka' yin la/ de'i dgongs pa 'grel pa ni bstan bcos so// yang ston pa sangs rgyas kyi bdag rkyen las byung zhing legs par gsungs pa ni bka'/ de la rten zhing de'i dgongs pa ma nor 'grel pa ni bstan bcos so// gnyis pa bye brag so so'i dbye ba ni/ bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis so// bka' la gsum ste/ zhal nas gsungs pa'i bka' dang*/ byin gyis rlabs pa'i bka' dang*/ rjes su gnang ba'i bka'o// dang po ni/ sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas gsungs pa rnams so// gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i dus na/ ston pa'i byin rlabs kyis sku dang gsung dang*/ thugs kyi byin 120)gyis brlabs so// sku'i ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po'i spyi bor/ ston pas phyag gser gyi mdog can bzhag nas/

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po khyod kyis/ sangs rgyas phal po chos la spobs par gyis shig gsungs pas/ byang chub sems dpa' des phal po che gsungs pa lta bu'o// gsung gis byin gyi rlabs ni/ rab 'byor la rab 'byor khyod kyis shes rab kyis pha rol du phyin pa spobs par bzung zhig gsungs pas/ rab 'byor gyis 'phags pa bsdud pa lta bu'o/ thugs kyis byin gyis rlabs la gsum ste thugs ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyi rlabs pa ni/ 'phags pa shā ri'i bus/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la/ zab mo bzhi ldan dang*/ brgyad ldan dris pas/ byang chub 121)sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis shes rab kyis pha rol du phyin pa gsungs pa lta bu'o// thugs rjes byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ ston pa'i bdag rkyen gyis gnod sbyin la sogs pa rnams dang*/ ne rtso dang*/ rma bya dang*/ glang po che la sogs pa rnams kyis chos bshad pa la sogs pa rnams so// thugs rje bden stobs kyis byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ shing bu dang*/ rdi'u dang*/ rnga bo che dang*/ dpag bsam gyis ljon shing dang*/ rtsigs pa la sogs pa rnams las/ 'bum la sogs pa'i chos byung ba lta bu'o// gsum pa rjes su snang ba'i bka' ni sangs rgyas kyi nga'i bka' rnams la dang po gleng gzhi'i tshig chug bar du mtshams sbyor gyis tshig chug tha ma rjes su yi rang ba'i tshig chug ces gsungs pa lung bstan pa las byung ba rnams so/ 122)spyi cings las/ ston pa mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ ci srid mya ngan ma 'das par// byung ba gang yin bka' ru grags// yang tshad ma'i zhal nas byung bas na// bka' yi nges tshigs 'grub pa yin// gnyis pa bstan bcos ni/ bka' spyi dang bye brag gis dgongs pa 'grel ba rnams dang*/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gis dgongs pa 'grel pa rnams dang*/

rang rang gis skabs nas bshad pa ltar yin te/ rje btsun byams pa'i gsungs nas/ ci ltar sgron glogs nor bu nyi zla la// brten nas mig dang ldan rnams lta ba bzhin// thub la brten nas ngas 'di yang dag bshad// 'jig rten khams 'dir yun ring gnas par 'gyur/ zhes pa dang*/ nyon mongs dgra rnams ma lus chos pa dang*// ngan 'gro'i srid las skyobs byed gang yin pa// chos skyob yon tan phyir na bstan bcos te// gnyis po 'di dag 123)gzhan gyis lugs na med/ zhes pa dang*/ dam pa bder gshegs yis/ sa'i dbang phyug man chad nas// gang zag sad pa yan chad la// byung ba gang yin bstan bcos te// ces gsungs so// gnyis pa rgyud lung man ngag gis khyad par ni/ spyi dang*/ bye brag go de yang phun sum tshogs pa lnga tshang zhing 'brel dang ma tshang ba med pa gcig rgyud/ dpag par dka' ba'i don mngon sum ston pa lung*/ tshegs chung zhing*/ bya sla la don che bas man ngag go /rngam log las/ phun sum tshogs pa lnga tshang zhing*// 'brel dang ma tshang med pas na// yongs su rdzogs pas rgyud ces bya// zhes pa dang*/ mdo las/ thabs che tshegs chung don dpag med// ces gsungs so// gnyis pa bye brag la gnyis te/ rgyud lung kan ngag gsum gyis dbye ba dang*/ khog dbub pa'o/ 124)dang po ni/ zhus len 'dres mar gsungs shing tshang la 'brel pas rgyud/ sangs rgyas kyi zhal ma slad cing ci bzhin gsungs pa'i cha nas lung*/ don nyid mngon du phyung ba'i cha nas man ngag go /mdo las/ gsung gis 'gyur ba de mtshon na// skyes bu rgyal po'i bka' lung bzhin// zhus len 'phra men 'phel rgyas na// skyes bu rgyal po'i bka' rgyud yin// de nyid nges pa kho na'o// ces pa dang*/ ma slad ci bzhin bcas pas lung*// rtogs chen yan lag 'brel bcas rgyud/ ces gsungs so// de ltar yang*/ ngo bo gcig la rgyu mtshan phyogs res nas gsum du phye ba yin te/

lung de nyid las/ gsum du snang ba gcig tu zad// dbyer med tshul gyis rang bzhin las// gcig ste rnam pa yongs kyis med/ ces pa dang*/ bdud rtsi bam brgyad las/ rgyud dang lung dang man ngag gsum// 'bangs dang rje dang rgyal po'i 125)tshul// gcig la gcig rten gcig gis ngang*// gcig ste rnam pa yongs kyi med/ ces gsungs so/ gnyis pa khog dbub pa la gnyis te/ rgyud kyis khog dbub pa dang*/ man ngag gi khog dbub pa'o// rgyud dang 'byung ba'i gleng gzhi dang*/ rkyen gyis gleng slangs dang*/ yongs rdzogs pa rgyud kyis don dang*/ rgyud gang la gsungs shing btad pa dang bzhi ste/ rang rang gis skabs bzhin no// gnyis pa man ngags la drug ste/ ngo bo dang*/ nges tshig dang*/ dgos byed dang*/ rnam grangs dang*/ rtsa ma tshad/ bshad pa'i thabs so// dang po ngo bo ni/ khongs nas khongs su rgyud pa'i dgongs pa'i nyams len la bya ste/ don spyi dang rang gis mtshan nyid nyams su myong ba gcig dgos gsungs/ yang bcud du phyung ba/ don du 'drel ba/ nyams su blang ba'i lag len la bya'o// gnyis pa nges 126)tshig ni/ rje bsgrub phug pa shākya seng ge'i zhal nas/ tshegs chung dgos byed che/ nges par myur du 'grub pas man ngags yin gsungs/ yang ka dang nyams su myong ba'i don mngon du phyung nas/ ston pa gcig la man ngags ces bya'o// gsum pa dgos byed ni/ lung gis dgongs pa rnams lta bar mi nus pa'i don du/ gang zag gis lung gis bcud phyung nas/ rtogs shing nyams su myong ba'i dgos pa yod do// bzhi pa rnam grangs ni/ snyan rgyud zhal gyis gdams pa dang*/ khyad par stong nyid rang grol ba'i man ngag dang*/ yi ge kun gyis man ngag go /snga ma ni/ kun bzang rdor 'chang man chad du yi ge ris su bris ma myong*/ bris pa dang 'gal ma myong ba'i don mtshon pa la bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ dang po brda don sprod/ bar du ngo 'phrod/

tha mar brda bral stong nyid rang grol lo// gsum pa yi ge kun gyis man ngag ni/ tshig dang 127)yi ge ris su bris pa'i man ngag la bya ste/ de kho na nyid ston pa'i man ngag dang*/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa gnyis so// dang po la gnyis te/ gnas skabs de kho na nyid ston pa'i theg pa 'og ma rnams kyi rang rag gis mthar thug gis don ston pa dang*/ mthar thug gi de kho na nyid ston pa a ti'i na ngag rnams so// gnyis pa mngon par rtog pa'i rim la gsum ste/ theg pa spyi dang bye brag la 'jug pa dang*/ rgyud spyi dag bye brag la 'jug pa dang*/ lam spyi dang bye brag la 'jug pa'o// de yang theg pa spyi la 'jug pa ni/ la shan dang*/ g.yu thang dang*/ snang ba bcun pa la sogs pa rnams so// theg pa bye brag ni rang rang gis skabs bzhin no// rgyud spyi la 'jug pa ni/ dbu zhabs mtshon pa'i 'brel pa dang*/ tri ka dang man ngag rnams so// rgyud bye brag la 'jug pa ni/ gleng 128)slang dang*/ rgyud kyis don phun sum tshogs pa la 'jug pa'o// lam spyi la 'jug pa ni/ sgyu 'phrul rim la sogs pa dang*/ lam rgyas par bstan pa rnams so// lam bye brag ni cha rkyen lta ba ting 'dzin la sogs pa'o// slab pa'i mtha' bcu la sogs bye brag re re nas ston pas so// lnga pa tsam pa'i tshad la gnyis te/ mod sde las brten nas bstan bcos rtsam pa'i tshad dang*/ rgyud sde la brten nas man ngag rtsam pa'i tshad do// dang po ni lung la 'dres shing tshad la mkhas pa sgra dang don gnyis gtso bor gyur pas/ rig pa'i bstan bcos brtsam pa dang*/ ces gsungs pas/ lung la 'dris pas/ mngon sum dang rjes dpag gis tshad la mkhas pa/ rang gis don spyi dang mtshan nyid khongs su tshud pas/ bstan bcos rtsam par bshad do// gnyis pa ni/ lung la rdzun mi tshud/ rang gis nyams 129)myong man ngag ldan// yongs su shes pa'i dngos po rnams/ tshad du shes pa gdams pas bstan/

zhes pa lung gis tshig dang don gyis dgongs pa khrol ba/ rang gis rtogs shing nyams su myong ba/ khong nas khongs su rgyud pa'i gdams ngag dang ldan pa/ shes pa'i dngos po bcu la mkhas pas rtsam par bshad do// rgyan las/ chos nyid mngon sum rtogs pa rab/ bla med mkha' 'gro yis// lung bstan thog pa 'bring po yin// la shan bka' lung tshig la mkhas// bye brag phyed pa tha ma yin/ zhes pas/ rab chos nyid kyis bden pa mthong ba/ 'bring yi dam lha'i zhal mthong lung bstan thob pa/ tha ma shan 'byed cing la zlas pa'i bka' lung gis tshig la mkhas pas rtsam par bshad do// drug pa bshad thabs ni/ lung chog bla ma las/ thos chung par bu yid 130)ches bskyed pa'i phyir/ man ngag spyi don rtsis sgo lnga yis gzhoms sam/ zhes gsungs pas/ yid ches shing khungs tsun pa'i phyir slob dpon gang gis mdzad pa dang*/ bka' dang mig gsal zhing theg pa'i gzhung tshugs par bya ba'i phyir/ rgyud gang nas btus shig phyogs gang du gtogs pa dang*/ bstan pa la mtshan nges shing don gyis mdo tsam rtogs pa'i phyir/ mtshan ci la btags pa dang*/ dgos byed dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir/ gang gis don du mdzad pa dang*/ dbu zhabs kyi don khongs su chud par bya ba'i phyir/ dbu zhabs kyi don du bstan pa'o// de rnams rang rang gis skabs dang sbyar la bshad do// bka' rdzogs pa chen po'i lugs kyis rgyud man ngag 'chad kyang*/ spyi don lnga dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bshad do// kun byed las/ dang po yid ches khungs ni bstan pa'i phyir/ lo rgyus don gyis bshad lugs 131)bstan par bya/ chos kun rtsa ba sems su 'dus pa'i phyir/ de nas rtsa ba'i don te bstan par bya/ theg pa'i khyad par so so phye ba'i phyir/ yo ga don gyi rtsa ba bstan par bya/ rtsol sgrub bya mi dgos par bstan pa'i phyir/ dgos byed don gyis dgongs pa de ru bstan// ma rtogs don te rtogs par bya ba'i phyir// tshig gis don te sgra ru brjod par bya/

ces pa dang*/ rgyan lasa.a man ngag khung phyung ldugs pos dang*// 'jug sgo theg pa yo ga'i don// rten gyis gang zag dgos pa'i don// dril nas mtshan gsol rtsa ba'i don// dbu zhabs dkyus bshad tshig gis don// spyi don lnga yis bshad pa yin// zhes gsungs te/ de la dang po don gyis rgyud pa can dang*/ tha snyad bral don mtshon pa// man ngag tshad mas rang mtshan ston// rgyal ba rig 'dzin gang zag rgyud// ces pas/ 132) rgyal ba dgongs pas rgyud pa/ rig 'dzin brda'i rgyud pa/ gang zag snyan khung rgyud pa'o// dang po lo rgyus bstan pa ni la bcu ste/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi che ba dang*/ bstan pa dam chos kyi che ba dang*/ mkhas pa paṇḍi ta'i dang*/ sgra sgyur lo tsā'i dang*/ yon bdag zhing gis dang*/ bzhengs pa rten gyis dang*/ sgrub po grub thos kyis dang*/ gtan la phebs pa gzhi'i dang*/ 'grod pa lam gyis dang*/ mngon du byas pa 'bras bu'i che ba dang bcu'o// dang po ni/ ston pa yongs rdzogs kyis che ba dang*/ gzhi rang bzhin gyis ston pa kun tu bzang po 'khrul ma myong pas ston pa sangs rgyas kyi che ba'o /snga ma ni/ sde snod gsum la sogs pa rnams ni/ sprul pa'i sku re res gsung pa yin la/ bka' rdzogs pa chen po ni sku lnga yongs rdzogs kyis sangs rgyas kyi gsungs pa yin/ gnyis pa ni/ rang byung gis ston pa ni/ 133)/ye ci bzhin pa'i sangs rgyas las 'khrul ma myong ste/ khyad par 'phags so// lam gyis sangs rgyas/ theg pa so so'i sangs rgyas las/ phyogs 'dzin dang lam bsgrod ma myong bas khyad par du 'phags pas/ 'bras bu rtogs pa mngon gyur gyis sangs rgyas las lam gyis rtogs ma myong bas khyad par du 'phags so// de dag gis lung ni 'khrul ma myong gis skabs bzhin no// gnyis pa bstan pa dam chos kyi che ba la gnyis te/ bstan pa yongs su rdzogs ma rdzogs kyis khyad par dang*/ che ba rgyu mtshan lnga'i khyad par du 'phags pa bstan pa'o/

dang po ni theg pa rim pa dgu las mtshan nyid kyis theg pa gsum ni/ rgyu'i theg pa yin zhing*/ sprul pa sku'i bstan pa'o// yang sde snod rnam pa gsum las/ chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong du gsungs/ gsang sngags phyi rgyud gsum ni 'bras bu spyi'i rnam pa tsam lam du 134)byed pa la/ longs spyod rdzogs pa sku'i bstan pa gtso che bar gsungs te/ de la yang rgyud sde dpag tu med pa yod par gsungs/ nang pa dbang gyur thabs kyi theg pa gsum ni/ sku snga lhun grub kyis bstan pa yongs su rdzogs shing*/ khyad par du ngo bo nyid kyis sku dang*/ chos sku'i bstan pa'o// de la mahā dang a nu gnyis ni/ 'bras bu rang gis mtshan nyid dang ldan pa lam du byed cing 'khor 'das gnyis su med par ston pa yin/ mahā ni sgyu 'phrul sde bzhi dang*/ tan tra chen po sde bco brgyad la sogs pa dpag tu med cing brjod las 'das par yod par gsungs/ a nu ni lung gis bam mdo chen po lnga la sogs pa/ lung gis chos rnams gsungs/ a ti yo ga ni/ chos kun rang byung ye shes la las rgyud gnyis su med cing*/ 'khor 'das gnyis med rgya chad phyogs lhungs med par gtan la 'bebs pa/ 135)de yang a nu man cad kyi theg pa yongs su rdzogs par ston la/ khyad par a ti'i bstan pa nam mkha' dang 'dra ste mtha' med par stan/ de yang phyogs tsam gcig mtshon na/ phyi sems sde'i bskor/ nang klong sde'i bskor/ rgyud sde'i skor/ shan 'byed bram ze'i skor/ la zla rgyal po'i skor/ rang grol mngon sum du ston pa gdams ngag gis skor dang drug go /sems sdem ma bu bco brgyad de/ rmad byung dang rig pa mchog gis rgyud la sogs te/ rgyud sde chen po bco brgyad dang*/ snga 'gyur lnga/ phyi 'gyur bcu gsum la sogs te/ gdams ngag bco brgyad la sogs pa dpag tu med pa yod par gsungs/ klong sde'i skor la bzhi ste/

phyi rtsis rgya'i skor la/ glang pa che rab 'bog gi rgyud la sogs pa/ zer bu brgya dag brgyad bcu/ nang gsang rgya'i skor la/ rig pa rtsal gyis 136)rgyud la sogs pa'i man ngag brgya dang brgyad cu/ gsang ba rgyud bu chung gis skor la/ rin chen bkod pa'i rgyud la sogs pa bsam gtan brgya dang brgyad cu/ dgongs pa gtad rgya'i skor la/ klong chen rab byams kyis rgyud la sogs pa brgya dang brgyad bcu gsungs par gsal/ rgyud sde'i skor la nam mkha' mtha' mnyam dang*/ nya mo 'khor lo'i rgyud la sogs pa rgyu bzhi bcu zhe gnyis man ngag dang bcas pa yod par gsungs/ bram ze'i skor la/ bram ze rtsa ba'i rgyud drug yan lag gi rgyud sum cu rtsa drug gsungs/ de la nam mkha' klong yangs kyis rgyud dang*/ ye shes gting rdzogs kyis rgyud dang*/ kun tu bzang po ye shes klong gis rgyud dang*/ rang byung bde ba 'khor lo'i rgyud dang*/ nges don 'dus pa gter gyis rgyud dang*/ 'khor ba rtsad gcog kyi rgyud dang*/ spyi rgyud ye shes nams mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud 137)la sogs pa'o// la zla rgyal po'i skor ni/ bkra shis dus tshod 'dzin pa khu byug rol pa'i rgyud dang*/ rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i rgyud dang*/ sgron ma gsang ba bkod pa'i rgyud dang*/ kun byed rgyal po'i rgyud dang*/ rig pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud la sogs pa rtsa ba'i rgyud sde lnga/ man ngag gi rgyud sde brgya tham pa/ man ngag dang bcas pa yod par gsungs/ man ngag skor la/ gab pa mngon du phyung ba'i skor dang*/ rig pa gtan la phebs sgeg pa'i skor dang*/ chos nyid ma bu ngo sprad pa'i rdzong 'phrang gis skor dang*/ rang grol mngon du stan pa rgyud tha ma'i skor dang*/ de re re la yang rgyud sde man ngag dang bcas pa yod par gsungs so// de rnams kyis khongs nas kyang*/ mu stegs pa'i log rtog bsal ba dang*/ theg pa brgyad kyis shan 'byed pa dang*/

rdzogs pa chen po zla ba dang*/ rang grol 138)mngon sum du ngo sprod pa la sogs pa theg pa thams cad kyis 'dod lugs yod par gsungs so// rke tshang gis skor la/ phyi skor/ nang skor/ gsang skor/ yang gsang bla na med pa'i skor la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ a ro'i skor/ dam sgro'i skor/ spros bral don gsal gyis skor/ spyi ti'i skor/ spyi mdo'i skor/ kun grol gyis skor la sogs pa brjod las 'das yod par gsungs/ gnyis pa che bdun nam lnga'i khyad par du 'phags pa ni/ theg pa thams cad kyis yang rtse yin pa'i tshe ba ri rgyal lhun po lta bu dang*/ lung thams cad kyis rgyal po yin pa'i che ba nyi ma'i snying po lta bu dang*/ bka' thams cad kyis 'grel pa yin pa'i tshe ba nam mkha' dwangs nas snod bcud thams cad gsal ba lta bu dang*/ bstan pa thams cad kyis 'byung gnas/ yin pa'i che ba nam 139)mkha' las 'byung ba lnga snang ba lta bu dang*/ man ngag thams cad kyis rtsa ba yin pa'i che ba rgyal po'i bka' lung thog pa'i mi lta bu dang*/ don thams cad kyis 'jug sdud yin pa'i che ba/ mgron po don grub nas rang khyim du 'ong lta bu dang*/ chos thams cad kyis le log yin pa'i che ba me long g.ya' dag pa lta bu'o// mdo las/ gling dang ri bo mu 'khyud bcas// lhun po'i rtse mo nyid nas gsal// ci snyed theg pa'i rnam grangs kun// bdag nyid chen po nyid mthong gsal// zhes dang*/ 'jig rten 'od kyis rgyal po ni// gza' ldan rgyal po nyi ma yin// chos kun yongs rdzogs gsal ba la// kun snang chen po de nyid do// ces dang*/ go skabs chen po nam mkha' ni// chen po nyid ni go 'byed ltar// gsungs shing 'dus pa de nyid kyis// brjod pa'i tshig kun gsal 140)bar 'grol/ zhes pa dang*/ gang gis bka'i gsang thos nas// mi gang gzhan la rags ma las// gsang ba'i snying por kun chub nas// smra brjod gang la yang rtsal mi dgos// ces pa dang*/

rgyud dang bcas pa'i 'byung ba rnams// nam mkha'i ngang nas 'byung zhing snang*// de ni smra brjod 'byung ba rnams// de nyid zab mo'i dbyings nas 'byung*/ zhes dang*/ don du bya ba'i rnam grangs kun// mthar gyis 'bras bu 'grub par sdud// rnam grangs rgya che brjod mod kyang*// de kun de bzhin nyid du 'dus// ces pa dang*/ me long gsal ba'i snying po ni// gzhan gyi gzugs brnyan ston pa ltar// de bzhin chos kyis me long gis// kun gyis rang bzhin gsal bar byed// ces gsungs so// gsum pa mkhas pa paṇḍi ta'i che ba ni rig 'dzin rnam pa gsum dang*/ rdzogs pa chen po 'khor 'das 141)dbyer med chos kun rang byung ye shes su rtogs nas/ rig pa mchog la mnga' brnyes pa yin te/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang*/ shrī ri sing ha dang*/ bi ma la mi tra la sogs te mkhas pa nyi shu rtsa lnga dang*/ rgyal po dza dang*/ dam pa'i rigs can lnga dang*/ slob dpon chen po hūm̐ ka ra dang*/ gu tu pad ma 'byung gnas la sogs te/ de rnams kyis chos nid rgyun chad med par mngon sum du rtogs pas/ lha ma srin bral du 'khol zhing snang srid dbang du bsdud pa/ sgra sgyur sum brgya drug cu la sogs pa la mnga' brnyes shing*/ rigs drag gis skad la thogs pa med par chos ston nus pa'o// bzhi pa sgra sgyur lo tsā'i che ba/ dge slong mi lnga dang*/ ka cog rnam gnyis dang*/ gnyags dzñā na ku ma ra dang*/ bai ro tsa na la sogs pa'i lo paṇa brgya rtsa brgyad rnams rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas shing*/ sgra sgyur 142)sum brgya drug cu la sogs pa mkhyen pa/ rigs drug gis skad la thogs pa med cing*/ snyan gyis dus gcig la chos nyan nus pa/ bstan pa thams cad thugs la rdzogs pa yin te/ rig 'dzin byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ sprul pa sku'i lo tsā ba yin gsungs/ lnga pa yon bdag zhing gis che ba ni/ rgyal po med dpon rnam gsum sprul pa'i sku yin par gsungs te/

lha tho tho ri'i gnyan tsan ni phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa/ srong btsan sgam po ni spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa/ khri srong sde'u btsan ni 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa yin par gsungs te/ de gsum gyis sku ring la dang po chos kyis dbu brnyes/ bar du srol btod/ mtha' ma khri srong sde btsan gyis ring la dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do// drug pa ni/ bod du rten bzhengs su ma btub pa la/ ru non bzhi/ kha naun bzhi/ gtad kha bzhi/ me rtsa bzhi la sogs pa 143)byas te/ lha sa bsam yas la sogs pa gtsug lag khang brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs/ de rnams su rang byung gis lha tshogs mang po dngos su bzhugs pa dang*/ bzhengs pa'i lha tshogs rnams la srong btsan sgam po dang*/ slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas la sogs pa rnams kyis rab gnas mdzad nas/ ye shes kyi lha dngos su spyan drangs te/ gnyis su med par bstibs pa'i tshe rten thams cad chos kyi sgro ba mdzad par gsungs so// bdun pa grub thob byin gyis rlabs che ba bod du gnubs nam mkha'i snying po la sogs pa dge slong mi bzhi dang*/ a tsa ra dpal dbyangs la sogs pa dpal yang dag gi sgo nas tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin dang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin la sogs pa thob ste/ lus por ma dgos pa sangs rgyas/ brgyud pa'i lugs re re la'ang mang du 'byung bar gsungs so// brgyad pa 144)gtan la phebs pa gzhi'i che ba ni/ gzhi 'khor 'das dbyer med rang byung ye shes su gtan la phebs pa yin te/ gong du gzhi'i skabs bzhin no// dgu pa sgrod pa lam dang*/ bcu pa mngon du byas pa 'bras bu'i che ba ni/ gsang sngags kyis gzhi lam 'bras bu'i skabs nas bshad pa bzhin du shes par bya'o// spyi don gnyis pa yo ga'i don ni/ yo ga'i bye brag phye la a ti yo gar la zla'o// gsum pa dgos byed ni/ spyir theg pa rang rang gis skabs nas bshad pa bzhin dang*/ khyad par du rtsol sgrub can tshi chad pa'i nang dang bral ba'i phyir/

gol sgrib kyis shan phye/ ma nor bar la bzlas nas/ rang grol mngon sum du bstan pa'o// bzhi pa dril nas mtshan du btags pa ni/ chos kun rtsa ba rang byung ye shes su 'dus shing rdzogs la/ de nyid kyis gong na gzhan med pas rdzogs pa chen po zhes bya'o// de la yang bye 145)brag tu phye na/ mdo sa lu ljang pa la sogs pa dpe la mtshan du btags pa dang*/ lang kar gshegs pa la sogs pa yul la mtshan btags pa dang*/ rigs gsum dang brgya bcu pa la sogs pa grangs la mtshan du btags pa dang*/ lam rim dang gsang snying la sogs pa brjod bya la mtshan du btags pa dang*/ la shan la sogs pa rjod byed la mtshan du btags pa dang*/ dgongs 'dus dang*/ kun byed dang*/ klong chen la sogs pa don la mtshan du btags pa'o// de la sogs pa mtshan gyis 'dod lugs dang*/ rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab par gsungs so// lnga pa dbu zhabs kyis kyus bshad pa tshig gi don/ rang rang gis skabs bzhin shes par bya/ theg pa thams cad kyis shan 'byed/ nyi 'od rab gsal las/ thugs rje skyes nas don mdzad tshul bstan pa'i 146)le'u ste lnga pa'o// ༈ gsum pa gdul bya lam gyi snang ba la gsum ste/ nyams su len pa'i rten gang zag ngos bzung ba dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rnam par bzhag pa dang*/ theg pa'i rnam par bzhag pa'o// dang po la bzhi ste/ dal 'byor don yod pa bya ba'i phyir/ rnyed dka' zhing don che bar bsam pa dang*/ tshe 'di la mi zhen par bya ba'i phyir/ de nyid mi rtag par shes par bya ba dang*/ 'khor ba bde sdug dge sdog la rag las phyir/ las 'bras bsten pa dang*/ nges 'byung gis blo skyed pa'i phyir/ zag pa dang bcas thams cad sdug bsngal du shes par bya'o// dang po ni/ spyod 'jug las/ dal 'byor 'di ni rnyed pa shin tu dka'// skyes bus don 'grub thob par gyur pa la// gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrub na// phyis nas yang dag 'byor pa ga la 'gyur// zhes

147)gsungs pas/ dal 'byor ni/ mi khom pa brgyad dang bral bas dal ba yin te/ mdzod las/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang*// kla klo tshe ring lha dang ni// log sta sangs rgyas kyis stong pa// lkugs pa 'di dag mi khom brgyad/ ces gsungs so// 'byor pa la gnyis te/ rang 'byor dang*/ gzhan 'byor ro// dang po ni/ mdzod las/ mi nyid dbus skyes dbang po tshang*// las mtha' ma log gnas la dad// ces pa dang*/ mi lus thob pa dang*/ dbang po tshang ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa la dad pas gnas la dad pa dang*/ log lta ma skyes pa dang*/ las kyi mtha' ma log pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas byon dang des chos gsungs// bstan pa gnas dang de rjes 'jug /mkhas po slob dpon sbyin bdag bcas// gzhan phyir snying brtse yod 148)pa'o// ces pas/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa dang*/ des bstan pa dam chos gsungs pa dang*/ bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa dang*/ rang nyid de'i bstan pa la 'jug pa dang*// gzhan gyis phyir snying brtse yod pa rnams rang 'byor lnga dang mi khom pa brgyad spang pa ngo bo gcig ste/ mi lus thob pa dang mi ma yin gyis 'gro ba bzhi spang pa ngo bo gcig gnas la dad pa dang zhing stong par ma skyes pa ngo bo gcig yul dbus su skyes pa dang kla klo ma skyes pa gcig la/ dbang po tshang ba dang lkugs par ma skyes pa gnyis gcig cing*/ las kyi mtha' ma log pa dang*/ log par lta ba spang pa gcig pas/ dal 'byor ngo bo gcig pa yin no// 'on kyang dal ba ni bral ba'i cha yin la/ 'byor pa ni ldan pa'i cha yin pas ldog pa tha dad pa yin te/ de lta bu'i dal 'byor rnyed pa dka' ba ste/ gang la rnyed par 149)dka' na mi khom pa'i gnas las rnyed par dka' ste/ spyod 'jug las/ ngan song las ni mi nyid thob par dka' gsungs/ ces gsungs so// rgyu gang gis rnyed dka' na/ dge ba phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu las byung ba yin la/

mi khem pa'i gnas ni/ dge ba byed pa'i skabs med pas/ 'bras bu dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba'o// bshes springs las/ rgya mtsho gcig na gnya' shing bu ga dang*// rus sbal phrad pa bas kyang ngan song las// mi nyid ches thob dka' bas mi dbang gis// dam chos spyad pas de 'bras mchis par mdzod/ ces dang*/ mdo las/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba rgya lam rnyed par dka'// mi rnyed pa yang shin tu dka' ba ste// grogs po gang dag dad pa'i chos nyan pa// 'di 'dra skal pa brgyar yang rnyed mi 'gyur/ zhes gsungs so// don che ba 150)ni/ mngon par mtho ba lha mi'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ nges par legs pa byang chub rnam pa gsum yang*/ dal 'byor la brten nas 'byung ba las/ gzhan gyis ma yinas don che ba ste/ slob springs las/ gang zag zhig thob nas 'gro ba'i rgya mtsho mthar phyin cing*// byang chub mchog gis sa thob dge bas krun gyur pa// yid bzhin nor bu bas kyang yon tan lhag pa yis// mi rnyed de ni su zhig 'bras bu med par byed// ces pa bzhin no// gnyis pa mi rtag pa'i tshul ni/ thob pa'i dal 'byor yun ring mi rtag ste// 'chi ba'i rkyen ni mang bas nam 'chi cha med la// gson pa'i rkyen ni ches nyung bas// de nyid kyang 'chi rkyen du 'gyur srid de/ klu sgrub kyis/ 'chi ba'i rkyen ni mang ba ste// gson pa'i rkyen ni cung zad tsam// de dag nyid kyang 'chi ba'i rkyen// de bas rtag tu 151)chos mdzod cig /ces pas/ de yang nyin zhag la sogs par ltos pa med par myur du mdzad pa ste/ spyod 'jug las/ nyin mtshan sdod par yongs med pas// tshe 'di skad cig 'gog gyur cing*// bsnan pa rgud na yod med na// bdag lta 'chi bar cis mi 'gyur// ces dang*/ slob sbrings las/ mi'i dbang po gang gis nub mo nas// mngal du zhugs te rab tu 'jug gyur pa// de nas bzung ste de ni nyin re bzhin// 'gro shul med par 'chi bdag gzhan du 'gro/

ces pas/ skad cig ma re re 'gag chig 'chi ba la nye bas/ dper na gsod sar khrid pa'i mi bzhin no// de ltar tshe thung la myur du mdzad pa de yang*/ tshe la mthar phyin pa nyung ba ste/ blo bur du 'chi ba'i rkyen bsam gyis mi khyabs pas/ lo phyi ma dang zla ba phyi ma'am/ mtha' ma nyin zhag gnyis sdod pa'i nges pa med de/ slob springs 152)las/ 'di ni sang bya 'di ni thang gcig 'og tu bya// 'di ni de'i ring bya zhes skye bos bsam pa la// gshin rje be con zhags thogs zur gyis lta ba yin// mig rtsa dmar 'khros ma rangs gad mo re snyams 'debs// ces dang*/ zhi ba lhas/ yid rten mi rung 'chi bdag ni/ byas dang ma byas mi sdod pa// na dang mi na kun gyis kyang*// blo bur tshe la yid mi rten// zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ sang tsam shi'am sus shes kyis// de ring nyid nas btud de bya// 'chi bdag dregs can de dag ni// bdag dang bshes pa ma yin no// 'di 'dra'i dal 'byor rnyed gyur nas// bdag gis dge sgom ma byas na// 'di las slu ba gzhan med pa// 'di las rmongs pa gzhan med do/ ces dang*/ myur ba nyid du 'chi 'gyur pas// ci srid du ni 'tsho bsags bya// de tshe le lo spangs kyang 'di// dus ma yin pa ci zhig bya/ 153)/ces pas/ de yang rang nyid 'chi ba'i tshe/ gnyen bshes la sogs gang gis mi phan la/ bdag nyid mya ngan gyis gdung zhing 'chi ba 'gyur te/ spyod 'jug las/ bdag nyid man na 'dug bzhin du// gnyen bshes kun gyis mtha' bskor yang*// srog chad pa yi tsher ba dag /bdag nyid gcig pos myong bar 'gyur// gshin rje'i pho nyas zin pa la// gnyen pas cis phan gshes cis phan// de tshe bsod nams gcig skyabs na// de yang dbag gis ma bstan no// ces gsungs so// mi rtag pa bhai nas tshe 'di la ma zhen par bya'o// gsum pa las 'bras la gnyis te/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ bye brag tu bshad pa'o// rnam par dkar ba dang*/

nag pa dang*/ 'dres ma'i las gsum gyis go rims bzhin du/ 'bras bu bde ba dang*/ sdug bsngal dang*/ bde sdug 'dres mar 154)myong bar gsungs la/ yang sbyor ba dkar la bsam pa nag pa'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig tu myongs shing*/ sbyor ba nag la bsam pa dkar ba'i 'bras bu bde ba myong bar gsungs/ yang byas la bsags pa'i las ni/ nyon mongs pa'am/ dad pa log pas mi dge ba dang*/ dge ba la sbyor ba yin la/ byas la ma bsags pa'i las ni/ kun slong dge ba'i bsam pa med pa'i bzlas brjod la sogs pa dang*/ bsod nams sems med pa'i bya ba pha rol shi ba la sogs pa'o// ma byas la bsags pa'i las ni/ gzhan gyis dge ba dang mi dge ba la rjes su yi rang bya ba'o/ zhes gsungs so// yang las la gsum ste/ mthong ba'i chos la myong ba 'gyur ba dang*/ skyes nas myong ba 'gyur ba dang*/ lan grangs gzhan du myong bar 'gyur ba'o// dang po ni/ zhing sam phul byung la bsam pa phul byung gis/ dngos po phul byung gcig spyad nas 'bras 155)/bu de nyid la 'byung ste/ mdzod las/ zhing dang bsam gyis mi khyabs pa'i khyad par gyis/ mthong chos 'bras bu can gyis las/ ces dang*/ de nyid las/ gang dag 'gog lam nyon mongs med// mthong dang dgra bcom 'bras lang ba// de la phan gnod byas pa yi// 'bras bu 'phral du myong bar 'gyur/ ces so// skyes nas myong ba 'gyur pa ni// mtshams med pa rnams dang*/ tshul khrims 'chal pa la sogs pa'i las sdig tshe phyi ma nges par smin 'gyur te/ de nyid las/ sdig pa'i las rnams bgyis pa gang yang ni/ de'i mdo la mtshon bzhin mi gcod de/ 'chi ba'i dus las bab pa gyur pas na// las kyi 'bras bu gang lags mngon du 'gyur// ces so// mtshams med pa mang po byas pa dag kyang*/ lus ci phan te/ sdug bsngal tshor ba mi zad pa mang du myong bar gsungs pa'o/ 156)mthong ba'i chos dang*/ skyes nas myong ba'i chos rnams ni// thog mar brtsams pa yin gyis/

des 'bral ba ma yin te/ dmyal ba la yang nas yang du tshe 'phos zhing skyes pas rnam par smin pa myong bar gsungs so// gzhan ma de dag ni tshe thal nas/ myong ba thams cad lan grangs gzhan las myong ba yin te/ lung las/ lus can bdag gis las rnams ni// skal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ tshogs shig dus la bab pas na// 'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ ces so// gzhan yang*/ byed pa dang*/ mngon par zhen nas 'jug pa dang*/ gnyen po dang ma 'brel ba dang*/ zhing yon tan dang ldan pa dang*/ lus nar son te kun slong rtag pos kyang stobs dang ldan pa yin te/ klu sgrub kyis/ rtag tu mngon par zhen dang gnyen po med// yon tan rtsol ldan gzhi las 'byung de ni// dge 157)dang mi dge rnam lnga chen po ste// de bas dge ba spyad la brtson par gyis/ ces so// gnyis pa/ las 'bras bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis te/ mi dge ba'i rgyu dang*/ dge ba'i rgyu'o// dang po la gnyis te/ de'i rgyu dang 'bras bu'o// dang po la gnyis las/ mi dge ba bcu dang*/ mtshams med pa la sogs sdig lci ba gzhan gyis rnam bzhag go /dang po la gsum ste/ mtshan nyid/ sgra don/ mtshan gzhi'o// mi dge ba las kyi mtshan nyid ni/ nyon mongs dug lnga dug gsum gyis bsdus pa'i bya ba sdug bsngal gyis bsdus pa'i bya ba sdug bsngal gyis nyer len du 'gyur ba'o// klu sgrub kyis/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// de skyed la ni mi dge ba'o// ces dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ mi dge ba la sdug bsngal 'byung*/ zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ 'di phyi mi shes pas mi dge ba dang*/ sgo gsum gyi 158)bya ba yin pas las dang*/ ngan 'gro'i rgyu yin pas lam zhes bya'o// mtshan gzhi la gsum ste/ yan lag rtsa ba dang*/ lci yang gis bye brag go /dang po srog gcod pa ni/ yan lag bzhis rdzogs par 'gyur te/ sems can yin pa dang*/ der shes shing bsam pa dang*/

sbyor ba byas pa dang*/ rjes su mthun pa'i tshor ba myong ba dang des shi ba ste bzhi'o// ma byin len pa ni/ gzhan gyis yin zhing de dag tu bzung ba dang*/ der shis shing blang par bsam pa dang*/ sbyor ba byas pa dang*/ gnas nas dpag pa'o// 'dod pa log par g.yems pa ni/ gnas dang*/ dus dang*/ yan lag dang*/ bsgrod bya ma yin pa dang*/ reg la reg tu shes pa dang*/ sbyor ba byas pa dang*/ rjes su mthun pa'i tshor bas myong ba'o// de la gnas ma yin pa ni/ pha ma dang*/ bla ma dang*/ mchod rten gyis drung dang*/ 159)/dkon mchog bzhugs pa'i gnas so// dus ma yin pa ni/ bsnyen gnas la gnas pa dang*/ na ba dang*/ sbrum ma dang*/ bu btsas pa dang*/ zla mtshan dang ldan pa dang*/ mi mos shing yid mi bde ba'o// yan lag ma yin pa ni/ kha dang shangs lam la sogs pa bud med kyis dbang po las bzhan pa thams cad do// bsgrod bya ma yin pa ni/ sdom pa can dang*/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang ldan pa dang*/ gzhan gyis bdag gir bzung ba dang*/ rang gis bdun brgyud las mi ring ba'i nye du dang*/ bud med dang khyo phyogs kyis nye dus srungs ba dang*/ rigs dang yon tan gyis srung zhing*/ dud 'gro dang*/ gzhan don che bas spyad mi bzod pa'o// rdzun du smra ba ni/ don ma nor ba khong du chud pa dang*/ 'du shes gzhan du bsgyur ba dang*/ legs par smra ba dang*/ gzhan gyis go ba'o/ 160)/phra ma ni/ gzhi sems can yin pa dang*/ dbye bar 'dod pa dang*/ dbyen tshig smra ba dang*/ des dbye ba ste bzhi'o// tshig rtsub ni/ gzhi sems can dang*/ smra bar 'dod pa dang*/ tshig tu smra ba dang*/ gzhan la phog pa'o// ngag 'khyal ni/ gzhi sems can dang*/ smra ba la chags pa dang*/ cal col smra ba dang*/ dge dga' pas so// brnab sems ni/ gzhan gyis yin zhing der shes pa dang*/ bdag gis bya bar nges pa'o// gnod sems ni/ gzhi sems can yin pa dang*/ de la gnod pa bya bar nges pa'o// log par lta ba ni/

don phyin ci ma log par gnas pa dang*/ bsam pa phyin ci log tu nges pa'o// yan lag ma rdzogs na sdig pa byas pa 'gyur gyis/ rdzogs par mi 'gyur ro// gal te chags sdang dang*/ brnab sems dang*/ gnod sems la khyad par yod par ma mthong la/ 161)/med na yang nyon mongs pa dang las sam/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i kyad par med par 'gyur ro/ zhes na/ khyad par yod de/ chags sdang bsam yang yin la/ 'di nyid bsam sbyor 'tshogs pa'i phyir ro// de ltar chags pas gud nas blangs nas/ gzhan gyis yo byad bdag gir bya bar sems na brnab sems yin pas/ zhe sdang gis gud nas blang nas gzhan la gnod pa bya bar sems na gnod sems yin te/ snga ma ni bsam rkyang yin la/ 'di ni bsam sbyor 'tshogs pa yin te/ gti mug gis gdud nas blang nas/ skye ba snga phyi la sogs med nges bsnyam pa'o// gnyis pa lci yang gis bye brag gnyis te las/ ngo bo'i sgo nas lci yang ni/ yid lus ngag gsum go rim nas lci la/ yid kyi log lta nas rim gyis lci zhing*/ lus kyis 162)srog gcan na lci la/ ngag gis rdzun lci'o// gnyis pa yid kyis sgo nas lci yang ni/ yul mchog tu gyur pa la mi dge ba gang byas kyang lci la/ 'bring dang dman pa rnams la rim gyis kyang ngo*// gsum pa kun slong gis sgo nas lci yang ni/ nyon mongs pa rags po kun nas slangs nas lci zhing*/ chung ngus kun nas slang ba rnams kyang la/ nyon mongs pa'am zhe sdang gis kun nas slangs pa rnams lci la/ 'dod chags dang gti mug gis slangs pa rnams rim gyis kyang ngo*// bzhi pa lan grangs kyis sgo nas lci yang ni/ mi dge ba gang yang rung ba grangs mang du spyad pa rnams lci la/ nyung ngu spyad pa rnams kyang ngo*// gsum pa gang na yod bsam pa ni/ dmyal ba na tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal gnod sems gsum yod de/ dmyal srung la tshig ngan brjod pa dang*/ sdug glu'i smre ngag dang*/ gcig la gcig zhe sdang

163)yod pa'i phyir ro// gzhan du med do// las ma zad par bsdad bas mi 'chi ba'o// yid du 'ong ba'i dngos po gang yang med pa dang*/ lus rgud cing sdug bsngal gyis bzir ba dang*/ 'dod pa'i don thob rgyu med pa dang*/ mdza'o su yang med pa dang*/ chags gnas ci yang med pa dang*/ las kyi me long la las 'bras mthong ba dran pa'i phyir ro// sgra mi snyan pa ngag 'khyal yod de/ chags pas glu len par bshad do// dgu pa mngon gyur med de/ rim pa ltar tshe nges pas bsad pas mi 'chi ba dang*/ rdzas dang bud med la bdag bzung med pa dang*/ rdzun dang phra ma tshig rtsub gsum smras pa la dgos pa med pa dang*/ longs spyod la bdag 'dzin med pa dang*/ sems kun nas nyon mngos pa can ma yin pa dang*/ yang dag pa'i lta ba med pa'i phyir ro// gzhan nam 164)gling gsum pa'i mi rnams dang*/ 'dod khams kyis lha dang*/ yi dwags dang dud 'gro la bcu ka yod pa yin no// khams gong ma gnyis la/ mngon 'gyur gang yang med do// 'dod shis phyin las/ 'dod pas dbye na/ sdig to mi dge ba'i chos dbyen zhes pas so// gnyis pa mtshams med pa lnga ni/ pha dang ma dang dgra bcom pa bsad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la ngan sems kyis khrag 'byin pa/ dge 'dun gyis dbyen no// de dang nye ba lnga ni/ pha bsad pa dang nye ba byang chub sems dpa' bsad pa/ ma bsad pa dang*/ nye ba dge slong ma dbang med du khrims dang 'phral ba/ dgra bcom pa bsad pa dang nye ba 'phags slob pa bsad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la ngan sems kyis khrag 'byin pa dang nye ba/ mchod rten gshig pa/ dbyen byed pa dang nye ba dge 'dun gyis sgo 165)'phrog pa'o// 'di dag yan lag tshang na der 'gyur gyis// ma tshang na mtshams med du mi myur ba bshad do/ arya dhe bas/ dge slong rang gis pha rgan la// myur 'dong zhes ni skul gyur na// phul bas de ni shi gyur yang*// mtshams med 'gyur ba yod ma yin/

zhes pa bzhin no// de las gzhan nam sdig pa lci ba ni/ dam pa'i chos spang ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba'i bar chad byas pa dang*/ byang chub sems la brnyes pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum dang*/ rang gi bla ma dang*/ pha ma la ma gus pa rnams kyang sdig lci bar gsungs so// gzhan log pa'i 'tsho ba rnams kyang lci bar gsungs te/ mdo las/ kha bsags gzhogs slong thob phyir 'jal// snyed pas snyed pa tshol ba lnga// ma dag pa yi 'tsho ba ste/ ces dang*/ rin chen 'phreng ba las/ tshul chos 166)snyed dang bkur sti'i phyir// dbang po bsdams par byed pa ste/ kha bsags snyed dang bkur sti'i phyir// tshig 'jam sngar ni smra ba'o// gzhogs slongs de ni thob bya'i phyir// gzhan gyis rdzas la sngags byed pa'o// thob phyir 'jal ba snyed pa'i phyir// mngon sum gzhan la smod byed pa'o// snyed pas snyed pa slab 'dod pa// snga ma thob la sngags byed pa'o/ zhes pas/ mi dge ba cher spyad pas dmyal ba/ 'bring gis yi dwags/ chung ngus dud 'gro skye'o// dmyal ba ni/ mdzod las/ 'di 'og stong phrag nyi shu na// mnar med po yang de tsam mo// de'i steng na dmyal ba bdun/ brgyad po kun la lhag bcu drug /de dag gis ni ngos 167)bzhi la// me mar mur dang ro myags 'dam// yi dwags lam sogs thal tshan chu// chu bur can sogs bgrang brgyad bzhin/ zhes pas/ 'dzam gling 'di'i mtsho ma dros pa'i 'og na/ tsha ba'i dmyal ba brgyad rim pa bzhin du yod de/ thog mar yang sos ni/ me dang dmyal srung gis sdug bsngal med pa/ phan tshul rngon pa ri dgas mthong ba lta bur gsod pa'i sems su 'gyur zhing lag tu blang ba thams cad mtshon cha sna tshogs par 'gyur nas/ gcig gis gcig la rgyab ste gsod par byed/ yang sos par gyur cig gis byung nas snga ma bzhin du 'tsho/ yang 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal mi'i nyin zhag gcig la lan brgya'i bar du 'tsho// rta dbyangs nyer bzhag chung ngu las/

phan tshun 'khon zhing zhe gnod la// mi gang mi ni gsod pa dang*// gzhan nam skyes nas gsod byed 168)pa// de dag nges par ngan song 'gro// gang gis phyir ni lo stong phrag /yang sos yang sos de dag tu// bsad cing bsad cing yang 'tsho bas// de phyir yang sos yang sos zhes bya'o// ces so// de'i 'og na thig na ni/ dmyal ba'i lus la dmyal bsrung gis thig nag po btab nas spyi bo dag rmang mthil bar du sog les dra zhing stod pa'i tshe smad 'byar la/ smad dra ba'i tshe stod 'byar la/ de ltar yang yang byas pa'i sdug bsngal myong ste/ de nyid las/ bya men byed du 'jug pa dang*// mi rnams 'ja'o byed byed pa'i// phra ma rdzun smra ru byed pas// thig nag tu ni 'gro bar 'gyur/ zhes so// de'i 'og tu bsdus 'joms ni/ ri rab lug gis gdong pa lta bu gnyis kyi bar du ltems nas/ thim gyi 'gro// phyir khyad song ba dang*/ snga ma bzhin du 'gro// de ltar yang yang bsdus shing 'joms pa dang*/ yang lcags kyis gshongs 169)chen por dmyal ba rnams bsdus shing*/ tho ba me 'bar bas 'joms pa'i sdug bsngal dmyong ste/ de nyid las/ rig dwags phag dang bya nag dang*// gzhan nam skyes gnas gsod byas rnams// lus can bsdus 'joms 'gro bar 'gyur/ zhes so/ du 'bod ni/ lcags kyis khang pa dram mig lta bu me 'bar ba'i nang du bsregs pa dang*/ dra mig na las la grub pa'i bya dang*/ khyi dang sbrul la sogs pa/ srog chags mang pos gnod pa byas nas nyams 'thag pa'i sgra 'byin te/ de nyid las/ gzhan bslu g.yo dang rgyu byed cing*// skye bo dag ni yid phyung pa// 'jigs su rung ba'i sgra 'byin pa// yun ring du 'bod bsregs par 'gyur/ ces so/ du 'bod chen po ni/ lcags kyis khang pa'i nang du bsregs pa dang*/ lnga ma ltar srog chags rnams kyis gnod pa byed cing*/ sdug 170)bsngal dmyong nas sgra chen po 'byin te/

de nyid las/ gag gis lha dang bram ze dang*// bla ma'i rdzas la 'phrog sdul byas// gang dag snyems pas 'phrogs byed pa// de dag tu 'bod chen por 'gro/ ces so// tsha ba ni/ lcags kyis khang pa me 'bar ba'i nang du bsregs pa dang*/ gshin rje'i las mkhan rnams kyis/ lcags zangs dpag med du ma yod pa/ tsha zhing 'bar ba'i nang du bcug nas skol te/ lcags kyis gsal zhing me 'bar ba rtse gcig pa/ lus kyi bshang lam nas gtsugs nas spyi bor 'byin pa'i sdug bsngal dmyong ste/ de nyid las/ dge sbyong bram ze dge ba dang*// de ni gang zag gis pha ma la// gnod pa drag pos gnod byed pa// de ni tsha ba rab tu bsregs/ ces so// rab tu tsha ba ni/ lcags kyis khang pa me 'bar ba gnyis rim gyis nang du 171)bsregs pa dang*/ lcags kyis gsal zhing rtse gsum pas lus kyis bshang lam nas gtsugs nas/ spyi bo dang phrag pa gnyis su 'byin pa dang*/ lcags leb mo tsha zhing 'bar bas lus thams cad dkris pa dang*/ lcags zangs chen mo'i nang du 'gyur med kyis bskol pa dang*/ kun tu 'bar ba'i nang du spyi bo nas 'jug go /sha dang lpags pa zhig nas keng rus 'bigs lus pa de tshi phyir 'byung zhing*/ lcags kyis sa gzhi la 'grams nas/ sha dang khrag lpags pa skyes nas/ yang nang du 'jug par byed/ de lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong ste/ de nyid las/ med par lta ba gang dag gis// chos dang chon min log ston cing*// skye bo dam pa dag la sdang*/ de ni rab tu tsha bar bsreg ces so// mnar med ni/ lcags kyis khang pa ngos re la dpag tshang nyis stong yod pa'i gru bzhi'i nang 172)du bsregs te/ de yang*/ phyogs bzhi/ mtshams brgyad/ steng 'og gnyis/ rang lus me 'bar ba ste/ mnar med me'i phung po bcu gcig tu 'bar zhing bsregs la/ mdor na khang pa de'i nang du me dang sems cab dbyer mi phyed pas/ skad 'byin pas sems can du ma mngon par zad do// sdug bsngal ba tshad med cing*/

dmyal ba gong ma'i sdug bsngal thams cad tshang bar yod de/ de nyid las/ yon tan dag gis che ba las// gnod pa drag po byas pa'am// pha ma bla ma bsad byas nas// nges par skal pa mnar med 'gro// gang phyir bde ba'i skabs med phyir// de phyir mnar med yin par bshad/ ces so// dus mtha'i me bas dmyal ba'i me bdun 'gyur gyis tsha zhing*/ de yang rim gyis 'og ma rnams bzhi 'gyur gyis tsha bar bshad la/ sdug bsngal de dag kyang mtshon pa tsam te/ shin tu mang ba dran pa nyer 173)bzhag nas bshad do// tsha dmyal brgyad po de dag re re bzhin/ 'khor lhag ma bcu drug yod de/ de nyid las/ de ltar de dag dmyal ba ni// brgyad ces bya ba rgal ba dka'// drag po'i las kyis kun tu gang*// re re la'ang lhag bcu drug /ces so/ mnar med de'i ngos bzi'i sdug bsngal gyis las zad pa dang*/ shar sgo lta bu nas mthon te phyin pa dang*/ me ma mur gyis 'obs ni/ dong me 'bar bas gang ba'i 'obs/ pus mo nub tsam phyogs bzhir bar mtshams med par skor nas yod pa 'bod cing rgam nas 'gro ba'i tshe/ rkang pa'i sha bsregs te dmar ngar gyis 'gro// rkang pa btegs pa dag sha slar skye ba/ de lta bu la 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal yod de/ de nyid las/ gang zag gi brngugs bzang mnos nas/ legs par bsrung ba mi byed na// de ni nges par sha dang rus// 'jig pa'i me ma mur du bsregs/ 174)ces tso// de'i phyi rol na ro myags kyis 'dam zhes pa/ mi gtsang ba shin tu dri mi zhim pas gang ba'i 'dams rdza ba rked pa nub pa tsam la 'gro bas na/ srin bu mchu rnon zhes pa lcags kyis mchu can dag gis lus sang sing 'bigs par byed do// de nyid las/ gang du 'tsho ba log pa yi// cung zad tsam cig 'tsho byed pa/ de dag skyag 'dzim nub 'gyur cing*// srin bu rnams kyis za bar 'gyur// ces so// mtshon cha'i skor ma gsum la/ spu gri gtams pa'i lam zhes pa/

spu gri rnon po kha gyen la bltas pa'i thang la 'gro ba'i tshe/ rkang pa'i sha rus gcod par byed// de nyid las/ gang zhig chos kyis rtags 'dzin cing*// yang dag ma yin lam smra ba'i// mi dge bas ni spu gri'i so// gtams pa lam la 'gro bar 'gyur/ ces so// ral gri lo ma'i nags tshal zhes pa/ nags kyis lo ma ral gri 'bar 175)bar 'gyur pa rnams/ lhung nas lus dum bur phye mar byed pa dang*/ des ma bzod nas phyin na/ khyi sre bo lcags kyis mche ba can gyis/ rbad cing za ba'i sdug bsngal myong ste/ de nyid las/ bag phebs pa la gnod byed cing*// nags tshal ral gri'i 'dab can gyis// btubs te ngu zhing bya rog khyi// 'ug pa bya rog za bar 'gyur/ ces so// der ma bzod par phyin pas shal ma ri'i sdong po lcags kyis tsher ma sor bcu drug tsam la 'dzeg ste/ yar 'gro ba'i tshe tsher ma kha thur du bltas te/ sha dum bur dum bur gcod de// rtse mor phyin pa na bya kha da 'dabs 'jig ces pas/ mgo ltoms te glad pa za bar byed/ yang thur la 'bab pa na tsher ma gyen la ltas te 'bigs par byed de/ de nyid las/ byi po byas nas shal ma rir// lcags kyis tsher ma rtse mo 'bar// so ni bcu drug 176)yod pa la// ngu zhing stobs kyis 'dzeg par 'gyur// ces so// de gsum mtshon char gcig pas gcig tu rtsi'o// de'i phyi rol na thal tshan gyis chu bo rab med pa/ thal skyol khol mas gang ba rab med pa la lus ril nub pas/ sha rnams chos shing rus pa skya zang gis 'gro ba dang*/ phyogs kun skor ba la rgal dgos pa'i sdug bsngal yod/ de nyid las/ chu skyar nya mo bsad pa na// chu bo rab med 'bar ba yis// zungs kyi khu ba chur 'gyur zhing*// mi de mes kyang bsregs par 'gyur// ces so// de lta bzhi las med kyang*/ khang pa'i sgo phyogs kyis bcu drug tu rtsi'o// lhag ma de dag tu dmyal bsrungs lag na mtshon cha sna tshogs te/

skra dngas shing 'bar ba a ba glang mgo dang*/ raksha phag mgo dang*/ sdig pa sbrul mgo dang*/ rngam pa dom mgo la sogs pa rnams kyis/ dbang med du zlog par byed do// gzhan yang sor 177)mod shig la sogs pa bsad na/ de nyid las/ de dag lus ni cher 'gyur la// stong brgyad yang dang yang du ni// brag dkar po yis 'joms par 'gyur/ ces dang*/ 'bras bu'i nang na 'khod pa yi// srog chags mthong nas 'joms pa gang*// de ni lcags kyis gtun zhing gis// yang nas yang du brdung bar 'gyur/ ces so// grang dmyal brgyad kyis gnas ni/ tsha dmyal nas dpag tshad khri gzhal ba'i byang phyon na yod de/ grang ces bas lus chu bur byung ba dang*/ shin tu grang che bas chu bur rdol ba dang*/ smre ngag la a chu zer ba dang*/ kyi hud zer ba dang*/ skad 'byin mi nus pas so tham tham pa dang*/ lpags pa'i mdog sngon por 'gyur zhing lus lnga'am drug tsam du gas pa dang*/ utpal ltar gas pa dang*/ lpags pa'i mdog dmar por song zhing*/ kha bcu'am de las lhag 178)par gas pas pad ma ltar gas pa dang*/ lus ser ka gting ring po sha dum bu du mar chad la khad du mar gas pa/ pad ma ltar cher gas pa'o/ de dag tu skyes pa'i rgyu ni/ chos 'chad pa'i 'du khang bshig pa dang*/ bla ma dang*/ chos kyis na bza' bshus pa dang*/ 'phags pa la bskur pa btab pa la sogs yin gsungs so// nye tshe ba'i dmyal ba rnams ni/ rang gis lus la rang gis las kyi sdug bsngal myog ba mdo sde dag las ci kad bshad pa ste/ gro zhun skyes pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa las bshad pa lta bu'o// de rnams kyis tshe tshad ni/ mi lo lnga bcu dang*/ brgya dang*/ nyis brgya dang*/ bzhi brgya dang*/ brgyad brgya dang*/ stong drug brgya ni go rim bzhin du/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi/ sum cu rtsa gsum/ 'thab bral/ dga' ldan/ 'phrul dga'/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyis bar gyis nyin zhag re re yin la/ de rtsis pa'i rang lo brgya/

179)lnga brgya/ stong*/ nyis stong*/ bzhi stong*/ brgyad stong*/ khri drug stong gis/ rgyal chen bzhi nas gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyis bar gyis rang rang gis tshe tshad yin te/ mdzod las/ mi rnams lo ni lnga bcu yin// 'dod pa dag gis nyin zhag gcig /lha rnams 'og ma de dag gis// des na tshe lo lnga brgya'o/ ces pas/ de rnams kyang go rim bzhin du/ yag sos dang*/ thig nag dang*/ bsdus 'joms dang*/ du 'bod dang*/ du 'bod chen po/ tsha ba/ rab tu tsha ba'i bar/ rang rang gis nyin zhag re re yin la/ de rtsis pa'i rang lo brgya dang*/ ces pas/ de rnams go rim bzhin du/ stong dang*/ nyis stong dang*/ bzhi stong*/ brgyad stong*/ khri drug stong*/ yang sos nas tsha ba'i bar gyis rang rang gis tshe tshad yin no// de la dmyal ba yango sa kyi zhag gcig ni/ mi lo sa ya phrag dgu yin te/ mdzod 180)las/ yang sos la sogs drug rim bzhin// 'dod lha'i tshe dang nyin zhag mnyam/ de sani de dag rnams kyis tshe/ 'dod pa'i lha dang mnyam pa yin/ zhes so// nye tshe nye 'khor pa'i dmyal ba ni nges pa med par gnas so// grang dmyal rnams kyis tshe tshad ni/ ma ga dha'i bres bcal ba'i khal brgyad cu la/ lo brgya re la ril re phyung bas zad pa chu bur can gyis tshe'i tshad yin/ 'og ma de la nyi shu 'gyur du gsungs te/ mdzod las/ til sbyang nas nas lo brgya zhing*// til gcig phyung pas zad gyur pa// chu bur can gyis tshe tshad yin/ 'og ma de la nyi shu 'gyur/ ces so// yi dwags la gnas la gnas pa dang mkha' la rgyu ba gnyis yod de/ dang po ni/ grong khyer yangs pa can gyis 'og /dpag tshad lnga brgya la gnas te// de la phyi'i sgrib pa can dag /bkres shing skom pa lus sdong dum tshig pa ltar/ gdong pa skras kheb cing 181)bzhin mi sdug pa dag /kun tu zas skom tshol ba la rgyugs kyang mi snyed la/ cung zad mthong yang gshin rje lag na mtshon cha thogs pa rnams kyis bsrungs nas longs spyod dbang med pa dang*/

chu dag kyang rnam khrag tu mthong nas btung du mi rung ngo*// nang gis sgrib pa can dag ni/ kha khab kyi mig tsam du zas mi tshud mgrin pa gzhu rgyud tsam du mi thar/ lto ba lung pa tsam mi khengs pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal yod de/ zas skom gyi sgrib pa can ni/ zos pa dang 'thung pa rnams/ lcags kyis tho lum me 'bar bar 'gyur te/ lto ba bsreg par gyur ba dang*/ ljan ljin za ba zhes bya ba ni/ mi gtsang ba rnams za zhing btung bar byed par skye bar bshad de/ rtags dbyangs las/ gang gis byis pa rnams la 'tshe// srid pa 'grib par byed pa de// khong pa'i dri ma za byed pa// lus srul por ni skye bar 'gyur// mi 182)gang spyod pa dman pa dang*// shin tu zhums dang ser sna can// rtag tu 'dod byed de shi nas// yi dwags sna ba can du skye// gang gi ci yang mi ster dang*// sbyin pa zlog par byed pa ste// yi dwags bkres pas btung ma yin// bsus che kha ni khab tsam 'gyur// gang gi spyod dang byin mi byed// rigs kyi don du nor srung na// de ni yi dwags tshun ltor spyod// shi dus bsngo za der skye'o// gang zag gzhan gyis nor 'phrog 'dod// byin nas 'gyod pa byed pa de// shi nas phyi ma'i skyug pa la// za bar byed pa'i yi dwags skye// gang zhig khros nas mi snyan smra// 'tshang 'bru ba ni smra byed pa// las de shin tu yun ring bas// yi dwags kha 'bar skye bar 'gyur// gang zhig 'thab mo byed pa dang*// ma chags pas na khro byed pa// srin dang sdig sbrul phye leb za// de ni yi dwags me 'bar 'gyur/ ces dang*/ zas kyi ched du rtse med pa/ 183)srog chags gsod nas sbyin byed pa// de ni shi nas nges par ni// srin bu'i zla dang bcas par 'gyur// ces pa dang*/ ma rung khro zhing sbyin byed pa// chang zhim bdag la dga' ba'i mi// shi nas gnod sbyin ma rungs pa// chang la dga' ba rnams su skye// sred dang ser sna can gyis ni// shi nas yi dwags de rnams gyur// nyon mongs can dge'i gnod sbyin no// de ni de phyir spangs par bya/

ces so// tshe'i tshad ni/ mi'i zla ba gcig la/ zhag gcig byas pa'i rang lo lnga brgya'o// mi lo khri lnga stong ste/ klu sgrub kyis/ lnga stong dag dang khri yang 'chir mi btub// ces dang*/ dud 'gro la byings la gnas pa dang kha 'thor ba gnyis la/ dang po ni/ phyi'i rgya mtsho'i nang na chang dar ma'i sbang ma tsam yod/ de rnams kyang gcig la gcig za ba'i sdug bsngal 184)dpag tu med cing*/ rgya mtsho'i klu rnams la nyin re la bye tshan gyis char lan bdun bdun babs pa'i sdug bsngal yod/ kha 'thor ba ni/ lha mi'i yul dag na gnas pa rnams te/ de dag la gcig la gcig za ba dang*/ gzhan gyis bkol zhing spyod pa'i sdug bsngal te/ klu sgrub kyis/ de phyir dge ba spangs pa rnams la ni// gcig la gcig za shin tu mi bzod pa// kha cig mu tig bal dang rus pa dang*// sha dang lpags pa'i ched du 'chi bar 'gyur// gzhan dag dbang med lag pas brdeg pa dang*// lcags dang lcags kyus btab pas btab ste bkol/ ces so// de mi dge ba'i las mtha' dag gis/ dud 'gro gang du skyes tshul ni/ rta dbyangs kyis/ 'dod chags kyis ni rmongs pa na// ngang pa phu rol la sogs dang*// bong bu 'dod chags can rnams kyi// skyes gnas srin po'i skyes gnas skyes// khro 185)'khor 'dzin pas sbrul du 'gyur// nga rgyal khengs pa seng ge ru// che ba yi ni nga rgyal gyis// khyi dang bong bu'i skyes gnas skyes// ser sna phrag dog la sogs kyis// skyon gyis lus can shi nas sprel// mu cir smra dang spyi rnal che// rang bzhin mi rtan khar skye'o// gsod dang bcing dang ser sna yis// lus can ba glang khyi la sogs// 'gyur ro mi srun las kyis ni// sdom dang sdig pa mi sdug skye// khro dang ser sna can gyis ni// shi nas sha ni za byed pa// stag dang sprel dang wa dang dom// bya rgod spyang ki la sogs te// mi srun khro zhing sbyin byed mi// sbrul chen po'i klur skye'o// gtong zhing khro dang dregs pa yis// nam mkha' lding gis dbang phyug skyes/

rang gi lus dang ngag yid kyis// sdig pa'i las ni gang byas pa// de ni dud 'gror skye bas na// de ni chung yang ma byed cig /ces so// tshe tshad 186)mdo las/ tshe ni dud 'gro mchog ring skal pa'o/ ces so/ klu kha cig skal pa'i bar gnas la/ gzhan rnams la nges pa med do// rgyu mthun gyis 'bras bu la gnyis las/ byed pa rgyu mthun ni/ tshe rabs gzhan du'o// de dag nyid la goms shi dga' ba'o// gnyis pa myong ba rgyu mthun ni/ mi dge ba bcu rim pa ltar smin te/ rin chen 'phreng ba las/ bsad pa yin ni tshe thung 'gyur// ma byin len pas dbul ba nyid// byi bo byas pas dgra dang bcas// rdzun du smra bas lkugs pa mang*// phra ma yin ni bshed dang 'byed// rtsub mo nyid kyis mi snyan thos// ngag 'khyal pas ni tshig mi btsun// brnam sems yid la re ba 'joms// gnod sems kun tu 'tshe ba nyid// log par lta ba lta ngan nyid// chang 'thung bas ni blo 'khrul te// log par 'tshe bas bslus pa ste// khengs pa yin ni rigs ngan nyid// phrag dog gis ni gzi 'chung zhing*/ 187)khor bas kha dog ngan pa dang*// mkhas la mi dri blun pa nyid// mi nyid la ni 'bras bu ni// kun gyis dang po ngan song ngo*/ ces so// gsum pa dbang gis 'bras bu ni/ phyi'i dngos po mthu chung ba dang*/ 'bras bu dus su mi dman pa dang*/ sad kyis 'khyar ba dang*// nas la sran ma ltar 'gyur ba dang*/ 'bras bu shin ti ba dang*/ zas mi zhim pa dang*/ lo nyes sha stag 'ong ba dang*/ 'bras bu chung ba dang*/ kha zadas lus la gnod pa dang*// rdul 'khrig dri ngan mtho dman dang*// tsha sgo can sogs dus la sogs// 'bras bu phra kha chu dang me// phyi rol dngos po 'gyur ba ni// mi dge bcu'i ldan 'bras yin// zhes so// gnyis pa dge ba'i rgyu la gnyis te/ rgyu ni dge ba bcu yin pas/ 188)'di la gsum/ mtshan nyid/ sgra don/ dbye ba'o// dang po ni/

sems 'byung dge bas gud nas blangs pa'i sgo gsum gyis bya ba 'bras bu dge ba bskyed byed du 'gyur ba ste/ rin chen 'phreng ba las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug med// des bskyed la ni dge ba yin// ces so// gnyis pa ni/ de phyir shes pas dge ba dang*// sgo gsum gyis bya ba yin pa'i las dang*/ bde 'gro'i rgyu yin pa'i lam zhes bya'o// gsum pa sgo gsum gyis mi dge bcu spang ba ni dge ba bcu ste/ rin chen 'phreng ba las/ mi gsod pa dang rku spongs dang*// gzhan gyis chung ma spangs pa dang*// log dang phra ma rtsub nyid dang*// mi 'bral smra ba yan lag gdoms// 'phyes dang gnod sems med pa dang*// nyid kyi lta ba yongs spang pa// 'di dag las lam dkar bcu ste// log pa dag ni nag po yin// chang mi btung dang 'tsho ba bzang*// rnam smin me dang gus sbyin dang*// mchod 'os 189)mchod dang byams pa ste// mdor na chos ni de yin no/ zhes so// gnyis pa 'bras bu la gsum las/ rnam smin ni/ bsod nams cha mthun gyis dge ba chung 'bring che gsum spyad pas/ mi dang lha ma yin dang*/ 'dod khams kyis lha'o// dge bcu'i steng du mi g.yo ba'i las kyi khams gong ma gnyis kyis lhar skye'o// gnyis pa rgyu mthun la'ang gnyis las/ byed pa rgyu mthun ni/ dge ba bcu ngang gis spyod par 'gyur ba'o// gnyis pa myong ba rgyu mthun ni/ dge ba bcu go rim bzhin du tshe ring ba dang*/ longs spyod che ba dang*/ gzhan gyis bskur ba dang*/ bskur ba med dang*/ mdza' bo mang ba dang*/ snyan par thos pa dang*/ tshig btsun pa dang*/ chog shes pa dang*/ gnod pa nyung ba dang*/ yang dag pa'i lta ba 'dzin par 'gyur ro// gsum pa dbang gis 'bras bu ni/ go rim bzhin/ phyi'i dngos po lo thog 190)mthu che ba dang*/ dus smin pa dang*/ gzhan du mi 'gyur ba dang*/ 'bru grung ba dang*/ ro zhim pa dang*/ gtan du lo legs pa dang*/

'bras bu che ba dang*/ lus la phan pa dang*/ rang gis longs spyod par 'gyur ba'o/ ces gsungs so// de la gong du smon pa'i mtho ris kyis rnam par dag pa la gsum te/ mi dang lhar skye ba'i tshul dang*/ snod kyis rnam par dag pa dang*/ bcud kyis rnam par dag pa'o// dang po la gsum te/ mi'i rnam par dag pa dang*/ lha'i rnam par dag pa dang*/ bde 'gro ngan 'gro'i lus dang tshe tshad bstan pa'o// dang po la gsum te/ las sna tshogs kyis mi phal pa dang*/ las khyad par can gyis mtho ris yon tan bdun ldan dang*/ las mchog gis 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po ji ltar 'byung ba'i tshul lo// dang po la/ mi ni gling bzhi gling phran brgyad la gnas pa rnams yin la/ de dag kyang rgyu dge ba stobs che chung 191)gis/ mi dge ba dang 'dres pa'i stobs kyis 'bras bu bzang ngan bsod nams che chung la sogs tha dad du ma 'byung ste/ rta dbyangs kyi/ mi 'tshe ba lha dang 'tshe// lha mi rnams su tshe ring 'gyur/ 'tshe ba'i thung du skye bar 'gyur// de phyir 'tshe ba rnam par spangs// mdze dang rmang bu zad byed rims/ma/mi nad gzhan nam gang dag rims// 'byung po rnams la bsad bcad cing*// brdeg par bya ba rnams kyis 'gyur// gnyis pa mi dge ba dang ma 'dres pa'i bsod nams kyis 'bras bu 'di lta ste/ dkon mchog sprin las/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos bcu dang ldan na/ mngal gyi dri mas ma gos par skye'o// bcu gang/zhe na 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs byed pa dang*/ mchod rten zhig pa bcos pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la spos kyis byug pa phul pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs japa'i mchod rten la spos kyis byug pa phul ba dang*/ de bzhin gshegs 192)pa'i gzugs sku dag las khrus kyis spos chu phul ba dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten dag la phyag dar dang rkyang 'bul byas pa dang*/

pha ma la bkur sti dang rim 'gro byas pa dang*/ mkhan po dang slob dpon dag las lus kyi rim 'gro byas pa dang*/ mtshungs par spyod pa rnams la rim 'gro byed pa dang*/ de/yang zang zing med pa'i sems te/ zang zing dang bcas pa ma yin pa dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yang 'di ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ sems can thams cad la mngal gyis dri mas ma gos par skye bar 'gyur ro/ ces yongs su bsngo zhing bsam pa 'thad pa nas sems pa ste/ rigs kyi bu bcu po 'di dag go ces so// mtho ris yon tan bdun ldan ni/ dam pa'i chos bsgrub pa'i rtane zhun tshogs pa ste/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ tshe ring de bzhin nad med dang*// gzugs dang skal ba de bzhin rigs// nor mang shes rab 193)dag dang ldan// yon tan mdo sde dag las gsungs// ces pas bdun po de dag tshang dgos shing*/ |

re re ma tshang yang nyes pa skyed japa ni/ drug po yod na tshe ring ba med na ni/nabasad ཿpar khrid pa'i mi bzhin du 'gyur/ de bzhin du/ nad med ཿ dang ma ladna na ma ning la bud med chags pa yod pa dang 'dra bar yon tan gzhan longs spyod du med pa dang*/ gzugs bzang ba dang ma ldan na/ gzugs ngan rgyal po'i bu mos mthong ba dang 'dra bar/ don du mi gnyer ba dang*/ skal pa bzang po dang ma ldan na/ drang srong gis bran bzhin du shin tu mnar zhing bsam pa mi grub pa dang*/ rigs bzang po dang ma ldan na drang srong/gis bu mo yon tan can rigs ngan gyis lan na gnas pa ltar/ longs spyod par med na dud khrod na gnas pa'i mi shin tu rang nid zhums shing gzhan gyis brnyes par 'gyur pa dang*/ de bzin du gzhan drung po yod kyang shes rab 194)med na/ chu shing gis 'bras bu dang 'dra bas blun po bdag nyid kyis yon tan thams cad 'joms par 'gyur ro// dbyig gnyen gyis/ de ltar ci skad bshad yon tan// yan lag re re ma tshang nyams// yi ge gcig gis ma tshang bzhin// rig pas 'bras bu med 'gyur mtshungs// yon tan yongs rdzogs mdzes pa ni// yi ge tshangs pa'i rig pa 'dra// de dag la sngon du song ba la 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ste/ dbyig gnyen gyis/ 'id dag rgyu ni gang yin pa// mdo bshad pa la rtogs par gyis// gsod par tshud pa legs btang dang*// de bzhin srog gis phan gdags phyir// srog chags 'tshe ba las dalog pa// tshe ring pas ni thob par 'gyur// nad pa'i bsnyen bkur byas smin pa// sman ni rab tu byin pa dang*// srog chags bung ba dbyig sogs kyis// mi 'tshe bas ni nad med nyid// khro ba med la brten pa dag /brgya byin pas ni gzugs 195)bzang 'gyur// phrag don med pa'i 'bras bu ni// skal pa bzang por yongs su bshad// dam pa mchod cing brnyen bkur bya// nga rgyal spangs pas rig mthor 'gyur// sbyin byed rku ba las logs pas// longs spyod phun tshogs thob par 'gyur// dge dang sdig pa gang yin zhes// yang dag 'di la brtson pa dang*// chos skyis bstan chos byin pa yi// blo gros rgya cher thob par 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa bsod nam mchog gis 'bras bu ni gnyis te/

'khor lo sgyur ba'i rgyal po dang*// stobs kyi rgyal po gnyis las/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po ni/ stong phrag brgyad cu la mi bye zhes pa/ de ba'i lus dang*/ yo byad dang*/ 'dul ba'i skye bo la sogs pa/ brgyad khri man du mi tshogs pa'i phyir/ tshe lo dpag tu med pa nas/ brgyad khri'i bar du 'byung ngo*// 'di ni mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs 196)pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dbang du byas pa yin no// gnyis pa stobs kyis 'khor lo bsgyur ba ni/ tshe lo brgya pa phan chad du'ang 'byung ngo*// dbyes na/ gser/ dngul/ zangs/ lcags kyi 'khor los can dang bzhi'o// gling la dbang byed pa ni/ lcag 'khor can gling gcig /zangs 'khor can gling gnyis/ dngul 'khor can gling gsum/ gser 'khor can gling bzhi kar dbang byed/ de dag gzhal la 'dra zla med pa yin te/ gling gcita tu 'khor lo bsgyur ba gnyis nam yang mi 'byung yin te/ stong gsum gcig tu sangs rgyas gnyis mi 'byung ba bzhin no// g.yul las rgyal bar byed pa ni/ gser 'khor can la gling gsum gyis rgyal phran rnams kyis/ gser gyis gzhongs pa dngul sil mas bkang ba thogs te/ lha tshur byon pa legs so// bdag gis yul 'khor 'byor ba rgyas pa bde ba la sogs legs pa mis gang 197)ba 'di lha nyid kyis phyag gis bzhes shig bdag cag rnams kyis ni lha'i zhabanas 'bring 'gyid do// zhes phar la 'dus pa las/ des kyang*/ khyed rnams nga'i ngag ma bcag par mi dge bcu rgyun chod cig zer te/ dge ba bcu spyad pas/ de'i dus kyis mi phal cher lhar skye'o// sgra mi snya du lo du ma bsda pa tsam la dbang byed kyis/ ces snyed par byed kyis/ de lta bu'i 'dud japa med de/ rje 'bangs dang dge sdig med pa'i phyir ro// dngul gyis 'khor lo can gyis gling gnyis la rang nyid rgyal ldan gyis rtser 'gro zhing bsnyen bkur sngar bzhin byed zangs 'khor can ni/
