gling gnyis su g.yul bshams te/ g.yul 'byin pas sdig ste/ de nas bka' bsgo ba nyan no// lcags 'khor can ni/ 'dzam gling rgyal phran la yang*/ mtshon gyis btab ste/ gsod pas sdig nas/ rgyal zhing bka' bsgo ba nyan no// de ltar mod kyis 198)gsod pa la sogs pa'i gnod pa med do// de dag kyang dge ba bcu la gnas shing*/ gzhan yung bkod pas/ de bzhin du bkod pas/ de bzhin du byung na/ ngan 'gro 'grib cing bde 'gro 'phel ba yin no// mtshan gyis khyad par ni/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan 'khor lo la sogs pa phyag zhabs dbus na gnas pa dang*/ 'od gsal zhing ri mi dod pa dang*/ rtsi bas la sogs pa ma tshangs ba med pas rdzogs pa yin la/ rgyal po la yang yod cing*/ 'od med la ri mo ma dod cing*/ rtsibs ma tshang pas ma rdzogs la/ gsang ba'i gnas su nub pa dang*/ spyi gtsug mthong ba yang med do// gzhan la med pa'i lus dang longs spyod dang ldan te/ lus ni mtshan dpe yin la/ longs spyod ni rin po che nyi shu rtsa gcig yod de/ rin po che sna bdun ni/ brgyad stong 'grel chen las/ mu sa la ka bheḍūrya dngul dang shel dang gser dang ni/ mu tig mar gad rdo rnying dang*/ kun la 199)phan pa'i rin chen bdun/ zhes so// mchog gis rin chen sna bdun la/ 'khor lo rin po che gser la sogs pa la byas pa/ rtsibs stong yod/ mdzes pa/ nam mkha' la dpag tshad dang*/ 'bum du nyi ma gcig gis 'grod par nus shing*/ gling bzhi dang lha ris gnyis su yang de'i mthus/ glang po che la sogs pa thams cad nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang*/ rgyal pos ma po'i bla rtsam la zur brgyad pa ste/ mtshan mo dpag tshad tsam du 'od 'byung la/ nyi ma tsha na 'od sal ba dang*/ lam du skom na chu yan lag brgyad ldan 'byung ba dang*/ rgyal po ci 'dod pa'i dngos po dang 'od sna tshogs 'byung ba dang*/ dpag tshad brgyar nad med cing*/ mi 'dod pa'i 200)byas pa'i las thams cad ci ltar 'dod pa ltar 'bras bu 'byung ba dang*/

klu ngan pas ser ba la sogs phab par mi nus pa dang*/ mya ngan g.yang sa'i yul dang bral ba rnams/ ljon pa dang 'tsho ba la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba dang*/ mi rnams kyang dus ma yin pa mi 'chi zhing*/ dud 'gro mi mthun pa rnams phan tshun mi gnod pa zhig rgyan gyis ster/ btsun mo ni/ lus la tsan dan dang*/ kha nas ud pa la'i dri 'byung ba dang*/ reg na nyon mongs par mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba byed pa dang*/ gling gis bkroms mya ngan dang bral bar byed pa dang*/ mi rnams kyis ma dang srid mo ltar mthong ba dang*/ bud med gzhan la sems phrag dog med pa zhig blon pos ster/ blon po ni/ bya ba rnams la bsgros kyang shes nas byed cing*/ mi dge ba spangs nas nyon mongs ba med pa dang*/ sems can thams cad la pha ma ltar phan pa zhig 201)'byung ngo*// glang po che ni/ cang shes shing bka' nyan la/ pha rol las rgyul bar byed cing*/ glang po che gzhan stong gis stob yod pa dang*/ chu skam sa bar snang gsum la g.yul 'gyed pa dang*/ nyin gcig gcig la gling bzhi lan gsum bskor ba dang*/ skud pas kyang bkriras rung zhing*/ rgyal pos bzhon tshe/ gang du 'jug par bskul mi dgos pa dang*/ dal gyis 'gro ba zhig brgya byin gyis ster ro// rta ni/ rma bya'i mgrin pa ltar sngo ba/ sngar gyis glang po che dang yon tan mchungs pa zhig brgya byin gyis ster ro// de gnyis ni/ rdzogs byed dge ba rdzogs pa'o// khyim bdag ni/ sa 'og gi gter mthong ba dang*/ gser dngul la sagos pas mdzod gang ba dang*/ rgyal po'i bka' nyan cing*/ skye bo thams cad la mi gnod pa zhig 'byung*/ de rnams kyis phyag mtshan dang yo byad rnams ni/ rgyu dge ba bcu cher spyad cing*/ de 202)bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten bzhengs pa dang*/ byams pa bhai pa dang*/ gnod sems spangs pa las 'byung bar bshad do/ gnyis pa lha'i rnam pa la gsum te/ lha ma yin lhar bsdu ba'i 'dod khams kyis lha dang*/

gzugs khams dang*/ gzugs med/ dang po ni/ lha ma yin gyis gnas ni ri rab kyis tshu 'chams man ched stong pa'i nang nas rim bzhin/ lha min gyis dbang po/ sgra gtsan 'dzin dang*/ rab rgod dang*/ 'gul 'phreng dang*/ gser gyis sa gzhi'i steng na thag bzang ris gnas pas 'og ma bzang ngo*// longs spyod lha la 'gran pa ltar yod de/ rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams ni/ ri rab gyis bang rim bzhi dang*/ ri bdun dang*/ nam mkha' la nyi zla gza' skar rnams dang*/ 'khor yug la gos sngon can dang*/ 'dzam gling dag na'ang gnas so// ri rab kyis steng na/ sum cu rtsa bgasum ni/ brgya byin dang nye dbang sum cu rtsa gnyis yod 203)pa'o// ri rab kyis steng gis ngos re re la dpag tshad brgyad khri/ mtha' skor la gsum 'bum nyi khri'o// ri rab kyis zur g.yis lcogs bzhi la/ gnod skyin lag na rdo rje/ gos sngon can gnas so// dbus na spyi bo'i grong khyer yid du 'ong zhing lta na sdug ces pa/ dpag tshad nyis stong lnga brgya la mtha' skor du khir yod pa/ gyen la dpag tshad gnyis 'phags pa la/ ngo bo gser dang rka ba gdung la sogs pa bhaiḍūrya'i rang bzhin/ sa gzhi mtshon sna brgya rtsa brgyad kyis mdzes pa rkang pa bzhag na sor bzhi mnems pa/ bteg na sor bzhir 'phar ba mnyam yod do// phyi skyabs rin po che sna bzhi dang ldan pa/ sgo stong du gcig gi mtshang ba/ sgo re re la bsrung ma lnga brgya dang ka ba drug khri dang*/ lam srang sna tshogs dang*/ rdzing bu la sogs pa du ma yod do// de'i dbus na/ brgya byin gyis pho brang gzhan thams cad 204)zil gyis mnon pa/ rnamapar rgyal ba'i kang bzang zhes bya ste/ ngos re la dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu dang*/ mthaḥ skor du dpag tshad stong yod pa/ lta na sdug las dpag tshad phyed dang lngas gyen la 'phags pa/ rin po che sna bzhi la byas pa'i sgam/ re re la mig khang bdun bdun/ de re re la mdzod mig bdun bdun/

de re re la lha'i bu bdun bdun/ de re re la lha'i bu mo bdun bdun/ de re re la g.yog mo bdun bdun/ de re re la g.yog mo bdun bdun/ de re re la'ang sil snyan bdun bdun yod de/ lta na sdug gis phyi rol dpag tshad nyishu shar na/ shing rta sna tshogs can gyis tshal/ rtsig skyabs dang*/ rdzing dang*/ the ma skas dang*/ zhing dang*/ gos dang*/ brgyan dang*/ bza' btung sna tshogs yod pa dang*/ de'i nang du lha dang lha ma yin dang*/ 'thabs pa la mos par 'gyur bas/ rtsub 'gyur tshal dang*/ nub na lhī bu dang bu mo 'dres par spyod sa/ 'dres pa'i tshal dang*/ byang 205)na yid rab tu zhing zhing*/ dga' bar 'gyur pas dga' ba'i tshal te/ de dag gis rgyan pa'o// lha de dag gi ngos bzhin/ dpag tshad nyi shu gzhal ba'i shar na/ sa gzhi bzang po shing rta can dang*/ lho na rtsub chen dang*/ nub na 'dre pa dang*/ byang na dga' ba zhes bya ba rnams yod do// tshal dang sa gzhi thams cad kyang*/ gser rnams rgyal dang mnyam zhing*/ gser gyi ra ba/ dpag tshad re res skor ba la bar na lam bzang po dang ldan pa la/ lta na sdug gi byang shar mtshams na/ shing yongs su sa 'dul zhes byas ba/ dpag tshad lnga bcu thur la zugs cing*/ gyen la brgya 'phags pa/ yan lag dpag tshad lnga bcur khyab cing*/ phyogs su dpag tshad brgyar dris khyab cing*/ rdzing phyogs ma yin par lnga bcu ldang ngo*/ lta na sdug nas dpag tshad lnga bcu'i lho phyogs na/ brgyad dang 'grims pa chos bzang zes pa zlum 206)por thad khar sum brgya la/ mtha' skor du dgu brgya ba/ gsete gyis ra bas skor ba yod do// a ma li ga zhes pa/ zla ba dkar po lta bu'i rdo leb ros re la lnga bcu pa/ mtshon sna brgya rtsa gcig can rngams sus lhag de'i dbus nas brgya byin gyi gdan dang*/ khor yug la nye dbang gis gdan yod/ brgya byin la dge slong gnyis yod de/ sa bsrungs dang*/ rab brtan/ sa bsrungs ni/ sum cu rtsa gsum gnas la// rab brtan gyis 'dzam bu gling mtsho ma dros par gnas shing*/

de gnyis ka yang*/ me tog ku mud ta ltar dkar ba/ yan lag bdun legs par gnas shing*/ mgo bo dmar ba/ mche ba drug dang ldan zhing*/ srid du dpag tshad phyed gsum yod pa/ zheng du gcig gis tshad dang ldan pa/ mog bo dmar ba/ mche ba drug dang ldan zhing*/ srid du dpag tshad phyed gsum yod pa/ zheng du gcig gis tshad dang ldan pa/ 'khor yug tu bdun gyis 'khor ba/ re re la 'khor glang po che brgya dang ldan no// sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gong du/ nam mkha' 207) la rten pa ni/ lha ma yin dang 'thab dang bral bas/ 'thab bral dang*/ skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams bzhugs shing theg chen gyi chos kyi dga' ba dang ldan pa dang*/ rang gis sprul pa la longs spyod pas na 'phrul dga' dang*/ gzhan gyis sprul pa'am/ thun mong du longs spyod pas gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang*/ 'dod khams kyis lha ris drug po'i tshe tshad ni gong du bshad zin no// gnyis pa gzugs khams ni/ bsam gtan bzhi la/ bsam gtan dang po tshangs ris dang*/ tshangs pa mdun na 'don dang*/ tshangs chen gyis lha dang gsum mo gnyis pa/ 'od chung dang*/ tshad med 'od nga*/ 'od gsal gyi lha dang gsum mo/ gsum pa laḥ/ dge chung dang*/ tshad med dge dang*/ dge rgyas kyis lha dang gsum mo/ bzhi pa la/ sprin 208)med 'od dang*/ bsod nams skye/ 'bras bu che ba dang gsum ni so so'i skye bo'i gnas yin la/ 'phags pa'i gnas ni/ gtsang ma ris kyis lha lnga ni/ mi che ba/ mi gdung ba/ gya noms pa/ mthong ba/ 'og min gyis lha'o// lha tshe ring po zhes bya ba ni/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i 'bras bu che ba'i bye brag grong dang dgon pa'i tshul du yod do// dgra bcom pa thob snyam pa mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas la/ bar do'i snang ba shar bas na/ dgra bcom pa mi bden par snyam na/ log lta skyes nas/ dmyal bar skye bar bshad do// las dang tshe'i tshad ni 'bras bu che ba'i lha dang mtshungs so// gsum pa gzugs med khams la bzhi las/

nam mkha' mthas yas skye mched dang*/ mtha' yas skye mched dang*/ ci yang med pa'i skye mched dang*/ yod min med min srid rtse'o// 'dod khams kyis lha ris drug po rnams/ 209)lha'i bu dang bu mo'i pang du rdzus te skye'o// rigs bzhi nas gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kahayis bar go rim bzhin/ tshe lo brgya'i dus kyis/ byis pa lo lnga dang*/ drug bdun dang*/ brgyad dang*/ dgu dang*/ bcu lon pa rlata/ rgyan dang bcas shing*/ ngo tsha dang khrel med pas gcer bu 'byung ngo*// bskyed drag pas lus myur du rdzogs la/ brgya byin ni/ lus rdzogs shing snga phyi brje ba yang mi/tshor bar bshad do// lha rnams la rgas shing 'khogs pa med do// gzugs khams kyi lha rnams ni/ lung kun rdzogs shing*/ ngo tsha dag khrel yod pas brgyan dang gsos dang bcas pa bskyed la/ pha ma med cing*/ pho mo'i dbang po med kyang skyes pa'i cha byad bzhin no// gsum pa lus dang tshe'i tshad labastan pa la drug ste/ lus tshang dang*/ tshe nges pa dang*/ ma nges pa'i dbye ba dang*/ 'chi tshul dang*/ skye gnas 210)kyis dbye ba dang*/ gnas rigs kyis dbye ba'o// dang po ni/ 'dir bde 'gro dang ngalan 'gro lus kyi tshad ci ltar yin zhes/ 'dzam bu gling gi mi rnams tshe lo brgya'i dus su khru bzhi dang phyed bzhi yin la/ skal pa dang po'i mi rnams lus shin tu che ba/ tshe lo bcu pa na da ltar gyis mtho gang chag gang tsam du 'gyur ro// lus 'phags pa khru brgyad dang*/ ba glang spyod khru bcu drug sgra mi snya sum cu rtsa gnyis so// 'dod khams kyis lha rnams la/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi/ rgyang grags gcig gis bzhi cha dang*/ sum cu rtsa gsum phyed dang*/ 'thab bral cha gsum dang*/ dga' ldan rgyang grags gcig dang*/ 'phrul dga' gcig dang bzhi cha dang*/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed rgyang grags gnyis so// lha ma yin rnams ni su cu rtsa gsum dang mnyam par bshad do// gnyis pa gzugs khams lnga'i lus tshad la/

bsam 211)gtan dang po tshangs ris kyis lus chad la dpag tshad phyed/ 'dun na 'don gcig tshangs che phyed dang gnyis so// bsam gtan gnyis pa 'od chung la gnyis la/ tshad med 'od la bzhi/ 'od gsal la brgyad do// bsam gtan gsum pa'i 'od chung bcu drug tshad med dge sum cu rtsa gnyisa.a dge rgyas la drug cu rtsa bzhi'o// bsam gtan bzhi pa'i sprin med 'od la brgya nyi shu rtsa brgyad las gsum dor bas brgya nyis shu rtsa lnga'o// bsod nams skyes nyis brgya lnga bcu/ 'bras bu che ba lnga brgya'o// gtsang ma rigs kyi lha lnga la/ mi che ba stong stong*/ gya nom snang ba bzhi stong*/ shin tu mthong ba brgyad stong*/ 'og min gyis lus la dpag tshad khri drug stong*/ gzugs med kyi lha la lus med pas tshe tshad med do// ngan song gsum la ni lus tshad med do// mtshams med pa gcig byas pas lus dpag tshad 212)gcig lnga byas pas slanga'i bar du bshad pa dran pa nyer bzhag las so// yang mtshams med pa byas pa'i lus la/ dpag tshad brgya bzhi yod kyang gcig la gcig mi thogs pa dang*/ chos la skur pa 'debs pa'i lus tshad bshad mi rug ba/dang*/ theg chen la bskur pa 'debs pa'i lce dpag tshad 'bum yod par bshad do.a /yi dwags chung ba la mtho gang dang*/ che ba la dpag tshad stong du yang bshad do// dud 'gro chung ba la skra rtse cha lnga bcu tsam dang*/ che ba la chu srin dpag tshad nyis stong bdun brgya dang*/ klu dga' bo dang nyer dga' gnyis kyis lus kyi ri rab lan gsum 'khir bar bshad do// 'o na rgyang grags dang dpag tshad ci ltar yin zhes na/ mdzod las/ phra rab rdul dang rdul phran dang*// lcags chu ri bong lug dang glang*// nyi zer bdul dang sro ma dang*// shig dang nas 'bras de bzhin no// sor gcig zhes bya gong bdun 213)'gyur// sor mo nyi shu bzhi la khru// khru bzhi la ni gzhu 'doms gang*// gzhu 'doms lnga brgya rgyang grags gcig

/rgyang grags de la dgon par 'dod// de brgyad dpag tshad zhes bya'o/ ces so// gnyis pa tshe'i tshad ni/ ngan song gsum dang 'dod khams kyis lha'i rnams kyis tshe'i tshad ni gong du brjod zin la/ mi rnams kyi tshe tshad ni/na'adzam bu gling na nges pa med do/ skal pa dang po'i mi rnams tshe la dpag tu med pas/ tha ma tshe lo bcu la rig shogs byed pa yang 'byung ngo*// lus 'phags po lo phyed dang sum brgya/ ba lang spyod lnga brgya/ sgra mi snyan lo stong thub bo// gzugs khams kyi lha rnams la ni/ nyin mtshan gyis rnam zhag med pas/ zhag dang lo'i grangs mi rtsis te/ rang lus las gzhal ba'i dpag tshad kyis grangs mthun pa'i skal pa'i grangs kyi 'jigs ste/ tshangs ris kyi tshe 214)skal pa phyed dang*/ 'dun na 'don gcig tshags che phyed dang gnyis/ 'od chung gnyis/ tshad med 'od bzhi/ 'od bsal brgyad/ dge chung bcu drug tshad med dge sum cu rtsa gnyis/ dge rgyas drug ci rtsa bzhi/ sprin mdo 'od lus la dpag tshad gsum dor ba ltar/ tshe la yang skal pa gsum dor bas brgya nyi shu rtsal lnga dang*/ bsod nams skyes nyis brgya lnga bcu dang*/ 'bras bu che ba lnga brgya dang*/ mi che ba stong dang*/ mi gdung ba nyis stong dang*/ gya noms snang ba bzhi stong dang*/ shin tu mthong ba brgyad stong dang*/ 'og min gyi tshe skal ba khri drug stong thub bo// gzugs med rim pa ltar/ skal pa chen po nyis khri dang*/ bzhi khri/ drug khri/ brgyad khri thob bo/ gsum pa ni/ 'o na/ sems can thams cad kyis tshe de ltar nges pa snyams na ma yin te/ sgra mi snyan ni tshe nges pa can yin la/ gzhan ni 215)bar ma ra dor 'chi ba yod do// gzhan nam gang zag brgyad bar ma dor mi 'chi bar bshad de/ skye ba gcig gis thogs pa/ dga' ldan na bzhugs pa de gzhan rgyal tshab tu dbang ma bskur bar du dang*/ srid pa tha ma dgra bcom pa dang sangs rgyas pa dang*/ rgyal bas lung bstan pa dang*/

rgyal bas bsngags pa'i pho nya dang*/ dad pa dang chos kyi rjes su brang ba gnyis/ mthong lam ma rdogs bar du dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' srid pa tha ma dang*/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba de lhums na yod pa de ma bltams bar du dang*/ 'gog pa dang*/ 'du shes med ཿ dang*/ byams pa la sogs pa'i snyoms par zhugs pa de las ma langs bar du mi 'chi'o// bzhi pa 'chi ba'i tshul ni/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ drod paḥ la ba'i dus/ ro yayod de/ bar do grub pa'i tshul rnams ni mdo sngags spyi gzhung 216)laratas las gal chung bas ma spros so// ngag gis dbang po'i 'chi slu las/ tshe dang yin rnam par shes/ 'gags pa 'chi ba'i mtshan nyid yin/ thabs kyis yun rings 'tsho ba ni/ 'chi ba bslu ba/zhes bshad do// gnyis pa zhor la sems can rnams kui snod kyi 'jig rten gyi rnam par bzhag pa la lnga ste/ gnas paḥ/ 'jig pa/ stong pa/ chags pa'i tshul dang*/ bskal pa'i rnam dbye bstan pa'o/ dang po ni/ 'og rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ rngams su yang drug dang 'bum phrag gcig kha dog sngo skya dbyibs zlum po leb mo'o// mtha' skor dang chu zheng du/ grangs med pa khyams yugs stong gsum gyi brten byed la/ de'i steng du chu dang gser gnyis la/ chu'i dkyil 'khor rngams su dpag tshad 'bum dang nyi shu yin la/ gnas pa'i tshe rngams su 'bum phrag brgyad yod cing*/ lhag ma gsum 'bum nyi khri ni/ gser du 'gyur ro/ 217)mdzod las/ chu dang gser gyis dkyil 'khor gyis// thad kar 'bayum phrag bcu gnyis dang*// stong phrag gsum dang brgya phrag ni// phyed dang lnga rnams kho na'o// 'khor yug tu ni gsum 'gyur ro// ces so// kha dog ni dkar po/ ser po'o/ dbyibs ni zlum po leb mo'o// 'di ni gling bzhi gcig gis dbang du byas pa'o// spangs la ni chu dang gser gnyis rlung dang mnyam par bshad do/ de la brten pa ni/ mtsho'i gling ngo*// dang po ni/

mdzod las/ de la lhun po gnya' shing 'dzin/ shol mda' 'dzin dang*/ seng ldeng can/ de bzhin lta sdug ri dang*/ stag sna dang ni rnams 'dud dang*/ mu 'khyud 'dzin ri'i phyi rol du/ gling rnams yin no/ de dag ni/ phyi ril na ni 'khor yug go bdun ni gser yin de lcags so// lhun po rin chen bzhi rang bzhin/ ces pas/ shar dngul 218)dkar po/ lho bheḍūrya sngo po/ nub pad ma ra ga dmar po/ byang e kra ni la ser po/ gling bzhi'i nam mkha'i mdog kyang de bzhin no// dbyibs ni ri rab gru bzhi la ri bdun gru bzhis bskor zhing*/ lcags ri zlum po bskor ba'o// yar mar gyis tshad ni/ ri'i chu'i nang du brgyad khri nub cing*/ ri gzhan dang gling rnams kyang de bzhin no// chu'i steng du ri rab brgyad khri 'phags pas 'bum khrag drug khri'o// gser dang lcags brgyad pa'o// 'phangs su phyed phyed dbri ste/ gnya' shing 'dzin dang calags ri'i bar gong bzhin no// bzhi khri dang*/ nyi khri dang*/ khri dang*/ lnga stong dang*/ nyis stong lnga brgya dang*/ stong gnyis dang lnga bcu dang*/ sum brgya phyed dang bcu 'phags so// de yang 'bum phrag rngams su/ chu 'tshams yan chad kyis rang rang gis 'phangs dang mnyam te/ brgyad bzhi nas sum brgya phyed dang bcu gsum gyis bar du'o/ 219)ri bdun gyis bar rol mtsho dang mu 'khyud nas lcags ri'i bar phyi'i rgya mtsho ste/ mdo las/ de dag bar bdun rol mtsho yin// dang po stong phrag brgya pa'o// de'i nang gis mtsho chen yin// de'i ngos la gsum 'gyur ro// rol mcho gzhan gyis phyed phyed do// lhag ma phyi'i mtsho'i chen yin/ 'bum phrag gsum dang stong phrag ni nyi shu gnyis so/ ces pa bzhin no// bdun ni yan lag brgya dang ldan te/ mdzod las/ chu ni sil dag dri zhim dang*// 'jam pa dang dar dri ma med// 'thungs na mgrin par mi gnod cing*/ lto la byams shing rab tu gang*// ces so// gcig ni tsha sgo can te/

mi rnams kyis longs spyod du mi rung zhing*/ dud 'gro'i longs spyod do// gling rnams kyi rgyu ni sa yin cing*/ kha dog ni gro bo la/ rdo rje gdan ni ser du bshad do// dbyibs ni/ lho sog kha/ nub 220)zlum po/ byang gru bzhi/ shar zla gam/ gling de dag gi mi'i byad kyis dbyibs kyang de dang 'dra'o// tshad ni 'dzam bu gling gis ngos che b.lagasum la/ dpag tshad nyis stong nyis stong dang*/ chung ba la phyed dang bzhi'o// lus 'phags po'i che ba gsum snga ma gnyis po dang 'dra la/ chung ba la sum brgya lacha bcu dang*/ nub ba glang spyod la mtha' skor du/ stong phrag phyed dang brgyad la/ chu zheng la stong phrag phyed dang gsum mo// sgra mi snyan gyis ngos re la/ dpag tshad nyis stong nyis stong la/ mtha' skor du brgyad stong ngo*// gling de dag ni 'bru'i phung po ltar/ 'og bzhi rgya che zhing 'og gi tshad bshad pa ni med la/ gling phran brgyad ni lus dang lus 'phags/ sgra mi snya dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ rnga yab dang ni rnga yab bzhan/ g.yo ldan dang ni lam mchog 'gro/ ces pa/ dang po gnis shar dang nub tu'o/ gnyis pa gnyis byang gis shar dang nub tu'o/ 221)gsum pa gnyis lho'i nub dang shar du'o// bzhi pa gnyis nub kyis nub dang shar du'o// rim pa bzhin no// de dag gi tshad dang*/ gling rnams kyis bar dang*/ gling nas lcags ri dang gser gyis ri'i bar gyi tshad ni bshad pa med do// ri rab dang gling de dag la/ lha dang mi'i 'gro rnams ci ltar gnas pa ni brjod zin no// gnyis pa 'jig pa'i tshul la gnyis te/ bcud 'jig pa dang snod 'jigs pa gnyis so// dang po ni/ mnar med nas sems can gcig kyang ma lus pa nas dmyal ba rnams 'phos pa dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ dud 'gro dang*/ gling bzhi pa la sogs pa'i mi rnams dang*/ rigs bzhi nas gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyis bar dang*/ tshangs chen gyis bar du rim gyis 'jig cing 'pho'o// de la bar skal bcu dgu'o// gnyis pa snod 'jig pa ni bar skal gcig yin te/

de yang 222)'di lta ste/ da lta'i nyi ma 'di las bzhi 'gyur gyis tsha ba'i nyi ma gnyis nas drug gis bar dang*/ de bas bdun 'gyur gyis tsha ba'i rim pa ltar/ rtsi/sing nags tshal dang lteng ka che chung dang*/ chu klung ce chung dang*/ mtsho ma dros paḥ dang*/ phyi'i rgya mtsho'i lga ma dang bcas pa dang*/ lhag ma med pa dang*/ brten pa'i ri dang*/ gling rnams srogs cing*/ bsam gtan dang po man chad lhag ma med par/ me nyid kyang snod dang lhan cig tu med par 'gyur ro// de ltar skal pa chen poḥ re re bzhin*/ mes lan re 'jigs pa nas/ tshangs chen gyis tshe bar skal pa bcu drug go /me'i 'jigs pa bdun phrag gcig song nas bsam gtan gnyis pa nas chu byung nas/ bsam gtan gnyis man chad snga ma bzhin bshal/ de ltar chus lan gcig 'jigs pa'i skal chen po brgyad/ 'od gsal gyis tshe skal pa chen po brgyad do// mes bdun 223)phrag re 'jigs nas/ chus lan re 'jigs pas chu bdu seng nas/ yang mes lan gcig 'jigs te/ de nas bsam gtan gsum pa nas rlung byung ste/ gsum pa man chad rlag par byed de/ me bdun bcu rtsa drug chus lan bdun/ rlung gis lan gcig 'jigs pa'i bar la/ skal pa chen po drug cu rtsa bzhi yod pa la/ 'jigs skrag 'khor lo chen po gcig zhes bya ste/ des nas dge rgyas kyi tshe skal pa chen po drug cu rtsa bzhi'o// de lanas yang me 'jig sapa la sogs thogs mtha' med cing*/ da lta'i 'jig rten 'di ni rlung gis 'jigs pa'i rjes yin no/ zer ro// bsam gtan gnyis pa la rtogs 224)spyod me lta bu dang*/ gsum pa la dga' bde chu lta bu dang*/ bzhi pa la dbu 'byung rngub rlung lta bu'i skyon yod pas/ snod kyang*/ me dang*/ chu dang*/ rlung gis rim pa bzhin 'jig go /bsam gtan bzhi pa'i sa na rtogs spyod gnyis dbugs 'byung rngu ba gnyis/ sems dga' mi dga' gnyis med de/ bsam gtan gyis skyon brgyad dang bral ba'i phyir/

de dag mi 'jig mod kyi mi rtag de'i gzhalamed khang*/ sems can bcas te 'byung 'jig phyir/ ces pas/ lha de skyes pa dang*/ gzhal med khang dang bcas pa 'byung zhing*/ 'chi ba'i dus kyang mnyam du 'jig pa yin no// de ltar snod 'jig pa la bar skal nyi shu yin te/ 'jig pa re re'i 'og tu nam mkha' las med pa'i stong pa bar skal nyi shu 'byung ba yin no// bzhi pa 'jig rten chags pa'i tshul ni gnyis te/ snod chags pa dang*/ bcud chags pa'o/ 225)dang po ni/ mes 'jig pa sngon du song nas/ bsam gtan gnyis pa nas sprin sa la babs pa bzhin du tshangs pa'i 'jig rten chags la/ de bzhin du 'thab bral rim gyi chags so// chu dang rlung gis 'jig 'jigs pa nam mkha' gnyis pa dang gsum pa yang de bzhin no// de'i 'ogan nas gzhi la brten pa ni/ spyi mthun gyi las kyi rlung lang ste/ 'khrig pas rlung gis dkyil 'khor dang*/ sprin gser gyis snying po can las char babs pas chu dang rlung gis dkrug pas/ gser gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ de nas yang khams sgo can zhes pas/ rin po che du ma'i sa bon yod pa'i sprin las char babs/ steng gis chu dang*/ de rlung gis dkrugs pa las bcud dang po ri rab bye ba phrag brgya dang*/ bcud gnyis pa gser gyis ri bdun bye ba phrag brgya dang*/ bcud gsum pa gling bzhi gling phran 226)'khor yug lcag ri dang bcas pa bye ba phrag brgya chags so// de la bar skal gcig go /de nas sems can chags pa ni/ 'od chung gis lha tshe dang las zad pa gcig tshags chen gyis gzhal med khang du skyes pa nas/ lha shed bu zhes bya ba yid skyo nas grogs gcig yod na rung*/ snyam pa dang*/ shes la rogs byung ste/ log lta la snga lab ste/ 'jig rten gyis myes por grags so// de nas 'dun na 'don nas rgyal chen bzhi'i bar dang*/ de nas sgra mi snyan dang*/ ba lang spyod dang*/ lus 'phags po dang*/ 'jug tu 'dzam baya'i gling gis sems can 'byung ngo*// de nas dud 'gro dang*/

yi dwags dang*/ dmyal ba'i sems can 'byung ste/ mnar 227)med du sems can gcig skyes pa dang*/ chags pa'i 'jug rdzogs pa dang*/ gnas pa'i 'go rtsam pa dang*/ tshe lo brgyad khri pa bzhi dus mnyam/ de la 'jig rten gyis khams gcig ni stong gsum gyis stong chen po zhes bya ste/ mdzod las/ gling bzhi dang ni nyi zla dang*// tshags pa'i 'jig rten stong la ni// stong ni spyi phud yin par 'dod// bar ma'i 'jig rten khams yin no// de stong la ni sgong gsum mo// mnyam du 'jita rten 'byung ba yin/ zhes so// stong spyi phud de lcags ri gcig gis skor la/ gnyis pa yang lcags ri gcig gis skor zhing*/ stong gsum ni/tshags pa'i 'jig rten dang mnyam pa'i 'khor yug chen po gcig gis skor nas yod do// 'di ru 'jig rten chags gnas srong dus mnyam du bye ba yin no// gong 'og dang phyogs kyis tshad ni/ 228)mdzam bu gling nas rgyal chen bzhi'i bar du dpag tshad bzhi khrid yod la/ de nas shin tu mthong ba'i bar la dpag tshad bzhi khri bzhi khir yod cing*/ shin tu mthog ba nas 'og min gyis bar dpag tshad drug 'bum dang brgyad khri yod par bshad de/ mdzod las/ kha cig 'thab bral la sogs bya// ri rab rtse dang mnyam zhes zer/ kha cig 'thab bral de gnyis 'gyur// gzhan gyis gnyis 'gyur gnyis 'gyur te// yang kha cig na re/ bsam gtan dang po la sogs bzhi// gling bzhi ri rab bcas pa dang*// stong chen chung du dag dang ni// stong gnyis stong gsum rim bzhin mnyam/ kha cig bsam gtan dang po dag /go rim bzhin du stong gsum dang*// mnyam zhing bsam gtan bzhi pa dag /mu mtha' yas pa yin zhes zer// 'jig rten ni ji lta ba bzhin du phyogs bcu kun nas mtha' thug pa med pa yod la/ 229)/de dag dbyibs dang tshad ni nges pa med de/ phal chen las/ zhing la la spyi gcug la la gnas/ la la zlum po la la zur gsum te// de dag la la phyogs na gru bzhir gnas// nor bu bar ma 'khor lo yan lag brgyad// kun kyung las rnams rgya mtsho rnam par bris// rnam par 'khrul pa gzhan dang gzhan dag gis// zhing rnams rgya mcho sangs rgyas ston par byed/

ces pa dang*/ zhing gis rgya mtsho la la ni// rdo rje bzhin du mi shigs pa// la la 'od zer rang bzhin te// rtag cing bzung med 'od zer 'byung*/ zhes bzhin no// gnyis pa skal pa'i rang bzhin la gsum te/ skal pa bar ma gsum dang*/ bar gyis skal pa dang*/ skal pa chen po'o// dang po ni/ tshe lo sum cu pa la mu ge dang*// nyi shu pa la nad/ bcu pa la mtshon gyis bskal pa bar ma 'byung 230)ste/ mu ge lo bdun/ zla ba bdun/ zhag bdun 'byung la/ nad zla ba bdun dang zhag bdun 'byung zhing*/ mtshon ngaza bdun gyis bar du 'byung bas/ rim pa bzhin du/ longs spyod lus dang*/ srog rgud par byed do// de yang bar skal re re bar da 'byung bas/ skal paḥ bar ma zhes bya'o// dge 'dun la chos ston bsod snyoms phul ba dang*/ nad ཿpa la sman byin zhing*/ dge 'dun la a ru ra tsam phul ba dang*/ srog gcod paḥ spongs shing spangs su bcug na/ rim pa ltar/ skal pa bar ma gusam las thar bar 'gyur ro// bar gyis skal pa ni/ tshe lo dpag tu med pa nas/ bcu bar song bas ya thog ring mo yin la/ bcu pa nas brgyad khrid song zhing*/ de nas bcu par song bas khug pa yin la/ de lta bu bco brgyad dang*/ yang bcu pa nas 231)brgyad khrir 'phebs pa ma thog ring mo ste/ de rnams dus mnyam yin/ skal phran nyi shu zhes bya ste/ bar gyis skal pa'o// de'i bar la 'jig rten gnas pa yin no// de la dang po la lo brgya re zhing bri la/ khug pa rnams lnga bcu zhing 'phel ba dang*/ lnga bcu zhing 'bri ba dang*/ tha ma la yang brgya re zhing 'phel ba yin zer ro// da lta ni ya thog ring mo yin/ skal pa bzang po sangs rgyas stong la bzhi las ma byon pa'i phyir ro// bar skal brgyad cu ni/ bskal ཿpa chen po gcig yin/ de yang mi maced 'jig rten gyis dbang du byas pa yin/ 'jig rten gyis khams gzhan du ni nges pa med de/ mi mched kyis skal pa ni bde ba can du zhag gcig gis sangs rgyas zhing gi yon tan bkod las bshad pa'o// yang skal pa la gnyis te/

sangs rgyas mi 'byung ba mun pa'i skal pa dang*/ sangs 232)rgyas 'byung ba sgron ma'i skal pa'o// de yang skal pa bzag po de'i 'og tu/ bskal pa chen po drug cu rtsa lngar sangs rgyas mi 'byung ngo*// de'i 'og skal pa dra pa chen po zhes bya ba la/ sangs rgyas khir phrag gcig 'byung*/ de'i 'og tu skal paḥ brgyad cu la sangs rgyas mi 'byung ngo*// de'i 'og tu skal pa skra ma lta bu la sangs rgyas brgyad khri 'byung ngo*// de'i 'og skal pa sum brgya la sangs rgyas mi 'byung ngo*// de nas skal pa chen po yon tan skod pa zhes bya ba la/ sangs rgyas brgyad khri bzhi stong 'byung ngo*/ ces gsungs so// skal pa chen po gcig la yang gnas pa kho na'i bar gyis skal pa nyi shu la/ yar 'phel ba dang*/ brgyad khir bar du mi byon te/ sems can rnams skyo shas chung bas gdul byar mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// brgyad khri nas brgya'i bar du 'byung la/ da man chad du yang mi 'byung ste/ sems can rnams 233)snyigs ma lnga shas ches bas/ gdul bya sgor mi 'gyur ba'o// de'i tshe/ tshe'i snyigs ma srog rgud pa dang*/ dus kyi snyigs ma la longs spyod rgud pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa dang lta ba'i snyigs ma la dge ba'i rtsa ba rgud pa dang*/ sems can gyis snyigs ma la gzugs dang nad la sogs pas lus rgud par byed do// yang gdul bya'i dbang gis 'jig rten du the 'ong can zhes bya ba/ the bong gis tshad tsam mi rnams kyis nang du/ tshe lo bcu pa'i dus su sangs rgyas skra ma dga' ba zhes bya ba/ 'byon par gsung pa yang yod do// dad pa ni shin tu 'byung dka' ste/ tshogs bsags pa yang dka' zhing*/ gdul bya snod du gyur ba nyung ba'i phyir ro// sems can la phan par byed pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba dang*/ rang sangs rgyas ni yar 'phel ba dang*/ sangs rgyas mi 'byon pa'i dus kyang 'byung bar gsungs 234)so// spyi don bzhi pa nges 'byung gis blo skyed pa'i phyir/

zag pa dang bcas pa sdug bsngal du shes par bya ba ni/ brjod ma dag pa'i ma gis sdug bsngal ba thams cad skad cig ma dang*/ rgyun gyis mthar mi rtag pas 'du shes kyis sdug bsngal yin te/ mdo las/ 'du byas thams cad skad cig ma// mi gnas bya ba ga la yod/ ces pa dang*/ klu sgrub kyis/ sa dang lhun po rgya mtsho nyi ma bdun/ 'bar bas srog pa'i lus can kha cig la// lhag ma tsam yang lus par mi 'gyur na/ shin tu nyams chung mi lta smos ci dgos/ ces so// 'gro ba lnga'i sems can gang ci snyed pa de dag zag pa dang bcas pa'i las kyi/ 'khor ba ru 'khor lo bzhin du 'khor te/ rgya cher rol pa las/ ji srid ma rig dbang gis 'gro ba rnams// lha dang mi dang ngan song gnas gsum po// 'gro ba lnga'i gnas su mi bas 235)pas/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa myong zhing*/ da rung 'khor ba'i bde 'bras la chags shing*/ nges 'byung gis blo ma skyes na/ da lta sdug bsngal mtha' med myong bar 'gyur te/ bshes springs las/ re res rgya mtsho bzhi las lhag pa yis// nu zho 'thungs kyang da rung so so yis// skye pos rjes su 'breng zhing 'khor ba las// de bas che mang lhag cig ltung 'tshal lo/ ces so// mtho ris kyi lha dang mi rnams kyang*// bsod nams kyis 'phel ba zad pa na// slar ngan song du 'gro bas ni// 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal yin te/ klu sgrub kyis/ lha'i 'jig rten dag nas 'phos pa yis// gal te dge ba'i lhag ma 'ga' med na// de nas dbang med yi dwags du 'gro dang*// dmyal bar gnas pa gang yang rung bar 'gyur/ ces so// 'dod khams kyis lha dang mi dag gis ni/ sdug bsngal gyis 236)'khor// dpe na rdza mkhan 'phang lo 'khor ba bzhin/ zhes pa dang*/ rta dbyangs kyi mya ngan bsal ba las/ gtsang ma'i gnas rnams ma rtog par// bros pas gang du'ang mi gtong ba'i// sems can gang du'ang yod pa min// yang nas yang du dmyal ba las// zangs zhun bskol ba gang 'thung*// rgya mtsho nang gis chu bas kyang*// de'i tshad kyang yod ma yin/

khyi dang phag tu 'gyur pas na// mi gtsang ba ni gang zos pa// ri'i rgyal po lhun po yi// tshad las shin tu lhag par 'gyur// mdza' ba shes rab kyis bral ba yis// 'gro ba de dag gang rung pa// mig gi chil ma'i thig pa ni// snod du rgya mcho rung ma yin// phan tshun dag tu rtsod pa'i phyir// mgo bo gcad pa gang yin pa// spang nas de ltar mthong ba ni// tshangs pa'i 'jig rten las kyang thal// zhes gsungs 237)/sdug bsngal bzod par dka' ba yod pas/ mi rnams skyes rgas na 'chi bzhi dang brgyad la sogs pas sdug bsngal ba ni mngon sum du 'gyur la/ 'dod khams kyis lha rnams 'chi bar 'gyur pas na/ 'chi ltas rnam pa lnga lha'i zhag bdun gyis bar du 'byung ste/ klu nam mkha' lding gis khyer ba'am// rgyal mtsho'i dbus su gru zhig pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal yod de// klu sgrub kyis// lus kyis kha dog mi sdug 'gyur ba dang*// gdan la mi dga' me tog phreng rnying dang// gos la dri ma chags dang lus la ni// sngon med pa'i sdug bsngal 'byung zhes bgyi// mtho ris 'chi 'pho sbron gyis snga ltas lnga// lha yul gnaso pa'i lha rnams la byung ste// sa steng mi rnams 'chi ba 'gyur pa dag /sbren par 'gyur pa'i 'chi ltas rnams dang 'dra// ces so// gzugs khams dang gzugs med pa'i lha 238) rnams kyang 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal yod de// bsam gtan gnas mes yang du ni// nyon mongs tshing bsregs par 'gyur kyang ni| |bdag lta'i tshab brtan po ma spangs nas// char gyis rlan bzhin mos pa rab du skyed// ces pa dang*// dpal bos// khyod kyis bstan la phyir phyogs pa'i// skye bo ma rig gis mdongs rnams// srid rtse'i bar du song nas kyang*// sdug bsngal ma byung yang srid bsgrub// ces sau// ngan song gsum gyi sems can rnams// sdug bsngal gyis sdug bzod// mi nus pa'i lugs ni gong du bshad zin te// des na 'khor ba'i gnas gang du skyes kyang bde ba'i go skabs med de// rje btsun byams pas// mi gtsang ba la dri zhim med// 'gro lnga dag la la bde ba med// ces pa'i tshul gyis 'khor ba mtha' dag las yid 'byung bar bya'o// ces so// spyi don gnyis pa 'jig rten dang 'jig rten

239) /las 'das pa'i rnam par bzhag pa la gsum te// 'jig rten 'jig rtenalas 'das pa'i khyad par dang*// grub mtha' blo ba sgyur ma sgyur gyis khyad par dang*// drang don nges don gyis khyad par ro// dang po ni// mdo' bcu las// 'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten las// theg pa'i rim pa gnyis bstan te// ces pa dang*// nam mkha' mtha' mnyam las// 'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa'i| |lta ba'i khyad par bsam mi khyab// dngos la 'od gsal rig par 'dus// ces pas// de la gsum te// sa mtshams dang*// nges tshigs dang*// rgyan mtshan dang*// ngo bo'i sgo nas bzhag pa'o// snga ma la gnyis te// lta ba'i rgyu'i sgo nas bzhag na lta ba gang zag gis bdag med rtogs pa yan chad 'das pa// de las log pa gcig 'jig rten pa'o// de yang mu stegs man chad 'jig rten pa'o/ 249) nyon mongs yan chad 'das pa'o// 'bras bu'i sgo nas bzhag na// nyon mongs lan gcig gis phyir 'ong ba'i gang zag nam chad 'jig rten pa| dgra bcom thob pa ni 'das pa'o// de yang bhai lam lan gcig phyir 'ong ba ni// 'dod khams kyis sa bon dang bral bas 'dod khams ma 'ong la// khams gong ma gnyis las 'das pa'o// sa lam klong las// phyir mi 'ong ba 'dod pa na// 'dun snod yang chags bral na// dgra bcom 'grub par gsung pa ste// mi mnyam byas pa rtogs pa'i sa// ces so// theg chen pa ni// sbyor lam man chad 'jig rten// mthong lam yan cha 'das pa'o/ donabasdus las// de dag zag bcas bsam gtan te// gnyis med yul bral de mthong min// ces pa dang*// rang gis mtshan nyid mngon sum du gsal ba mthong ba dbugs phyin te// zag pa zag nas 'jig rten 'das// 241) /ces gsungs so// gnyis pa nges tshig ni// 'jig las 'jig pa rten pa dang*// mi 'jig pa la mi 'jig pa rten pa dang*// 'jig pa la mi 'jig pa bstan pa'o// de dag la mi rtag skye 'jig gis sdug bsngal dang bcas pa 'jig rten pa// de las grol ba 'das pa'o// kun byed las// ma rig lig rtog gzung 'dzin gyis// yul drug chos la nges rtags pas// 'jig pa drug dang rteg pa drug// 'jig rten zhes su bshad pa yin// ces pa dang*// yul drug chos la mi rtog pa// skye drug gnas su mi skye ste/

sdug bsngal drug las pa'i phyir// mya ngan 'das pa de la bya// ces gsungs so// gsum pa// rgyu mtshan dang ngo bo'i sgo nas bzhag na// nyon mongs 'chings dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten pa// de las log pa 'das pa'o// yang zag pa dang bcas pa 'jig 242) rten pa/ zag pa gsum dang bral ba 'das pa'o// lam rim las/ zag kun zad pa'i rigs can gyis// ci ltar spyang kyang rtog pa med| ces pa dang*/ don bsdus las/ khams gsum 'jig sogs zag bral dang*// mi rtog ma gnas phyor ma 'ing*// ces gsung so// gnyis pa grub mtha' blo bsgyur mi sgyur gyis khyad par la gnyis te// go ba dang*// sa mtshams so// snga ma ni/ rang rang gi gzhung la brten te// rgyu lam tshul 'bras bu mtho ris dang thar da 'dod ba'i blo dang ldan pas blo sgyur ba// de las log par ma sgyur bar 'dod de// de ltar na mu stegs chad lta blo ma sgyur bar thal ba'i skyon 'ong ngo// 'o na ci ltar yin zhe na// rang rang gi gzhung lugs la brten nas/ rang mos pa shes bya'i don la sems pa'i blo dang ldan pas blo sgyur ba// de las log pa blo ma bsgyur pa'o// ces gsungs 243) /so// yang 'khor ba las grol 'dod kyis blos rang mos pa shes bya'i don la 'jug cing rtog par byed pa blos sgyur ba// de las log pa gcig la ma sgyur ba'o// theg pa chen po mdo sde las// rmongs pa gsal phyir sems bskyed do// de 'tshar tshig gis 'dus te sgyur// ces gsungs so// gnyis pa la 'tshams ni/ 'gro drug mun pa'i shes pa blos ma sgyur ba'o// mu stegs pa dang nyan thos yan chad blos bsgyur ba'o*// gsum pa drang don nges don gyis dbye ba ni// brjod bya kun rdzob kyis bden pa gtso bor ston pa dang*// gdul bya' 'jig rten pa rnams la gtso cher dgongs nas gsungs pa rnams ni drang don yin la// gdul bya 'jig rten las 'das pa rnams la gtso bor dgongs nas gsungs pa rnams ni nges don yin te/

'jug pa las*// mdo gang bshad pa de 244) nyid drang don te// stong nyid don bshad nges don shes par gyis// ces so// gzhan nam byang chub sems dpal sde snod las// drang nges dbye ba brgyad gsungs te// lam la 'jug pa drang don te// 'bras bu la 'jug pa nges pa'i don// kun rdzob bsgrub byed drang don dang*// don dam bsgrub byed nges pa'i don// las kyi bya la 'jug pa drang*// las dang nyon mongs zad rten las// kun nas nyon mongs bstan da dang*/// rnam byang ston pa nges pa'i don// 'khor bar skyo skye drang don la// 'khor 'das gnyis med nges pa'i don/ tshig 'bru sna tshigs ston pa drang*| |zab cig rtogs dka' nges pa'i don// tshig mang sems can 'gu' byed drang*// tshig nyung bzung bde nges pa'i don// bdag sogs gtsor bshad drang don la// bdag med ston pa nges pa'i don// ces gsungs so pa ltar ro// spyi don gsum pa theg pa'i rnam par 245) /bzhag pa la gsum te// 'khor lo rgyun gyis theg pa dang*/ cho 'phrul mngon 'byung gis theg pa dang// don dam nges pa'i theg pa'o// dang po la gsum te// gdul bya dang*/ thegapa dang*/ 'dul thabs so// dang po gdul bya ni// khams gsum la gnas pa'i sems can rnams dang*/ bye brang du/ 'dod khams la gtso cher zhen pa'i 'dod pa dang ma bral ba/ 'khor lo rgyun gyi theg pa zhes bya ste/ spyi chings las// 'khor lo rgyun gyis gdul bya ni// khams gsum gnas pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ zhan gsum 'dod ba ma bral bas// 'dod la zhes pa'i gdul byar brjod// ces so// gnyis pa theg pa ni/ 'byung ba rnam pa lnga ye nas che ba lnga'i sangs rgyas su gsang sngags rgyud sde rnams nas grags pas/ 'byung ba lngar snang ba 'di dag kyang*/ sems can la bar 'tshams med pa'i don byed pas 246) na| thugs rje rtag pa'i sangs rgyas yin te/ rdzogs chen nam mkha' che las/

'byung ba chen po bcom ldan 'das// chub par gnas pa bcom ldan 'das// 'gro ba kun la rnam par snang*// ces pa dang*// dam pa bde bar gshegs pa'i zhal nas/ 'byung ba rgyun gyis bcom ldan 'das// ma bcos rtog bral ye nas dag /ces so// gsum pa 'dul thabs la gsum te/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyis skyed pa'i rgyu dang*/ 'tsho ba'i longs spyod kyis rkyen ngang brten pa'i gnas dang*/ mthun pa'i grogs dang bcas pa rnams/ rtog pa med pa ngang gis lhun grub du 'byu?ng ba'o/ rang bzhin ngang ngam bar 'tshams med par 'khor lo'i rtsibs ltar gnas so// spyi chings las// 'gro drug sems can thams can thams cad kyis// bskye 247) /dang 'tsho dang brten pa yi/ rgyu dang rkyen dang gnas pa yis// mi rtog ngang gis kun 'byung ba// ngang gis rgyun gyis 'khor lor gnas so// rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis te/ don mdzad tshul dang*/ 'bras bu'o// dang po ni/ de ltar 'khor lo rgyun gyis theg pa la don mdzad tshul yang*/ rtsol bsgrub med par rang bzhin shugs kyi gdul bya snod du rung bar byed do// skyes 'tsho' rten sogs bya ba mdzad nas*/ nges pa don gyis gdul byar gyur pa'o// spyi chings las/ de ltar rgyun gyis theg pa yis// rang bzhin shugs kyi gdul bya ste// 'gro kun skyes 'tsho' rten byas nas// ces so// gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i yul du gyur te/ kun kyang zag pa med pa'i dbyings su bkod do// spyi chings las/ dam pa'i 'khor 248) lo rab skor nas// kun kyang zag med dbyings su bkos// ces pa dang*/ gsang snying le'uganyis pa las/ sa chu spyan dang ma ma ki// me rlung gos dkar sgrol ma te// nam mkha' dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma// srid gsum ye nas sangs rgyas zhing*// thams cad ma lus chos so cog// sangs rgyas nyid las gzhan nam yin// sangs rgyas nyid las gzhan pa'i chos*// sangs rgyas nyid kyis mi rnyed do// ces so| |gnyis pa cho 'phrul mngon 'byung gis theg pa la gsum te/

mdor bstan pa dang*// zhabs bsdu ba'o// dang po la gsim te/ gdul bya dang*/ theg pa dang/ 'dul thabs mdor bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ gdug dka' 'dra pa'i gdul bya ngo bo nyid kyis skus 'dul ba'i gdul bya ste// nges pa'i theg pa'i spyod yul du ma gyur pa ni/ nyon mongs drag pos gdungs shing 'dul dka' ba'i sems 249) /can la// cho 'phral mngon 'byung gis theg pas don mdzad pa yin te/ de nyin las// cho 'phral mngon par 'byung ba yis/ dam pa'i spyod yul ma 'gyur pas// shig tu dug gsum bsdo ba yi// 'dul bar dkar ba'i sems can la// ces so// gnyis pa ni/ phyi nang gis bskal pa'i 'khor lo drug gis gdul bya yin te// 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*// gti mug gis mi dge ba bcu po rgyan bcad de// de nyid las/ skal pa 'khar lo'i gdul bya ste// zhen dang rmongs dang 'khrul pa yis// las ngan 'du shes ngan pa rnams// rgyan spyod 'gyur pa'i 'phrin las so// ces so/ gsum pa 'dul

thabs spyir bstan pa ni/ rgyal ba rnams kyis 'khor lo rgyun dang*// don dam nges pa'i 'khor lo bskor ba yang*/ gdug byar ma gyur da de dag la/ mngon sum du/ 250) skal pa'i 'khor los las rgyun bcad de/ de nyid las// dam pa'i 'khor lo bskor na'ang*// 'dul bar ma gyur de dag la// skal pa'i 'khor los las rgyun bcod// ces so// gnyis da rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis te/ bar gyas skal da dang*// phyi'i bskal pa chen po'o*// dang po la gsum te// mu ge'i skal da dang*/ nad kyis skal pa dang*/ mtshon gyis skal pa'o// dang po ni/ yul dngos po zhen pa'i gdul bya la/ zas skom rgyun bcad nas/ mu ge'i sdug bsngal gyis/ lo bdun/ zhag bdun/ za ma bdun la sogs pas 'dod yon la zhen pa'i rgyun bcod/ de nyid las/ srid zhi tshigs bral skal pa yi// sims dang yid kyis las rgyun bcod// ces pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje'i mdzad pa/ gdul bya 'dod yon can rnams kyi don/ mu ge'i 251) /skal pa'i tshul du snang ngo*// gnyis pa nad kyis skal pa ni/ sdug bsngal mi bzod pa'i nang rlung 'khris bad kan la sogs pas dran da nyams par byed pas na/ rmongs pa'i skal pas lus kyi zhen pa bcid par byad de/ zla ba bdun zhag bdun gyis gti mug gis lus la chags pa'i las rgyun bcod de/ lung las/ bzod ldan rmongs pa'i skal pa yis// zhen pa chags pa'i las rgyun bcod// de yang*/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje'i mdzad pa/ gdul bya gti mug can rnams kyis snang ngor/ nad kyi skal pa'i tshul du snang ngo// gsum pa mtshon gyis skal pa ni/ gdul bya gnyen 'dun la sogs pa rnams la zhen cing chags pa'i sems can rnams la// zhe sdang gos kun nas blang nas/ phan tshun 'thab cing*/ zhe gcod pa'i mtshon cha'i skal pa shar nas/ bdag 252) gzhan gnyis ka'i dngos po thams cad kyis kas rgyun bcad de/ lung las/ 'thab 'dzings mtshon cha'i skal pa yis/

dngos po dngos po thams cad bcod// ces gsungs pas/ zhe sdag can la mtshon cha'i skal pa zhag bdun za ma bdun gyis bar la rgyun bcad de| de yang sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje'i mdzad pa gdul bya zhe sdang can rnams kyis snang ngor/ gnyis pa phyi'i skal pa la bzhi ste/ me'i skal pa dang*/ chu'i skal da dang*/ rlug gis skal pa'o// stong pa'i skal pa'o// dang po ni/ lung las/ lhag mthong me'i skal pa yis// dngos po'i dra ba ma lus bsreg// ces gsungs pas/ yul dngos por rang rgyud du 'dzin pa'i snod kyis 'jig rten rnams/ dngos 'dzin bcod de/ tshil ni/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis thugs rje'i mdzad pa/ gdul byang rgyal can rnams kyis snang ngor me'i 253) skal par snang nas/ don mdzad pa'o// zhe khro lha rgyud las/ nga rgyal tshul gyis nga rgyal 'joms mdzad pa// nga rgyal 'joms 'dzad ratna he ru ka /gnyis pa ni/ lungalas/ zhi gnas chu'i skal pa yis// 'dzin pa'i bag chags thams cad dkru// ces pas/ rang bzhin gyis rtog 'dzin zhi bar byed pas chul skal pa ni/ sems kyis rtog pa thams cad 'jig par byed pas/ zhi gnas zhes bya/ tshul ni/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje'i mdzad pas/ gdul bya 'dod chags can rnams kyis snang ngor| chu'i skal pas 'jig pa'i tshul du snang ste/ de yang lha rgyud las/ 'dod chags tshul gyis 'dod chags 'dul mdzad pa// 'dod chags 'dul mdzad pad ma he ru ka /ces so// gsum pa ni/ lung las/ thogs med rlung gi skal pa yis// shes 254) bya thogs med kun tu skor// ces pas/ mtshan nyid gang du'ang mi 'dzin pa la/ skad cig mar thogs pa med par rlung gis skal pa'i tshil gyis| dngos po phra rags thams cad gtor te// mi gnas par byed do// tshul ni/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis thugs rje'i mdzad pa/ gdul bya phrag dog can rnams kyis snang ngor/ rlung gis skal par shar ba'o/ de'i dus nyid kyang sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje'i las ma g.yosate|

lha rgyud las/ 'phrag dog tshul gyis 'phrag dog 'dul mdzad pa// 'phrag dogs 'dul mdzad karma je ru ka /ces pa dang*/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud las/ dug lnga ma spangs ye shes lng// dug gsum ma spangs sku gsung thugs// ces pa'i dgongs pa dang yang sbyar bar bya'o// bzhi pa ni/ shes rab nam mkha'i skal pa yis/ mtshan ma'i rgas rgyud thams cad stong*/ 255) /ces pas/ skal phran nyi shus snod dang thams cad stong par byed do/ de yang sangs rgyas kyi gdul byar gyur pa rnams la/ snang tshol de ltar ston pas/ gdul bya nges 'byung skyes te/ don dam nges pa'i gdul byar gyur pa'o// tshul de dag ni sangs rgyas rnams thugs rje'i mdzad pa gdul bya rnams kyis snang ngor stong pa'i snang bar shar ba'o/ dgongs pa 'dus pa las/ 'khor ba ci snyed yod bar du// bstan pa'i snying po nyi ma shar// rang bzhan chos kyi 'khor lo 'di// mi nub rgyun mi chad par bskor// ces gsung so// don bsdu' ba la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dus gang gi tshen/ theg gang gis gdul bya gang las/ 'dul thabs ci ltar snang ba ni/ dus snyigs mar gyur pa'i bar skabs rnams su 'khor lo rgyun dang*/ don dam nges pa'i theg pa mdo' sngags rnam pa 256) gnyis nub pa'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid kyis don mi mdzad pa ni/ cho 'phrul mngon 'byung gis theg pa ste/ gdul bya las ngan can rnams la/ 'dul thabs las rgyun gcod pa'i phyir// sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i tshil du snang nas/ don mdzad de/ lung las/ snyigs mar gyir pa'i skabs rnams ni su 'dul ba rnams ni nub pa na/ skal sogs thugs rje'i bstan pa de// las ngan las rgyun gcod pa'i phyir| |sdug bsngal rnams ni rnam par snang*// ces dang*/ dgongs 'dus las*/ lang ka'i bdag po de ltar na// 'di kun gsag ba dam pa ni// dbyings las gar yang ma g.yos te// snying po kho na'i dbyings nyid las// stong pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar zad// stong nyid gsang ba'i de kho na// ces so// gnyis pa la gnyis te/

brgal ba dang*/ len no/ de ltar 'khor lo rgyun dang cho 'phrul 257) /mngon 'byung gis theg pas don mdzad na/ ston pa sangs rgyas mi bzhugs shing bstan pa dam chos nub nas/ 'gro ba 'dul thabs med zhes smra ba na/ de ltar ma yin te/ 'das dang nubo zhes pa dang*/ ston pa sangs rgyas la 'das grongs mi mnga'*/ bstan pa dam chos la 'char nub mi mdzad/ gsang sngags kyi thugs rjes shar thabs med pa ma yin no/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa gsang ba gnyis med kyis thugs rje'i mdzad pas shugs kyis 'dul ba yin te// sangs rgyas thid pa las/ theg chen gsang ba de nyid do| |ces dang*/ dgo ngas 'dus las/ sangs rgyas mya ngan yongs mi 'da'// chos kyang nub per mi 'gyur te// thabs dang theg pa gang rtags las// tha ma'i tha mar bshad pa yin// ces gsungs so// gsum pa don dam nges pa'i theg pa la yang*/ gsum te/ 257) ma rtogs dang*// log par rtog dang*/ nges pa'i theg pa'i dngos po gcig dang po la gnyis te/ phyal pa ba dang*/ rgyang 'phren pa'o| |phyal pa la gnyis te/ spyi dang*/ bye bral go /spyir ni/ rgyu dge ba la 'bras bu mtho' ris kyis bde ba yang mi shes shing*/ rgyu mi dge ba la 'bral bu ngan song gis sdug bsngal myong ba'i tshul yang dag par ma rig ste/ dus skye ba snga phyi yang ma shes pas tshe 'di'i rten 'tsho ba'i bya ba don gnyer ba yin te/ spyi chings las/ khams gsum sems can 'di dag rnams/ dge dang mi dge chos rnams la// 'bral bu bde dang sdug bsngal dag yod med gang du'ang mi rtogs shing*/ dus kyis skye ba lnga phyi dag /yod med mi rtog tshe 'di la/ skyes tshe rten pa'i bya ba de// lta ba med pa'i phyal pa'o// ces so// gnyis pa bye brag du phye ba la gnyis te/ dman rigs dang*/ rigs ma 259) /nges pa'o// dang po ni/ 'khor ba spyi gtsan gyis sems can rnams yin te/ gnas skabs mthar thug gang du yang sangs rgyas bstan pa'i skal ba dang mi ldan pas/

sems rig kun du rmongs shing 'thib pas/ dud 'gro dang mtshungs te| lung de nyid las/ dman rigs 'jug pa'i skal med de// shes rig med pas dud 'gro mtshungs// ces gsungs so// gnyis pa ni| yang gang zag sgos btsan kha cig rigs sad ma'i skal pa dang ldan na yang*/ gzhan rkyen gyis dge pa'i bshes gnyen dang ma mjal gyis bar du dus skabs kyis bstan pa'i sgor 'jug mi nus pas dal 'byor gyi chos dang mi ldan pa 'dra ste/ de nyid las/ ma nges skal yod rkyen ma 'joms// dal bcas 'byor ba med dang mtshungs// ces so// gnyis pa rgyang 'phen pa la gnyis te/ rigs chad dang*/ 260)'du shes can no// dang po ni/ gnas lugs spyi'is khyab kyang*/ bye brag rgyas 'gyur gyis rigs sad pa'i skal pa dang mi ldan pa'i phyer/ rigs chad pa zhes bya ste/ de nyid las/ rigs chad rgyu rkyen skal med yin/ ces so// gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ ya nga can dang*/ rnam g.yengs can dang*/ zhen pa dang*/ mos pa can no// dang po ni/ rigs bye brag gis khams rang dngas cha yod kyang*/ gnas skabs kyi gzhan rkyen sdig to can dang ma bral bas/ sdig pa'i rnam smin drag po bsags pa yin// de nyid las/ ya nga can gyi ya mtshan nyid ni/ rnam smin drag po'i las byed cing*// sdug bsngal drag po 'phen byed pas// shes ldan ldan ltas na skyi g.ya' ba// ya nga can zhes grags pa yin// ces so// gnyis pa rnam g.yengs can ni/ tshe 'di bya ba ched du gnyer zhing*/ khe dang grags pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ 261) /lus ngag yid gsum rnam g.yengs kyis bya ba bha 'ba' zhig la spyod pa yin te/ lus las/ g.yengs can tshe 'di yi ched phyir du// khe dang grags ba sna tshogs kyis// g.yengs pa'i bya ba sna tshogs byed// ces so// gsum pa zhan pa can ni| tshe 'di'i zas nor rigs rgyud don du gnyer nas/ 'jig rten pa'i lha 'dres dang*/ mo dang pra la sogs da mig 'phrul sna tshogs kyis|

gzhan gyis 'du shes bsgyur bar byed de/ lung las/ zhan pa'i 'du shes can nyid ni/ zas nor rigs rgyud ched phyir du| |brtson pas 'jig rten lha la brten// mig 'khrul nor dang zas bsgrub ste// gzhan gyi 'du shes sgyur bar byed// ces so| |bzhi pa mos pa can ni/ tshe 'di yis rnam g.yengs kyis dbang du byas ste/ thar lam don du gnyer ba med na yang*/ sngon 262) sbyongs pa'i stobs kyis sdig pa'i rnam smin gyi las mi bsag cing*/ bye brag rgyas 'gyur gyis rigs sad pa'i skal ba ldan pa yin te| yil dkon mchog gsum la yang skur ba mi 'debs sheng*/ lus ngag yid gsum ngang ngam shugs kyis nges 'byung skyo shes dang*/ rnam par dkar ba'i spyod pa la gzhol ba yin te/ lus las/ mos pa can gyi mtshan nyid ni// lta ba phyal par gyur pa dang*// dkon mchog gsum la skur mi byed// sdig pa'i las la ya nga zhing*// cung zad dkar ba'i tsa bon ldan// rgyud las sbyangs pa'i las yod pa'o| |ces so// gnyis pa log par lta ba la gnyis te/ dmu' rtugs pa dang*/ mu stegs pa'o// dang po ni/ rag bzhin gyis log pa dang*/ rkyen gyis log pa dang*/ rkyen gyis log pa ste/ rag bzhin gyis log pa ni/ gzhan rkyen med kyang sngon sbyangs stobs la sogs pa'i stobs/ 263) /kyis/ tshe snga phyi dang las rgyu 'bral las sogs pa med par lta zhing*/ 'di ltar du snang ba'i chos thams cad/ spangs la sha mongs rdol ba ltar/ blo bur pa yin par 'dod de/ lung de nyid las/ dngapo mi dge ba'i rkyen med ba'i rkyen med kyang*/ las kyis sbyangs pa'i log par 'dzin na// dge sdig rgyu 'bras tshe snga phyi// de dag thams cad med par lta// da lta'i snong ba blo bur pa// rgyu rkyen med par shugs kyis snang*// snod bcud kun la de ltar rtogs// ces so// gnyis pa rkyen gyis log pa ni/ 'aud bsrungs rdzogs byed la sogs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/

log par rtog pa'i lta ba 'dzin cing*/ dkar nag gis rgyu 'bral rnam par lta zhing*/ tshe snga phyi dang*/ dus snga phyi thams cad med par smra ba ni/ grub mtha' 'dod pa'o// lung las/ gnyis pa rkyen gyis log pa ni// 'od bsrungs 264) rdzogs byed la sogs pa'i// lta ba yongs su 'dzin byed cing*/ dka' nag rnam smin med smra zhing*// skye ba snga phyi med par smra// de nyid rang gis grub mthar 'dod// phyi ma med phyir dmu rtug ste// rgyu 'bras med 'dod chad smra yin// ces so// gnyis pa mu stegs pa ni gnyis te/ mdo' las/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po ni 'khor ba las thar 'dod kyis blo brod pa dang bcas nas/ lam gyis dka' ba sna tshogs dang du blangs nas/ log pa'i brtul zhugs la spyod ceng 'bras bu thob par 'dod na/ dge sdig log par sbyod pa yin te| lug las/ rgyu 'bras snga phyi 'dod da dang*// ngan song gsum gyis sdug bsngal las// thar 'dod mtho' ris thob 'dod kyang*| |lta log lta spyod char 'gyur// 'bral bu zhe 'dod ma bral bas// kun tu tshol ba'i la du zhugs*// ces so// rgyas 265) /par bshad pa la bzhi ste/ 'phra men spyod pa'i mu stegs pa dang*/ rten log 'chal pa dang*/ rtags tsam 'dzin pa dang| lug gis phyogs tsam 'dzon pa'i mu steg pa'o// dang po 'phra men spyod pa'i mu stegs pa ni/ mtho' ris bde ba 'dod pa'i phyir/ grub mtha' blos bsgyur ba bdag du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa la zhugs te spyod pa mi dge ba sna tshogs spyad nas/ lus mi gtsang bar 'dzin pa/ tshor ba sdug bsngal ba bde bar 'dzin pa/ 'dus byas mi rtag pa rtag par 'dzin pa dang*/ chos thams cad bdag med pa la bdag du 'dzin pa ste/ phyin ci log gis lta ba bzhi las/ yang dag pa'i lta bar 'dzin pa yin te/ lus las/ 'phra men spyod pa'i mtshan nyid ni// thar pa 'dod pas bdag du lta/ mtho' ris bzhed phyin mi dge bsgrub// phyin ci log pa bzhi la gnas/

'di dag kun la dngos por smra/ 'dod dang lta spyod mi mtshungs pas*// 'phra min 266) spyaud ces de la bya// ces so// gnyis pa rten log 'chal pa ni/ lha chen tshangs pa dang*/ dbang phyug la saugs pa'i lha chen rnams la rten bcas nas/ de dag gi go 'phangs thob par 'dod cing*/ nang pa'i sangs rgyas la sogs dkon mchog rnams la log par ltas te/ phyin ce log pa'i lam la zhugs pa te/ lung ni/ rten log 'chal pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ tshangs pa la sogs lha chen de/ bsod nams sbyangs pa'i stobs las 'byung*/ sbyangs stobs ches bas mnga' dbang brnyes/ byang chub sems dpal mthu' chen de /'jig rten kun gyis gtso bor 'gyur/ log lta can gyis mi shes te// phya dang dbang phyug ming btags nas// de dag rang rgyud ye grub smra// ces so/ de dag rgyas par phye na bzhi ste/ 'bras bu re ba log par spyod pa dang*/ gol ba'i ngo bo la rgyu 'bral log par lta ba dang*/ sga don dang*/ mtshan 267)nyid do// dang po ni/ 'bras bu lha chen dbang phyug la sogs pa'i go 'phangs thob pa dag gis/ med lnga'i btul zhugs dang*/ dbyug gu zhes bya ba dang*/ kha ṭam rtse gsum la sogs pa'i btul zhug sa/ khyi'i cha byad la gnas pa'i dka' thub dang*/ ba glang ma he la sogs dang*/ glang che'i ge'i lci ba la sogs pa'i btul zhugs ste/ logs pa'i btul zhugs sna tshogs spyod de/ lung las de'i go 'phangs thob 'dod phyir// me lnga bstan dang dbyung gu dang*// khyi'i dka' thub la sogs pa// logs pa'i btul zhugs sna tshogs spyod/ ces so// gnyis pa gol ba'i ngo bo rgyu 'bras la log par lta ba ni// kha cig de dang de'i 'bras bu thob par 'dod pa'i phyir/ rdul dang mun pa snying po stobs gsum la gzhi bcas nas/ gsum po cha mnyam du gyur na rdal la rten nas 'bras bu sku gsum mthob par 'dod de/ lus las 268) dus gsum rtul dang mun pa dang*// snying stobs dag gis byes brag las// cha mnyam mi mnyam khyad par gyis// rgyu dang 'bras bu yin par smra// gsum pa sgra don ni/

yang kha cig nang pa'i dkon mchog gsum la log par lta ste/ 'jig rten pa'i lha chen rnams la dngos po rang rgyud dubarten bcas te/ dug gsum rang rgyud kyis sbyod pas/ 'chal pa sna tshogs spyod de/ lung las/ rin chen gsum la rten logs nas// dngos brtag 'jig rten 'chal pas/ 'chal pa'i spyod pa sna tshogs spyod// ces so// bzhi pa de dag spy-i'i mtshan nyid ni/ de ltar rten log pas/ thob bya mtho' rig thar pa mi thob ste/ phal cher ngan song gis sdud bsngan myong bar 'gyur te/ skyabs gnas dang bral bas mtho ris thar pa'i gegs su gyur pa yin te/ lug de nyid las/ thob bya'i 'bras bu mi thob ste// sdug bsngan can du phal cher gzhol// 269) /rten log 'chal pa'i mtshan nyid yin// ces so// gsum pa rtags rtsam 'dzin pa la spyi dang*/ bye brag gnyis so| |dang po ni*/ lus kyis cha lugs sangs rgyas sprul sku'i tshul rtags 'dzin cing*/ sems phyin ci log du zhugs pa'o// lung las/ rtag tsam 'dzin pa'i mtshan nyid ni// ces sogs dang*/ gnyis pa bye brag la drug ste/ gol bzhi dang*/ gol bzhi dang*/ don rtag chad gnyis su 'dus tshul dang*/ bka'i dgongs don mi khrol lta log sna tshogs byung tshul dang*/ de nyid la sgra don dang*/ de nyin la sgra dog dang*/ rtag tsam 'dzin pa'i mu stegs pa nang pa'inang nas yod par bstan pa'o// dang pau ni/ sangs rgyas sprul sku mya ngan la 'das nas/ bstan pa snyigs mar gyur pa'i dus*/ gzugs brnyen gyis bstan pa 'dzin pa'i dus su 'byung ste/ lus las/ spral pa snga ma 'das pa yin/ bstan pa snyigs mar 'gyur pa'i tshe// 270) bstan pa de'i gzugs brnyan las// ces so// gnyis pa gol tshul ni/ bstan pa la 'jug 'dod kyis gang zag kha cig tshul rtags bstan pa sgor zhugs kyang*/ tog bsam bhai gsum gyis shes rab gsum la ma sbyangs pas/ bstan pa'i don la rtogs spyod byas kyang*/

drang nges bdeg gnyis la sogs pa'i dgongs don ni ma rtogs/ rgyal ba'i gsung pa'i bka' la rag chod byas nas/ rigs byed lhag spyod dang*/ sgyu rtsal gyis bu ring phur la sogs pa'i log par smra ba du ma byang ba yin te/ lus las/ 'jug 'dod g.yo' can gyis// shes rab gsum la ma sbyangs pas// bden gnyis zab mo'i don ma phig// zab mo'i bka' zhen phyogs drengs// rigs byed lha ga spyod la sogs pa'i| |log par smra ba du ma byung*// ces so// gsum pa rtag chad gnyis su 'dus tshulani/ yang kha cig stong pa'i don la nyi tsher ltas 271) /pas/ rgyu 'bras 'gog par 'dod cing*/ lus las/ dngos po 'di dag blos brtags nas/ dngos po mtshan mar brtags par 'dod pa yin te/ lungalas/ nyi tshe'i stong pa kho na lta// la las rnam par rtags pa yis/ bdag rtags dngos po mtshan mar smra// ces so// bzhi pa bka'i dgongs don mi khrol ba ni// la la dag shes rab zab mo'i don dang mi ldan pas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' zab mo'i dgongs don ma khrol bas/ grub mtha' log pa'i lta ba sna tshogs 'byung ba'o// de nyid las/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa 'di// zab cing rgya che dpag dka' bas// yin snyam spyod pas ma phig ste// log pa'i lta ba sna tshogs 'dzin// ces so// lnga pa'i bstan pa 'di/ gong gis de rnams/ sems phyin ce log gi lta ba la zhugs kyang*/ lus nang pa'i tshul rtags 'dzin pa dag yod de/ lang 272) kar gshegs pa las/ nga'i bstan pa sus 'byin pa// ngur smig gis ni gos gyon pa'i// 'bras bu yod dang med smra ba// ma 'ongs phyi ma'i dus su ni// 'bras bu med ces smra ba ni// skyi bo mang po brlag par byed// ces pa dang*/ spyi chings las/ sems can log pa'i lam du zhugs// lus kyi sangs rgyas rtags 'dzin pas// rtag tsam 'dzin ces de la bya// ces so// drug pa ni/ tshul rtags 'dzin pa nang pa'i nang nas kyang yod par bstan pa ni/

ston pa shākya thub pa'i bstan pa sde snod gsum la sogs pa rnams nub du nye bas/ snyigs ma'i dus la babs da'i dus su/ tshul rtags 'dzin pa'i 'gro bde/ ding sang nang par khas ches ba rnams kyis nang na'ang mang bar bshad de/ lung las/ shākya seng ge'i bstan pa brgas/ snyigs ma'i dus la ding sang babs// rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i 'gro ba de// ding sang 273) /nang pa'i nang na mang*// ces so// bzhi pa lung phyogs 'dzin pa la gnyis te/ spyi dang*/ bye brag gau/ dang po ni/ rgyal ba'i bka' ling las byung ba'i// lung gis phyogs tsam 'dzin kyang*/ grangs dang lta ba nor ba'i phyogs su song ba'i mu stegs pa ni| rang gis 'dod phyogs su zhen nas/ 'khrul pa'i mthar lhung ste/ gtan tshigs rang gis grub mtha' la zhen nas/ mkhas rtogs tshad ma rnams kyis bkag kyang ldog par dka' ste/ lung las/ lung gis phyaugs tsam 'dzin pa ni/ margyal ba'i bka'i zhor byung bas// phyogs mthun tsam las nor bar song// zhen phyogs 'khrul pa'i lam du zhugs// nga rgyal snyam pas zlog par dka'| |ces so// bye brag du phye na gnyis te/ lta bas las log pa dang*/ bhai pa las gol pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ spyi dang*/ bye 274) brag go dang po spyi la bzhi ste/ phyi rol pa dang*/ yang yag pa dang gsang sngags pa dang*/ gsang chen pa'o// dang po phyi rol pa ni/ theg pa chung duu las gol ba dang*/ yang dag pa ni/ dbu ma chen pi las gol ba dang*/ gsang sngags pa ni phyi rgyud sde gsum las gol ba dang*// gsang chen pa ni bla med rnam gsum las gol bo// phyi rol pa la yang gsum te/ bye brag pa dang*/ tha snyad pa dang*/ rang snang phyogs gcig pa'o// dang po bye brag pa ni/ nyan thos bye brag du smra ba las/ cha mthun tsam du gol te/ ci ltar gol na/ kun rdzob kyis snangab ni/ gug rnga'am/ ni'u sing gis bar bskor ba dang bcas pa rdzas can du 'dod pa dang*/ nang gi sems can skad cig cha med de/

gtso bo dbang phyug can du 'dod de/ phyi nang gnyis ka 'dus ma byas pa'i don dam par 'dod pa yin te/ gnyis pa tha snyad pa ni/ nyad thos mdo sde 275) pa la cha mthun tsam du gol te/ kun rdzob kyid snang ba 'di/ pu te'i bras kha'am/ bye ma'i phung po ltar 'dod pa de la/ dngos po rdzas grub 'dod cing*/ sems skad cig cha med 'di nyid/ gtso bo rtag pa'i rang bzhin can du 'dod/ phyi nang gnyis ka 'jig rten pa'i lha chen gyis byas par 'dod/ gsum par rang snang phyogs gcig pa ni/ rang sangs rgyas kyi lta ba la cha mthun tsam du gol te| ci ltar gol zhes na/ snang ba'i dngos po 'di/ brdul phra rags gang du yang ma grub par 'dod pa yin pa de la/ mu stegs pas de ltar ma rtog ste/ yul gyis snang ba 'di kun rdzob du yang med par rtogs shing*/ nang gi sems skad cig cha med de la bdag du ltas pas/ rang snang phyogs gcig pa zhes bya'o// deyang spyi chings las/ nyan thos bye brag mdo sde pa// rang sangs rgas kyi lta ba las/ 276) /cha mthun zhen pas log par song*/ ces gsungs so// yang dag pa la bzhi ste/ gang zag gsum gol tshul dang*/ spyod pa mthun pas gol ba dang| bdag nyid ma spangs pa'i skyon dang*/ log lta'i rnam grangs byung tshul lo// dang po ni/ phra ba pa dang*/ zab pa dang*/ rgya che yangs pa gsum po 'di dag sems tsam rnams bden pa dang/ phyi rol gyis snang ba 'di dag sems 'khrul pa'i snang ngor bden la/ don dam par mi bden par 'dod do/ de las gol ba'i mu stegs pa ni/ nang bdag rtags pa gcig pu ba ni bden la/ yul rdzun par 'dod pas phra ba pa zhes bya'o// gnyis pa sems tsam rnams rdzun pas yul gyis snang ba 'di rnams/ 'khrul ngos la rdzun par 'dod pa la/ de las gol ba'i mu stegs pa ni yul snang 'di rnams gtan nas med par 'dod pas zab pa zhes bya'o// gsum pa dbul ma chen po bas/ kun rdzub kyi chos thams/

277) /cad sgyu ma rmi lam lta bu la/ don dam par stong zhing bdag med du 'dod pa las/ de las gol ba'i mu stegs pa tshangs pa 'dra ba'i rjes su 'brang pa'i/ gsang ba'i grub mtha' smra ba dag ni/ 'gro ba'i shes rig bdag gcig pu rang dbang can yin te// rnam par rtog pa'i 'khrul pa zad nas/ bum pa chag pas nam mkha' chen por 'dus pa ltar/ srog kyang de bzhin du 'dus par bshad do| |de yang lus las/ yang dag pa la rnam gsum te/ phra ba zab pa rgya cher yang*// 'di dag sems tsam rnams bden rdzun// dbu' ma chen po'i lta ba la// cha mthun tsam gyis log par sing*// ces so// gnyis pa spyod pa mthun pas gol tshul ni/ gang gi gang zag gsum pos/ nang gis sems tsam dba' ma pa dang*/ gsum po'i spyod pa las mthun te/ bdag 278) med rnam pa gnyis ma rtogs bas/ lta ba ce lta zab pa'i tshig smras kyang*/ don la gol ba yin te/ lus las/ spyod pa phyogs mthun tsam du zhugs// ci tsam tsab pa'i tshig brjod kyang*// ces so// gsum pa bdag nyid ma spangs pa'i skyon ni/ gong gis spyod pa nang pa dang cha mthun kyang*/ lta ba gzung 'dzin gyis bdag nyid ma spangs pas/ bhai ba ting 'dzin kyang nor ba'i rjes su 'brang ba yin te/ lung las/ bdag 'dzin gnyis po ma spangs pas// bsam gtan nor ba'i lam du zhugs// ces so// bzhi pa log lta'i rnam grangs 'byung tshul ni/ gang zag gsum dang*/ gol bzhi gsum te/ rtsa ba drug po 'di las gyes pa'i rgyu'i theg pa log pa'i lta ba mang du byung ba yin te/ lung las| rtsa ba 'di las gyes pa yin// log pa'i lta ba mang du byung*// ces so// gsang sngags pa la gsum te/ gang zag gsum 279)/rgyud las gol tshul dang*/ lta spyod log pa'i skyon dang*/ de las log rtog gos grangs su ma byung tshul lo// dang po ni/ rigs byed pa dang*/ rigs spyod pa dang*/ rigs spyor ba'o// dang po ni/ bya rgyud pa 'di ltar du snang ba'i dngos po thams cad rigs gsum gyis dkyil 'khor du 'dod cing*/

don dam pa dag pa mtha' bzhi'i dra ma dang bral bar 'dod pa las log pa'i mu stegs rigs byed pa ni/ khrus dang gtsang sbra la gtso bor byed ceng*/ don ma rtogs yid smon shor bas rigs byed pa zhes bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ spyod rgyud las/ kun rdzob thoms cad rigs bzhi'i dkyol 'khor dang*/ don dam par stong zhing bdag med kyis rang bzhig du 'dod pa la/ de las gol ba'i mu stegs pa ni/ kun rdzob kyis snang ba la dngod po lta zhing*/ don dam par bdag du lta bas/ rigs spyod pa zhes bya'o/ 280) /gsum pa ni/ yo ga pas yul dbyings dang*/ sems ye shes gnyis dbyer med du 'dod pa de/ de las gol ba'i mu staigs pa ni/ don dam stong pa nyid/ tshe ba skye mched mu bzhi'i snyoms 'jug dang*/ kun rdzob smra ba rang rgyud par ltas pas/ rigs sbyor ba zhes bya'o// de yang lung las/ gsang sngags pa la rnam gsum te// rigs byed rigs spyod rigs sbyor ba// bya ba spyod pa rnal 'byor las// lta ba spyod pa bsam gtan dag// cha mthun rtsams te don la gol// ces so// gnyis pa lta spyod log pa ni/ gong gi de rnams bdag du 'dzin pa'i 'khrul pa la zhen nas/ shākya thub pa'am/ rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas sam/ rigs gsum mgon po'i dkyil 'khor du/ snang bas gol te/ gang du gol na thams cad kyis bdag nyid thob bya'i 'bras bu smra ba las gol te/ 'jig rten pa'i phya dang dbang phyug gi go 281) /'phangs thob par 'dod de/ rigs byed kyis smra 'dod sogs pas/ lus ngag gi dka' ba ci spyad kyang*/ 'khrul snang gis zhen pa ma spongs pas/ 'khor ba'i 'thags las thar bar gsum ste*// lung las/ 'dzin pa'i zhen 'khrul mtha' la zhen// bder gshegs sprul sku'i snang ba las// phya dang dbang phyug dag du 'khrul// rigs byed smra 'dun la sogs pa// dka' tub dka' spyad ci bsgrubs kyang*// zhes pa'i mun pa ma dang pas// 'khor ba nyid du skye mang rgyud// ces so// gsum pa log lta'i rnam grangs ni/

gsang sngags phyi rgyud las gol ba'i log lta mang du 'byung bar gsungs te/ lung las/ lta ba 'di las gyes pa yi// log pa'i lta ba du ma byung// ces so// gsang ba la gnyis te/ spyi dang*/ bye brag go/ spyi las gsum te/ gang zag gsum gol tshul dang*/ longs sku dang spyod pa las 282) gol tshul dang*/ de'i skyon no// dang po ni/ rtul zhugs cher spyod pa dang*/ rgyal dpog pa dang*/ rgyal 'thab pa gsum te/ bskyed pa ma hā yo ga dang*/ rdzogs pa a nu yi ga dang*/ rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga gsum las/ lta ba dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gsum la ltos te 'khrul pa'o// lung las/ gsang che pa la rnam gsum te// brtul shugs cher spyong pa dang ni// rgyal dpog pa dang rgyal 'thabs pa// bskyed dang rdzogs dang rdzogs chen las// lta ba spyod pa'o ting 'dzin las// 'dra' mthun tsam gyis ltos te 'khrul pa'o// ces so// gnyis pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku las gol chul ni/ nang pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'o gsaku gzugs la ltos nas/ khyab 'jug la deng ge'i mgo' yod pa dang*/ tshangs pa 'ahig rten thams cad skyed par byed pa dang*/ 283) /ladar mthun tsan gyis sbyor sgrol la sogs pa'i spyod pa rang rgyud du spyad pas/ 'jig rten pa'i lha la longs skur zhen nas/ mtho' ris thar pa dang bral nas/ rtogs spyod phyin log gis dka' thub spyad de/ rang gis bsam yul du 'bras bu thob par 'dod pa dang*/ spyod pa rnam smin drag po las/ bsags pas ya mtshan zhes grags pa'o// lung las/ bder gshegs longs sku'i gzugs brnyan las| |seng ge dang ni 'phrog byed dang*// dbyig gis snying po dag du 'khral// 'dra mthun spyod kyang*// 'dra mthun spyod pa ci spyod kyang*// sgro 'dogs zheno ma spangs pas| |thar pa'i 'bras bu mi myong ste// rtogs spyod log pa'i dka' thub can// bsam pa'i 'bras bu dag par bzhed// spyod ba yang yang sna tshogs byed// 'di dag ya mtshan can zhes grags*// ces so// bye brag du phye ba la gsum te/

brtul zhugs cher spyod pa dang*/ rgyal 284) dpog pa dang*/ rgyal 'theb pa'o// dang po ka gsum te/ gol bzhi dang*/ gol ba'i ngo bo lta spyod gzhan la gnod pa dang*/ log zhen phra mo la bden par zhen pa'o// dang po mu stegs brtul zhugs cher spyod kyis gol bzhi ni/ gsang sngags ma hā yo ga'i thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i ngang nas/ thugs rjes gzhan don rlabs po che/ thun mong ma yin pa yan lag dam tshig gis/ bdag gzhan gnyis ka'i don bsgrub pa las/ ltos pa'i cha mthun tsam las gol zhing 'khrul pa'o// de yang lung las/ rtul zhugs pa ni gsang sngags kyis// thabs kyis mardzad pa'i spyod pa yis/ bdag gzhan gnyis ka'i don bsgrub pas// de'i cha mthun tsam las 'khrul// ces so// gnyis pa gol ba'i ngo bo lta spyod gzhan la med pa ni/ 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid kyis don nim rtogs/ sbyor sgrol sogs pa rtul zhugs kyis spyod 285) /pa cha mthun tsam du spyod pas/ bdag gzhan gnyis kas bde 'gro la sogs pa'i 'bras bu mi thob ste/ lung las/ mnyam pa'i lta ba ma rtogs shing*// brtul zhugs gsabayod ba cha mthun spyad// bdag gzhan gnyis ka chud bsan te// phal cher mtho ris mi myong ste*// thar pa'i 'dabaras bu ga la srid*/ ces co/ gsum pa log zhen phra mo la bden par 'dzin pa ni/ 'jig rten pa'i lha chen la zhen nas de nyid kyis mthu' ltas pas*/ gzhan skabs su thun mo nga gis dngos grub snang ngos/ nor ngos 'phel chu la mi bying ba la sogs pa 'byung bas ya mtshan du lta'o/ lung las/ log 'atas pas zhen pa'i mthun brtas pas/ 'jig rten dngos grub phra mo dag /'byung bar 'a gyur zhing ya mtshan skye// ces so// gnyis pa rgyal dpog pa la lnga ste/ gol bzhi dang*/ gol ba'i ngo bo dbyings ye shes gnyis las gol tshul/ gol ba'i skyon dang*/ gol tshul 286) gyis rbam grangs sngon nas dbayung tshul lo// da lta nang pa'i bhai chen pa la yang yid par bstan pa'o// dang po mu stegs rgyal dpog pa'i gol bzhi ni/

rjes su rnal 'byor lung a nu yo ga'i lta bhai spyod gsum la cha mthun gyis 'khrul te/ lung las/ rgyal dpog rjes su rnal 'byor las*| |cha mthun tsam gyis 'khrul pa ste// ces so/ gnyis pa dbyings ye shes las gol tshul ni// lung gis dgongs pa chos dbyings skye ba med cing zad mi shes pa de las/ gtso bo bems po chos sku nyid du gzung nas 'khrul te/ skye 'gags thams cad bral ba'i ye shes de la ni| nang gis bdag rtag pa shes rig gis skyes bu zhes bya bar gzung nas 'khrul pa'o// lung las/ chos nyid nam mkha' mu med las| |gtso' bo bes po nyid du 'khrul// med la mo zad ye shes las// nang gis skyes bu byed par 'khrul// ces so// gsum pa 287) /gol ba'i skyon ni/ rgyal gdapog pa de nyid kyis lta ba las/ gtso' bo skyes bu de nyid dbyer med do/ zhes zab pa'i tshul du/ dbyings su shes dbyer med du 'dod kyang*/ yang dag pa'i lta ba dbyings ye shes kyi dgongs don ma rtogs te// ngan 'gro sdug bsngal gyis gnas su yang yang 'khyams te/ lung las/ zab pa'i tshul du smra byas kyang*// yang dag don chen ma rtogs pas// srid par 'khor ba'i gnas su 'khyams/ ces so// gol ba'i rnam grangs sngon nas byung tshul ni/ lung a nu yo ga'i lta ba la gol ba'i lta ba 'di bye brag lasam/ zab mor bcos pa'i log lta'i grangs kyang mang du 'byung bar bshad de/ lung las/ lta ba 'di yi bye brago las// zab bcod lta ba grangs mang byung*// ces so// lnga pa da ltar ba'i bhai chen pa'i nang du mang bar bstan pa ni/ rgyal dpog pa'i lta ba 'dzin 288) pa'i rnal 'byor pa la la ni/ da ltar nang pa'i bhai chen pa'i nang na yod par gsungs te/ lung las/ phal chen da lta ba'i bhai chen ba// bhai chen rnams kyis nang du mang*// ces so// gsum pa rgyal 'thabs pa la gnyis te/ spyi dang*/ bya brag go /dang po ka gsum te/

gol bzhi dang*/ gol ba'i ngo bo dang*/ gol ba'i rnams grangs so// dang po ni/ shin tu rnal 'byor rdzogs pa chen po las gol ba'i mu stegs rgyal 'thab pa ni/ gong ma'i lta bhai spyod pa las/ phyogs mthun gyis 'khrul te/ lung las/ rgyal 'thab shin tu rnal 'byor las// mthun pa'i phyogs gcig 'khrul pa ste/ ces so// gnyis po gol ba'i ngo bo gnyis te/ lta ba las gol ba dang*/ 'bras bu las gol ba'o// dang po la gsum te/ bden pa gnyis las log par rtogs cing gsang ba smra dang*/ khams gsum pa yang de dang mtshul par 289) rtogs pa dag las kyi rnam par smin pa'i 'dod tshul lo// dang po ni/ rgyal 'thab pa de dag gis lta ba ni/ kun rdzob sgyu ma rmi las lta bu las/ rang rgyud par gzung zhing*/ don dam par brten med stong pa nyid dang khun rdzob kyis bden pa gnyis do 'brel pa med par smra ste/ gang zag so so skye bo sems kyi rang bzhin/ bdag rtag pa'i skyes baya zhes bya ba yod de/ spyod yul du ma gyur ba zhes brjod pa nyid do// de yang lung las/ de dag kun gyis lta ba ni// kun rdzob sgyu'i rten 'brel dang*/ don dam de med brten pa'ang med/ gang zag sems kyis rang bzhin las// bdag gcig yod de dngos ma gyur// 'di zhes bya ba'i khas len med// ces so// gnyis pa khams gsum po de dang mtshungs pa ni/ khams gsum gyis sems can 'di dag kyang*/ kun rdzog kyis rten 'brel gong bzhin du lta zhing*/ thams cad 290) sems kyis rang bzhin bdag rtag pa shes rig skyes bu zhes bu zhes bya bar de nyid/ rang bi snying gi dkyil du kha dog dkar la mtsher ba bsnums ka 'dril ba nyid sems can rang rang gis ngos yid dang mtshams par 'dod cing*/ de dus gsum du rtag bar 'dod de/ lung las| khams gsum sems can 'di dag rnams// kun rdzogs don dam gong ma bzhin// kun gyi sems kyi rang bzhin la// bdag re yod de dngos mgyur// ces so// las kyi rnam par smin pa ni/

gong gi log lta de rnams kyis/ dge' ba dang*/ sdig pa'i'abras kyi rnam smun rnams/ rang gis blo yul du 'dod na yod cing mi 'dod na med do// lung las/ dkar nag las kyis rnam smin dag// 'dod na yod de mi 'dod med*/ ces so// gnyis pa 'bras bu la gol tshul ni/ chos sku las dol ba dang*/ gzugs sku las 291)/gol ba'o// dang po ni a te yo ga'i dgongs pa chos sku ka dag gis ngo bo/ gzung 'dzin rnams kyis mtshan ma dang bral ba'i ngo bo de la blo rtags kyis snang ba la// rang phyogs kyis 'bras bu thob pa'i tshe/ rig pa ye shes med cing dngos po dang mtshan ma med pa'i nam mkha' sprin dang bral ba lta bu de la/ chog sku thob pa zhes brjod de// lung las/ 'bral bu mngon sum thob pa'i tshe// rig pa med das ye shes med// dngos po med pas dngas pa min/ sprin med nam mkha' dngas pa ltar// gyur nas chos sku yin zhes brjod// ces so// gnyis pa gzugs sku las gol bar song ba rnams bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis thugs rjes 'dul bar mdzad pa de rnams la| /ye shes dang thugs rjes med par 'dod ceng*/ gdul bya dang 'dul byed rnams kyis sgyu ma'i skyes bu dang mtshungs par/ rang rang gis/ 292) /blos rtogs par byed de/ lung las/ bder gshegs thugs rje'i mdzad pa rnams// rig pa med cing ye shes med// snang nyid sgyu ma'iskyes bu mtshungs// phal cher rang gis rtogs par smra/ ces so// gol ba'i rnam grangs ni/ gong gis rgyal 'thab pa'i log par rtogasapa'i rnam grangs mang du 'byung ste/ lung las/ de 'dra lta ba bye brag rnams/ cha mthun log pa mang po 'byung*// ces so// gnyis pa gol ba'i rnam grangs la lnga ste/ chad par lta ba'i rnam grangs dang ma/ rtag par lta ba'i rnam grangs dang*/ log par lta ba bzhi dag*/ nang pa la yang lta ba ngan pa yod par bstan pa dang*/ log par rtogs pa'i skyon no// dang po ni mi stegs chad lta ba dag gis*/

tshe snga ma'i las med| da lta ba ni blo bur ba/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu med pas/ rgyu chad par 'dod pa 'dod pa dang*/ tshe phyi ma med par 'dod ceng*/ sangs rgyas 293) /kyi sku dang ye shes yang med par 'dod pas/ 'bras bu chad par lta ba de// des na snga ma'i rgyu yod pa phyi ma med par 'dod pa dang*/ rags pa yod pa la phra ba mar par 'dod dang / sangs rgyas than pa med cing stong pa byang phyad du 'dod pa'o// spyi chings las| rgya nyid chad par rtogs pa dang*// rgya'i cha gcig chad par rtogs// 'bras bu chad par rtogs pa dang*// rgyu 'bras kun du chad par rtogs| chad par lta ba'i rnam grangs yin// ces so// gnyis pa rtag par lta ba ni/ yang mu stegs rtog par lta ba'i 'dod pa/ gtso' bo dang skyes bu rtag la/ de las byung ba'i rtags pa'o// sangs rgyas thob nas kyang las nag po'i 'bras bu 'byung ngo// zhes zer ba'i/ rgyu rtags par 'dod pa rtags par rtogs pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i phyogs gcig rtag par rtogs// rgu 'bras kum tu rtag par rtogs/ 294) /rtags par lta ba'i rnam grangs yin// ces so// gsum pa log par rtogs pa bzhi ni// gong gis rgyu 'bras chad par 'dod pa dang*/ rtags par 'dod pa'i bye brag ni/ log lta spyi'i grangs yin te/ gang las log na 'bras bu blan med pa'i theg pa las log pa yin te/ sbyi bcings las/ rtag dang chad pa'i byi brag rnams// log lta can gyis rnam grangs te// bla med thegs pa las log yin// ces so| |nang pa la yang log lta 'dzin ba yod pa ni/ gong gis rtag chad kyis lta ba yod pa ni/ snyigs ma tha ma'i dus su/ rdo rje theg pa khas blangs pa'i rnal 'byor pa kha cig// thos bsam gnyis kyi shes rab la ma sbyangs pa'i/ rnal 'byo dam par khas blang ba yang mang ste/ lud las/ lta ba'i bye brag gong ma ni// da lta snyigs ma'i ding sang la// gsang sngags theg par khas che ba'i// shes rab gnyis

295) /la ma sbyangs ba'i// de dag kun gyis nang na mang*// ces so// lnga pa log pa'i skyon ni/ gong go lta log de rnams/ lta ba zab mo yin pa'i tshul smra kyang/ bdag du zhen pa'i rtogs pa ma spangs pas/ srid pa'i 'khor ba'i gnas su 'khor ba ste/ lung las/ log pa'i lta ba zab mo dag// shin tu zab pa'i tshul smras kyang*/ zhen pa'i mtha' gnyis ma spangs pas// srid pa'i gnas su yang yang 'khor// ces gsungs so// gnyis pa bhai pas gol ba la gnyis te/ gol ba'i ngo bo dang*/ gol ba'i skyon no// dang po ni/ gong gis gsang sngags bla med kyi lta ba las gol ba'i/ bhai pa ting nge 'dzin kha cig ni/ zhi gnas las gol ba'i snyoms 'jug kun gzhi rig rtogs pa de la brtan pa thob kyang*/ lhag mthong med pas/ skye mched mud pas/ skye mched mu bzhi la sogs pa'i/ 296) gnas su skyes shing*/ gzhan yang yid kyis dbang po gsal rtogs kyis rtogs med dang*/ sgo lnga snang thog gis rtogs med las sogs pa la brten bcas nas/ bla ma mtshan ldan gyis dmas das ma zin cing*/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i drod dang rtags dang mi ldan pas| rtogs med gsum la 'bras bu brlom pa dag yod de/ lung las/ bsam gtan bye brag kha cig gis// 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug dang*// skye mched bzhi sogs skyen ni// sngon gyis mkhas pa ma rten pas// 'bras bu nyid du yang dag brloms| |ces so// gnyis pa gol ba'i skyon ni/ bsam gtan nor ba'i sgor zhugs rtogs med la brtan pa thob kyang*/ las kyi mtha' ma zad pas 'chi 'phos pa'i tshe/ bag chags 'khrul pas mtshams sbyar nas/ bar dor sdug bsngal shar ba'i dus/ ston pa 297)sangs rgyas dang*/ bstan pa dge ba'i shes gnyen dang bcas pa rnams la skur pa btab pas/ mnar med rdi rje dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ro// ces so// blo gros rgya mtsho' zhus pa'i mdo' las/ ye shes rgyas pa'i mngo' las gsungs so| |bzhi pa mu stegs ba de rnams lam 'tshol gtan tshigs la bzhi ste/
kha cig ni/ 'khor lo rgyun gyis theg pa la brten nas lam

lam 'tshol ba dang*/ kha cig ni gzugs brnyan gyi chos la brtag da pyad byas nas lam 'tshol ba dang*// dang po ni/ nang pa la dga' ba'i phyi rol pa kha cig skye mtsho' brten sogs la gnas pas/ 'khor lo rgyun gyis theg pa'i gdul bya yin te/ gtan tshigs chi zhe na/ 298) lam tshol ba'i sems rtogs kyi 'du shes yod pa'i phyir na 'bras bu tshol ba'i gzhan phyogs can zhes bya ste/ lung las/ phyi rol lta ba 'di dag rnams// 'khor lo rgyud kyis gdul bya ste// sems la rtogs pa thob pa yis/ 'bras bu tshol gzhan phyogs can// ces so| |gnyis da ni/ yang kha cig sprul sku mya ngan la 'das nas/ bstan pa nub du nye ba'i tshe/ bstan pa de nyid la brtag dpyad byas pa'i sgo nas 'gyur zhing*/ lam du 'jug pa'ang yod de/ lung las/ sprul pa ma 'das yi/ bstan pa rgas par gyur pa'i tshe// rtog spyod log pa'i 'khrul pa can// ces so// gsum pa ni/ yang log par zhugs pa kha cig ni/ thabs mkhas pa'i byang chub sems dpal log pa'i dpal rnams kyis/ skal dan=man thabs kyi lam du zhugs nas/ lam tshol ba dag kyang yod de/ lung las/ log par gyur pa 'ga' 299) /zhig ni// sangs rgyas ston pa thabs mkhas pas// skal dman thabs kyi zhugs pa'i phyir// lam tshol ba yi thabs su bstan// ces so// bzhe pa ni/ theg pa dgu'i zhor las byung ba'i mu stegs de dag ni/ nang pa'i theg pa'i zhor las byung ba'i zhal 'byung*/ ces skyang bya/ sangs rgyas snga ma'i bstan pa zhugs nas/ phyi ma gzhan rkyen log pa'i dbang du 'khrul pas/ sangs rgyas nyes gnas zhes kyang bya ste/ rnam grangs mngon byang gis rgyud las/ mu stegs can la smad mi bya// rnam par snang mdzad ring ba'i rgyu// ces gsungs so// mdo' sngas theg ba ṇams cad kyis shan 'byed nyi 'od rab gsal las/ ma rtogs log rtog gis rnam par dag pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o*// ༈ //gsum pa don dam nges pa'i theg pa la gnyis te/
