mdo' las/ rgyas pa'o// dang po la bzhi ste/ 300) theg pa dang gdul bya dang*/ 'dul thabs dang*/ de dag so sor sdeb tshul lo// dang po la gsum ste/ kun 'byung 'dren pa'i theg pa dang*/ dka' thub rig byed kyi theg pa dang*/ nang pa dbang bsgyur thabs kyi theg pa'o// de ltar yang*/ kun 'byung 'dren dang dka' thub rig /dbang bsgyur thabs rig byed kyi theg pa'o/ ces so// gdul bya gsum ni/ gdul bya'i skabs kyang gsum nyid de/ blo'i bskal pa che chung las// dam na dang 'bring dang chen po'o// ces so// 'dul thabs gsum ni/ de nyid las/ de'i 'dul thabs gsum yin te/ gnyen pos spongs dang thabs kyis bsgyur*// ye shes chen pa'o gnas su dag /ces so// so sor sder tshul ni/ de nyid las/ gdul bya 'dul thabs theg pa gsum// so sor sprad de sdeb par bya// ces so// gnyis pa rgyas par bstan pa la gsum ste/ theg dgu'i lung rgyas par 301) /bshad pa dang*/ de dag gi yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o/ dang po la gsum ste/ theg pa dgur dbye' ba dang| 'dul thabs dgur dbye ba dang*/ de dag so so sdeb tshul lo// dang po ni/ gong gis theg pa gsum po re re las gsum gsum du 'byed pa byed pa nyid de/ de gsum re re la'ang gsum ste/ tha ma 'bring dang mchog gis tshul// des na theg pa dgu' zhes grags/ ces gsungs so// gnyis pa de dga' 'dul ba'i thabs ni/ kun 'byung 'dren pa'i theg pas/ nyon mongs pa'i gnyen po thabs kyis sbyang ba dang*/ dka' thub rig byed kyis theg pas nyon mongs pas nyon mongs pa nyid dag pa lha'i dkyil 'khor du sgyur ba dang*/ dbang bsgyur thabs kyi theg pas nyon mongs pa ma sbang par ye shes chen po'i ngang du dag par byed pa ste/ de nyid las/ thabs kyang de bzhin bye brag dgu// ces so// gsum pa ni/ de dag gis 302) grangs so sor sprad pas/ dgu gsum nyi shu rtsa bdun sdeb da yin te/

de nyid las/ dgu' gsum nyi shu rtsa bdun de sdeb/ ces so// gnyis pa yan lag rgyas par bshad par bshad la gsum ste/ mdo' dang*/ rgyas pa'o// dang po ni/ kun 'byung 'dren pa'i theg pa yang*/ gdul bya'i stabs kyis gsum du dbye ba yin te/ de nyid las// dang po yang 'di lta ste/ ces so/ rgyas par bshad pa la gsum ste/ nyan thos kyis theg pa dang*/ rang sangs rgyas kya theg pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpal pa'i theg pa'o// dang po nyan thos kyi theg pa la yang gsum ste// mdo' dang*/ rgyas bshad*/ lung gis don bsdu ba'o/ dbang po tha ma nyan thos kyis theg pa ni/ de yang de nyid las*/ tha ma'i tha ma 'di lta ste/ gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la bdun te/ 'jug sgo dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ sbyod pa dang*/ tshul 303) /khrims dang*/ lam yun dang*/ 'bras bu'o// dang po 'jug sgo la gnyis te/ spyi dang*/ bye brag go /chos spyi'imatshan nyid bzhi ste/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa/ srid par 'khor ba thams cad sdug bsngal ba/ khams gsum thams cad stong pa/ chos thams cad bdag med pa dang*/ bzhi'o// phyi rol pas ni phung po la/ bdag du 'dzin pa dang*/ mi gtsang ba'i lus la gtsang bar 'dzin pa dang*/ sdug bsngal la bde bar 'dzin pa dang*/ 'dus byas rtag par 'dzin pa yin te/ nang pa ni/ de las log par 'dod de/ sangs rgyas theg pa'i bka' rtags kyis phyag bzhi ste/ theg pa spyi'i'ajug sgo'o// spyi chings las/ mi rtag sdug bsngal stong bdag med// bdag tsam spyi rtag las zlog pa/ sangs rgyas theg pa spyi'i sgo/ ces so// gnyis pa ni/ nyan thos gang gi sgor 'jug na/ 'khor ba'i 304) 'bras bu sdug bsngal du shes pa/ 'khor ba'i rgyu kun 'byung spang byar shes pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'bras bu 'gog pa thob byar shes pa/ de nyid mngon du byed pa'i lam bhai par bya ba ste/ nyan thos kyis theg pa'i 'jugasgo yin par 'dod de/ spyi bcings las/

sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'gogs pa la lam// ces gsungs pas/ de yang lun 'byung spangs bar bya// sdug bsngal shes par bya/ lam rgyud la rten par bya/ 'bras bu 'gogs pa thob par bya// zhes pa/ kun 'byung la yang bzhi ste/ rgyu kun 'byung*/ rkyen gyis rnam pa/ rab du bskye ste/ rdzogs pa chen po sa lam klong las/ de rgya las nyon mongs phung po'i sa bon ltar/ de las rgyu drug khams gsum 'byung ba'o// bag chags brtas shing mngon par smin byed rkyen// rgyu rkyen 'bral bas khams gsum rab tu skye// ces pas/ ma rig nyon mongs las kyis khams gsum 305) /rgyur gyur pas rgyu dang*/ de las rgyu drug kun 'byung bas kun 'byung dang*/ bag chags kyis zhen pa ltas shing 'bras bu smun pas rkyen dang*/ rgyu rkyen 'brel bas khams gsum du skye zhing*/ 'khor bar rab du skye'o// ces so// sdug bsngal ba la bzhi ste/ mi rtag pa dang*/ sdug bsngal ba dang*/ stong pa dang*/ bdag med pa'o// de nyid las/ rkyen gyis skye zhing rang dbang med mi rtag/ gsum mam brgyad kyis gnod pas sdug bsngal ba'o// bdag gis lta ba mi mthun phyogs stong pa// lnga phung bdag du ltar med stong pa nyid// ces pas/ dus skad cig mar mi sdod pas mi rtag pa dang*/ gsum mam brgyad kyis sdug bsngal bas sdug sngal ba dang*/ gang zag gis dngos do stong par stong pa dang*/ gang zag bdag med pas bdag med pa'o// ces so// 'khor ba la bzhi ste/ 'gog pa/ zhi ba 306)gya nom pa/ nges par 'byung ba'o// so lam klong las/ rgyu rkyen bral bas phung khams 'jig phyir 'gogs// sdug bsngal med pas bsam mi 'byung zhing gnas// phyis kyang khams gsum sdug bsngal bral rgyal lam// don dam bde ba phyin te skyon las nges pa 'byung*// ces gsungs so| |khams gsum sdug bsngal che 'bring 'jogs shing*/ de'i 'bral bu 'gog pa dang*/ nang du nyon mongs pa'i me ro zhi bas zhi ba dang*/

gnas skabs kyi yon tan thob pas gya nim dang*/ mthong ba bhai pa la sogs rang rang gis don rtogs shing thob pas nges par 'byung ba'o// lam gyi bdeg pa la bzhi ste/ lam rig sgrub pa/ nges pa/ 'byin pa'o// de nyid las/ 'phags pa'i sa zhugs myang 'das grol lam las// 'khrul pa'i gnyin por chos nyid ma gyur rigs// phyin ci log spangs yang dgathob phyir sgrub// 'khor bar mi skye 'das pa nges par 'byin/ 307) /ces pas/ so so skye bo las blo 'phags shing*// mya ngan las 'das pa'i sar 'gro bas lam dang*/ skad cig rang gsal gyi don rtogs pas/ 'dzin pa'i 'khrul pa'i 'khrul pa bcoms nas rig pa dang*/ blo rab 'bring rnams nyams su len pas sgrub pa dang*/ 'khor ba las grol zhing mya ngan las 'das pa thob pas nges par 'byin pa'o// lta ba la bzhi ste/ sbrul pa sku'i nyan thos dang*/ tshul rtags 'dzin pa'i nyan thos dang*/ grub pa mthar phyin gyis nyan thos dang*/ gzhung 'dzin pa'i nyan thos dang*/ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ theg dman gyis gdul bya'i ched du/ nyan thos su sprul pa ste*/ kun dga' bo phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa dang*/ rab 'byor spyan ras gzigasadang*/ sha ri'i bu 'jam dpal dbyangs su sprul pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa tshul rtags 'dzin pa ni/ smon 'jug sems bskyed 308) yod kyang*/ nyan thos kyis tshul rtags 'dzin cing nyan thos dang mthun par smra ba'o// gsum pa mthar grub pa mthar 'dzin la gnyis te/ nyan thos kyi ris ma nges pa dang*/ nges pa'o/ snga ma ni/ da lta nyan thos kyis lam la gnas kyang*/ lam bor nas theg chen du gyur ba yin ta/ 'di la'ang so so skye bo dang 'phags pa gnyis yod de// dang po ni/ nyan thos drod rtse la gnas pa theg chen du gyur ba yin te/ bzod 'bring du gnas pas rang sangs rgyas su 'gyur srid pa yin te/ mdzod las/ gnyis pa slob rig las log nas ni// sangs rgyas su'agyur gzhan gsum las// ces so// de yang phyis nas sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba dpal 'phreng gis zhus pa'i mdo' las/

nyan thos su 'gyur nas rang sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro// yis nas sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro/ ces gsungs so// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ 'dod chags 309) dang ma bral ba gnyis so// dang po ni/ nyan thos 'phags pa'i gang zag 'dod chags ma bral ba te/ rgyun zhugs dang*/ lan cig phyir 'og ba gnyis te/ de gnyis smon las gyi stobs kyis/ 'dod khams su skye ba mtshan nyid pa lon/ gnyis pa 'dod chagad dang bral ba ni/ phyir mi 'ong ba ste/ 'dod khams su skye ba'i rgyu/ 'dod khams kyis nyon mongs pa dgu spongs pas/ der skye ba mtshan nyid pa mi len kyang*/ sbrul pa'i lus kyis sems can gyis don byed do/ de gnyis 'phags pa'o lam thob kyis 'dod khams su skye ba len pa de/ zab pas na bsam gyie mi khyab pa zhes bya'o// de yang las dang po ba theg chen du zhugs pa bas/ skal pa bzhi bcus sangs rgyas bul ba yin te/ sangs rgya ba'i rigs/ rang bzhin zhi ba 'dod pa yang yang goms pa'i ro// mdo sde rgyan las/ nyan thos ma nges 310) rnam gnyis te// theg don mthong dang ma mthong ba'o// don mthong 'dod chags bral ba dang*// 'dod chags bral min 'dir gnon pa'o// de nyid 'phags pa'i lam thob pa// srid pa dag du bsgyur phyir/ bsam gyid mi khyab 'gyur ba yi// skye ba dag ni yang dag ldan// gcig ni smon las dag gis na// skyeb rab tu sgyur bar byed// gcig shos phyir mi 'ong ba dang*// ldan phyir mi 'og ba dang*/ ldan phyir sprul pa rab du bsgrub// de ni yang dang yang du ni// rang sems kun du 'byung ldan pas/ mya ngan 'das pa mngon dga' phyir// rtogs pas bul ba yin par 'dod// ces so| |gsum pa rigs ma nges pa la gnyis te/ bye brag tu smra ba dang*/ mdo' sde pa'o// snang ba bcun pa las/ chos dang smra ba'i nyan thos la/ bye brag pa dang mdo' sde pa'o// phyi rol yul la brtsod byed cing*// shes pa skad cig snang ba mthan// ces pas/

nang 311) /skad cig phyi rdul phran du 'dod pa mthun la/ kun rdzog rags pa mi mthun te/ bye brag du smra bas/ rdul phran ma 'dres ne sing lta bur 'dod cing*/ gzung 'dzin gcer 'phrang du 'dod pa dag*/ gzhi lnga rdzas grub du dang*/ dus gsum rdzas yod du'o| |dang po rdul phran sil bu pa ni/ g.yag rnga dang ne sing gis tshul du 'dod pa yin te/ klu sgrub kyis g.yu' thang las/ kun rdzob bye brag 'dod zhugs nyid/ snod skyis rdzas rnams dngos po 'di// rdul phran sil bu phan tshun bar/ ma 'dres ne sing lta bu ste// mthu' 'am stobs kyis 'dus par 'dod// ces pas/ de yang*/ gzung 'dzin tha dang dus mnyam gcer 'phrad 'dod pa'o// gnyis pa ni| bzhi lnga rdzas grub du 'dod de/ snang ba gzugs kyi gzhi/ gtso bo sems las byung ba'i gzhi/ bden pa lus 312) kyi gzhi/ rtags pa 'dus ma byas kyis bzhi dang lnga'o/ dang po ni/ snang ba gzugs kyis chos bco lnga pa ste/ dbang po lnga/ yul lnga/ 'byung ba lnga/ thun mong du gyur pa'i yid dang bco lnga'o// gzugs kyi mtshan nyid ni gzhig cing gzhoms du rung ba'o// de yag rags pa gzugs su 'dod pa ni/ yil phan zhul reg du yod pa'o/ bcad pa gzugs su 'dod pa ni/ sgo lngas yul so sor bcad pa'o/ bdag pa gzugs su 'dod ba ni/ yid gzugs logs gzugs su snang ba rnams so// gtso bo sems kyi gzhi ni rnam shes tshogs drug go /'khor sems las byang ba'i gzhi ni/ sems 'byung lda bcu rtsa gcig go /drug rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa/ 'dod chags ma rig pa/ khong khro/ nga rgyal/ log rtog/ the tshom mo// nyi shu nye ba'i nyon mongs pa ni/ khro ba/ 'khon 'dzin/ chags sems/ tshigs pa/ phrag 213) /dog ser sna/sgyu yo'/ ེnam pa 'tshe ba/ ngo tsha med pa/ khrel med pa/ smugs pa/ rgod gam/ dad pa/ le lo/ bag med pa/ rjed pa/ g.yeng ba/ shes bzhin ma yin pa'o// gzhi gzhan du 'gyur ba ni/

'dod pa/ snyed pa/ rtogs pa/ spyod pa'o// lnga kun 'gro ba ni/ reg pa/ yid la byed pa/ tshor ba/ 'du shes/ sems dpa'o// yul so sor nges pa lnga ni/ 'dun pa mos pa/ dran pa/ ting nge 'dzin/ she'o/ bcu gcig dge ba ni/ dad pa/ ngo tsha shes pa/ khrel yod pa/ ma tshar pa/ zhe sdang med pa/ gti mug med pa/ brtson 'grus shen tu sbyangs pa/ bag yod pa/ gtong bsam rnam par mi 'tshe ba'o// 'du byas kyi gzhi ni nyer gsum ste/ thob pa dang*/ 'du shes nyams pa dang*/ 'gogs pa'i snyoms 'jug / 314) 'du shes bzhi'i snyoms 'jug srog gi dbang po/ rigs mthun pa/ skye ba/ gnas pa/ rgas pa/ mi rtag pa/ ming tshig/ yi ge so sor skye bo ste/ mi mthun pa'i 'du shes bcu gnyis dang*/ 'jug pa dang*/ so sor nges pa dang*/ 'byor zhing 'bres pa/ mgyogs pa/ go rims/ yul/ dus gcig grangs 'tshogs pa ste/ dgu ni cha mthun pa'o// brtan pa ma yin pa ni/ sems dang*/ sems 'byung*/ ngo bo ma yin pa'o/ rtag pa 'dus ma byas pa ni/ nam mkha'/ 'gog pa/ skad cig go/ gsum pa ni/ dus gsum rtag par rdzogs yod du 'dod de/ grangs can pa ltar/ rgyu 'bras rdzas gcig ni ma yin no// gnyis pa mdo sdepa ni/ phyi rdul phra rags 'dus pa'o gong bur 'dod de/ da ltar gyis gzung yul rags pa 'di/ don dam dngos po ma yin te/ 215) /'di rnam pa skyed byed kyi gzhi/ lkog gyur man rdzas lta gur 'dod pa'o/ g.yu' thang las/ mdo' sde kun rdzob phra rags rnams// 'dus pas snang ba gcig du 'dod*// ces pa dang*/ spyi chings las/ snod bcud rdul phran sol bu dang*// skad ceg cha med don dam pa dang*/ de la sogs pa'i bye brag ni// nyan thos theg pa'i lta ba yin// ces pas/ bye brag pas skad cig cha med don dam pa dang*/ rdu phran cha med kun rdzob ste/ skad cig cha shas med pa rgyun du gnas par 'dod de/ gzung 'dzin 'brel ba med bzhin du/ nya dang lcags kyu bzhin du/

blo rno med kyis gcer 'thong du 'dzin par smra'o/ mdo' sde las/ gzung 'dzin gnyis zhal bya gzhal byed kyis 'brel pa yod de/ rnam pa gzhan yul yin la/ gzhan byed 'dzin byed yin pas/ rnam bcas kyis yul 'dzon par 'dod/ 216) pa'o| |bzhi pa gzhung 'dzin pa'i nyan thos la bzhi ste/ phal chen pa dang*/ thams cad smra ba dang*/ gnas brtan pa dang*/ mang pos bskur ba'o// de las gyes pa sde pa bco brgyad de/ phal chen pa la'ang lnga ste/ shar gyis ri bo'i sde dang*/ nub kyis ri bo'i sde dang*/ 'jig rten smra pa'i sde pa'i sde dang*/ rtag par smra ba'i sde'o// yod par smra ba'i sde la bdun te/ gzhi thams ce yod par smra ba'i sde dang*/ 'od bsrung pa'i sde dang*/ chos gsungs pa'i dang*/ mang du ston pa'i dang*/ mang du thos pa'i dang*/ gos dmar can gyis dang*/ rnam par phye ste smra ba'i sde'o/ gnas brtam pa la gsum ste/ rgya byed tshal byas dang*/ 'jigs med rigs gnas dang*/ gtsug lag lam chen gyis sde'o// mang pos bskur ba la gsum ste/ sa sgron rig byed kyi sde dang*/ bsrung ba'i dang*/ gnas mang po'isde'o/ 317) /de dag gis nang nas/ bye brag pa dang mdo' sde pa bshad pa yang yod do// gsum pa ting nge 'dzin la gnyis te/ zag bcas kyi lam dang*/ zag med do// dang po la gnyis las/ tshogs lam ni/ nges 'byung gis bsam pa la brten nas/ nyan thos kyi sde snod la thos bsam gyis bden bzhi/ mi rtag lam bcu drag tsam rtogs par byas nas/ tshogs lam bzhi gsum bcu gnyis bhair byed do// mdzod las/ tshul gnas thos dang ting 'dzin pas/ bhai pa la ni rab tu sbyor// ces so// gnyis pa/ sbyor lam la/ drod/ rtse mo/ bzod pa/ chos mchog bzhi/ dang po gsum la che 'bring gsum gsum yod pas/ bzod chung man chad chos bcu drug po dmigs nas mtshungs par bhai/ bzod 'bring du lam 'gogs kun 'byung gis bzhi bzhi rim gyi dor nas/

chos mchog 318) la| skad cig re re las med pas/ dmigs nas mtshungs pa ste/ mdzod las/ ci ltar bzod chen skad cig la// gcig yin de ni chos kyi mchog /ces so// gnyis pa zag med la gnyis te/ mthang lam dang*/ bhai lam/ mthar phyin lam pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ zhugs pa dang*/ zhugs 'bras gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rgyun zhugs 'bras bu la zhugs pa ni/ mthong lam skad cig bco lnga mngon du gyur pa ste/ mdzod las/ de la skad cig bco lnga ni/ ma mthong mthong phyir mthong ba'i lam/ ces so// gnyis pa ni| rgyun zhugs 'bras bu la gnas pa ni/ mthong lam skad cig bco lnga drug la gnas pa de/ mdzod las/ bcu drug pa la de 'bras gnas| |ce so// 'dir ni mthong spangs ma lus pa spangs pa'o// bhai las la gnyis te/ lan cig phyir 'ong dang*/ phyir mi 'ong 319) /gnyis so// phyir 'ong la gnyis las/ dang po 'bras zhugs ni/ 'dod khams kyis bhai spangs che 'bring dgu yod pa'i| che rims nas lnga man chad spangs pa ste/ mdzod las/ rnam par lnga'i bar com nas/ gnyis pa la ni zhugs pa yin// ces so// gnyis pa 'bras bu la gnas pa ni/ bhai spangs drug spangs pa ste/ mdzod las/ rnam par drug po zad gyur pa// de ni lan cig phyir 'ong pa'o// ces so// 'di la bye brag 'bras gnas khyad par/ che ba bdun nas brgya zad pas// tshe gcig bar chad gcig zad pa// ces pa/ lha mi tshe gcig la dgra bcom thob par byed do// 'dod khams kyi lha mi'i nang nas/ skye ba rigs 'dar man chad las mi lan gcig phyir 'ong ba'o// sra ba phyir mi 'ong ba la gnyis te/ zhugs pa dang zhugs bras gnyis so// dang po ni/ phyar mi 'ong 'bras 320) bu la zhugs te/ sbang bya brgyad spangs nas/ dgu da spangs pa'i sbyor ba la brtson pa'o/ gnyis pa 'bras bu ni/ 'dod khams kyis spangs cha dag cha dgu po thams cad spangs nas/ 'dod khams su mi skye ba ste/ mdzod las/ rnam dgu zad pa phyir mi 'ong*// ces so// gzugs kyis spang bya ma lus pa spangs ni/

phyir mi 'ong khyad par gyis chos yin la/ gzugs med kyis srid rtse'i brgyad spangs pa ni/ dgra bcom 'bras bu la zhugs pa ste/ mdzod las/ srid rtse'i bar pa brgyad zad pas*/ ces so// gsum pa mthar phyin gyis lam la gnyis| zhugs dang zhugs 'bras so// snga ma ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i dgra bcom 'bras bu la zhugs pa thal nas/ gnyis pa dgra bcam 'bras bu la gnas pa ni/ khams gsum gyis spang bya ma lus pa spangs nas mya ngan las 'das pa ste/ spyi bcings las/ bden 321)pa bzhi dang dbugs 'grang dang*// zad pa rgyad dang keng res so/ de dag bsam gtan bye brag yin// ces pas/ gong gis bhai spangs pa bden pa bzhi bhai pa'i tshul dang*/ nyan thos rab kyis 'gogs pa ka zhugs/ 'brang gis dbugs 'grangs| tha ma rkeng rus la brten te/ bar skabs rnams su zad par bhai pa ni/ sa dang*/ chu dang*/ me dang*/ rlung dang*/ sngon po dang*/ ser po dang*/ dmar po dang*/ dkar po dang brgyad do// de dag ni nam mkha' rnam par shes pa'o mdo' lad bshad do// bzhi pa spyod pa la gnyis te/ thun maung dang*/ khyad par ro/ dang po ni/ mi dge bcu dang mtshams me lnga/ de dang nye balnga la sogs pa/ mdor na mi dge ba phra zhing pra ba nas sbangs shing*/ kha nam thob pa mtha' dag bsdoms nas/ dge ba bcu la sogs pa'i legs spyod thams 322) cad phun su mazhogs par spyod do/ spyi bcings las/ shin tu yang nga'i las sbangs te// zhan pa'i dge ba phun sum tshogs// gnyis pa ni/ sbyangs yon bcu gnyis yod de/ dang po gnas 'thab pa la gsum ste/ dur khrod pa/ shing drung pa/ bla gab med pa'o/ zas 'thab pa la gsum/ sgo gcig pa dang*/ sgo gcig pa/ zas pyir mi len pa'o/ gso 'thab pa la gsum ste/ chos gos gsum pa dang*/ phying pa dang*/ phyag dar khrod pa'o*/ spyod lam mthab pa la gsum ste/ pog pa dang*/ lcog lcog pa dang*/ togs togs pa dang*/ gzhan rnams khrus dang gtsang sbra lta spyod zhi du len pa/

byed spyod gang yang*/ rang don du tshul ltar skyon mtha' dag shing*/ yon tan mtha' dag blangs nas| 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das yis/ spangs blangs dgags sgrub tshul bzhin spyod pa yin te/ spyi bcings las/ khrus 323) /dang gtsang sbra la sogs pa// gang yang kun rdzob mtshan ma'i tshul/ thams cad spangs dgag sgrub ba// nyan thos pa yi spyod pa yin/ ces so// lnga pa tshul khrims ni/ so sor thar pa rigs bdun yin te/ dge bsnyen pho mo gnyis/ dge tshul pho mo gnyis/ dge slong pho mo gnyis/ bar slob ma dang bdun yin te/ spyi chings las/ so sor thar pa rigs bdun te// ces so// de rnams kyis slab pa srung ni/ dge bsnyin pho mos/ lus kyi sgo nas/ srog gcod pa/ ma byin len pa/ mi tshangs par spyod pa dang gsum/ ngag gis rdzun rtsa ba bzhi/ yan lag chang dang lnga rdzogs par bsrung pa'o// spyi chings las/ slab pa bzhi lnga rdzogad pa ni/ ces so// dge tshul pho mo ni slob dpon la chos bcu dang*/ mkhan pos las thob pa gsum ste/ 324) rags rtogs bcu gsum mo// spyi chings las/ sdom pa'i rtsa ba bcu gsum dang*/ ces dang*/ lus las/ gang zhig srog gcod gzhan gyis nor 'phrogs dang*// mi tshang spyod rdzon bcos pa'i chang la sogs// gar sogs 'phreng sogs mal stan mthon po dang*// phyi dro'i kha zas gser dngul len pa spangs// de nyid las/ mkhan por gsol btab mkhan po las thob pa// khyim pa'i rtags spangs rab byung tshul rtags 'dzin// chos gsum dang po dang ni ldan par bya// ces so// dge slong pho ni rtsa ba bzhi/ lhag ma bcu gsum ma nges pa'i chos gnyis/ ltung ba sum cu/ ltung ba 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu/ bslab pa'i chos brgya bcu bzhi ste/ dril bas nyis brgya lnga bcu gsum bsrung bar byed do// dge slong mos/ lnga brgya bsrung ba'o/ spyi chings las/ nyis brgya lnga bcu lnga brgya gang*/ 325) /ces so// bar slob ma ni/

nyi shu rtsa gnyis bsrung ba yang bshad do// spyi chings las/ nyan thos bsrangs pa'i tshul khrims yin// ces so// drug pa lam yun ni/ dang po nges byung bslab pa'i sgor zhugs nas/ khams gsum gyis spangs bya phra rags ma zad kyis bar du/ 'jug chags stong gnas re re la skal phran nyi shu nyi shu byas te/ skal phran brgyad cu tham pa la bskal pa chen po gcig du rtsis pa'i bskal pa chen po gcig gam/ de las sbyangs yun ring na/ skal pa brgya la sogs pa yang sbyang bar bshad do| |spyi chings las/ 'jug chags srid pa zad kyis bar// bskal pa chen po brgya sogs yin/ ces gsungs so// bdun pa 'bras bu ni/ de ltar khams gsum gyis sa bon dang bral nas/ dgra bcom pa'i 'bras ba thob pa'o// de la lhag bcas dang*/ lhag 326) med gnyis/ dang po ni/ kun 'byung ma lus sbangs kyang*/ ba sdug bden gyis brten phung po tsam zhig lhag lus te/ dper na sdong po bcad pa lta bu'o// de yang*/ ched du brjod pa'i tshoms las/ ma 'gags pa yi lus kyi su// tshor ba dang du len pa na// de'i sems ni rnam par grol// mi shi bar ni gyur ba bzhin// ces pas/ de la yang rgyan can dang rgyan med gnyis las/ snga ma ni/ nyan thos kyis skabs kyis stog pa shākya thub pa lta bu/ sprul pa'i mtshan dpe' dang ldan pa dang*/ gzhan ni rgyan sna tshogs dang ldan pa| 'gra don shas 'ga' byed pa'o/ rdzogs pa chen po 'bras bu'i klong las/ sangs rgyas dgra bcom rdul phran ni// thub pa dbang po'i sku 'chang ba// zhes gsungs so// rgyan med ni/ skyes bu zung bzhi/ ya brgyad kyis skad cig la mngon du byas/ 327) /nyon mongs pa'i 'chi ba mtha' dag dang bral te/ dgongs pa mcho la 'khyag zhu ba'am/ nam mnga' la sprin 'khrig pa ltar 'byung ba'o// 'bras bu'i klong las/ zung bzhi ya brgyad lus rgyan bral// ces pa dang*/ phyogs 'das mdo' las nyon mongs zhi// shing zad me shi ci ltar 'bar// dge slong mya ngan 'das pa las// lus med gzung 'dzin phra ba tsam// ces so// de nyid kyang ngo bo gcig ste/

rnam pa'i cha nas rgyan can la// dgongs pa'i cha nad rgyan med do// gnyis pa ni/ rten phung po yang med par nye ba zhi ba ni lhag med do// ces so// dper na sdong po bsregs pa lta bu'i// ched du brjod pa'i tshomad las/ gang na lus zhig tshor ba 'gags// 'du shes thams cad bral 'gyur zhing*// 'du shes nye bar zhi ba dang*/ rnam par shes par nub gyur pa'apa// de dag la ci'i phyir 328) nyan thos zhes bya zer na/ srid pa tha ma'i tshe/ sgra cas kyis chos nyan zhing*/ thos pa gzhan la sgra bcas su sgrogs par byed na nyan thos te/ kho rang kho na'i phyir byed bcos yin no// yang theg chen gyis chos rang gis thos pa gzhan la sgrog par byed na thos sgrogs ces bya'o| /dam chos pad dkar las/ mgon po de rung bdag cag nyan thos 'gyur// byang chub dam pa yag dag sgrag par dmigs// byang chub sems dpa' sgra yang rab du rdzogs// de bas bdag cag nyan thos mi zad 'dra// ces gsungs so/ de ltar nyan thos kyis dbaye ba bcu de bstan nas/ sa'i rnam gzhag ci ltar yin zhes na ni/ mdo' las dkar po rnam dar mthong ba'i sa dang*/ rigs kyis dang*/ brgyad pa'i sa dang*/ mthong ba'i sa dang*/ srab pa'i sa dang*/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa dang*/ byas pa rtogs pa'i sa dang*/ nyan thos 329) /kyis sa dang*/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sa dang*/ ces so// dang po ni/ tshogs yin te/ thar pa cha mthun gyis lam yin pas so// gnyis pa ni/ sbyor lam yin te/ de nas rigs nges par bshad pas so// gsum pa rgyun zhugs 'bras bu la zhugs pa yin te/ yas mar bgrangs pas brgyad yin pa'o// bzhi pa rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas yin te/ mthong lam rnam grol gyis lam yin pas so// lnga pa ni phyir 'ongs 'bras gnas yin te/ 'dod khams kyis bhai spangs ma lus pa spangs pas so| |drug pa ni/ phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas yin te/ 'dod khams kyis bhai spangs ma lus spangs pa'o// bdun pa ni/

dgra bcom 'bras gnas yin yin te/ zag pa zad/ bya ba byas pa rtogs pa yin pa'o// brgyad pa nyan thos kyis sa ni/ sngar ma bshad pa'i 'bras 330) bu gnyis pa dang*/ sum pa dang*/ bzhi ba'i zhugs pa gsum yin te/ spyi ming bye brag la btags pa yin no// rang sangs rgyas kyi sa ni 'og nas 'byung pa'i rang sangs rgyas kyis kho na'o// kha cig du dkar rnam par mthong pa'i sa mi bgrang na brgyas do// gsum pa lung gis zhabs bsdud pa ni/ dgongs 'dus las/ shin tu ya nga'i las spangs te// yid 'ong mdun pa'i tshul bzung nas// rang gis rtsa ba saden bkrun pas// so so thar pa'i lam du snang*// ces gsungs so// theg pa thams cad kyis shan 'byed nyi 'od rab gsal las| nyan thos kyis rnam data bzhag pa'i le'u ste/ bdun pa'o// ༈ //gnyis pa dbang po tha ma'i 'bring rang sangs rgyas kyis theg pa la gnyis te/ mdir bstan dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ lung gis zhabs bsdu' ba'o// dang po ni/ 331) /dbang po tha ma'i 'bring rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa ni/ 'og nas 'bayung ba bzhin 'di lta ste/ gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la bdun te/ 'jug sgo/ lta ba/ ting nge 'dzin/ spyod pa/ tshul khrims/ lam yun/ 'bras bu'o/ dang po ni/ spyi chings las/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis 'jug pa'i sgo ces pa tshul ci ltar na/ lugs 'byung 'khor ba'i chos kyi rten/ 'brel bcu gnyis dang*/ lugs zlog mya ngan las 'das pa'i rten 'brel bcu gnyis dang po la gnyis las/ phyi dang*/ nang ngo/ sda ma ni/ g.yu drung gis shugs 'bras ka brten nas rtogs pa yin te/ rgyu dang 'bres pa drug 'bras bu dang 'brel pa drug ste/ snga ma ni/ sas rten/ chus bsdus/ mes smin/ rlung gis g.yos/ nam mkha' go skabs 'byed/ dus kyis 'gyur ba'o/ gnyis pa ni/ 332) sa bon/ myu gu/ yal gang*/ me tog 'bras bu'o// de yang*/ rten 'brel lugs nas byung ba dang*/ lugs nas bldog pas sargyu 'bras ma grub par rtogs pa'o// gnyis pa nang ni/

dur khrod kyis rkeng rus las brten nas/ ma grub par rtogs pa yin te/ ma rig pa/ 'du byed/ rnam par shes pa/ ming gzugs/ skye mched drug reg pa/ tshor ba/ srid pa/ len pa/ skye ba/ rga shi'o// nang rten 'brel lugs nas ldog pa dang*/ lugs nas 'byung bas/ 'dzin pa rag pa rang bzhin med par rtogs shing*/ nang skad cig rang gsal nyan thos dang mthun pa'o// g.yu' thang las/ nyan thos rang rgyal don dam 'dra// kun rdzob snang ba'i khyad par ni/ gzugs kyi bsdus pa'i chos rnams kun// rten 'brel rgyu rkyen dbang gyur pas// ces pa'o/ 333) /gnyis pa lta ba ni/ spyi chings las/ lta ba phyi rol rdul phran las// gzugs kyi phung po bdag med pas// ces pas/ gong gis rten 'brel lugs ldog pas gzugs kyi phung po bcu bzhi la sogs bdag med par rtogs kyang*/ rnam par rig byed ma yin par bdag med par ma shes shing*/ gang zag skad ceg cha med stong par ma rtogs te/ slob dpon ti gsungs so// gzugs don rtogs pa spangs phyir dang*// 'dzin da mi spang phyir na yang*// brten gyis bse ru lta bu'i lam// ces gsungs so// de la gnyis te/ bse ru ltar gcig pur gnas pa dang*/ ne tso ltar tshogs la gnas pa las/ sgrub po'i gang zag dang*/ de tshogs tshul dang*/ lam 'grod tshul dang 'bras bu rang don la gnas pa dang*/ gzhan don la gnas ba dang*/ gzhan don rgyu pa dang lngar shes par bya'o// dang po bse ru lta bu ni 334)theg pa gsum gyis dbang po rnon po skyo shas che zhing*/ snying rje shas chung ba/ gcig pur gnas pa la dga' ba'o// gnyis pa tshogs bsag tshul ni/ bsod nams kyis tshogs ni/ nges 'byung gis tshul khrims rnam dag la brten nas/ thar pa cha mthun gyis dge bas bsdug pas| skal pa brgya yis bar du bsags pa ste/ mdzod las/ bse' ru skal pa brgya'i rgyu/ ces so// tshogs bsags pa tshogs chen por phyin ba'i tshe/

skye ba len par mngon shes kyis gzigs nas smon lam 'grub par bya ba'i don du/ ye shes kyis tshogs ra nyan thos kyi sde snong la rten nas/ phung po/ khams/ skye mchen/ bden pa/ rten 'brel/ gang zag dang*/ mkhas pa'i din drug la mkhas par byas nas/ sangs rgyas dang nyan thos med pa'i zhing stong par skye bar gyur cig de yang gzhan la mi ston pa/ 335) /rang gis rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis lam 'grod par gyur cig byang chub thob pa nas gdul bya la lus kyi snying brtse bar byed kyis/ ngag gis snying brtse bar gyur cig ces smon lam gyis tshogs bsogs par byed do// gsum pa lam 'grod tshul ni/ dur khrod song nas/ tshogs lam gyis rten las/ shi 'phaus na smon lam gyis stobs kyis/ zhing stong du skye nas/ dur khrod du song ste/ rus pa ni ci las byung bsam pas na/ rten 'brel lugs 'byung lugs ldog tu rtogs te/ bsam gtan la rten nas lam lnga mngon du byed do// mdzod las/ sangs rgyas rnams ni mi bzhugs shing*/ nyan thos rnams kyang zad gyur pa/ rang sangs rgyas kyis ye shes ni// brtan pa med par rab du skyed// ces pa dang*/ de nyid las/ sten dang byang chub bse ru bar// bsam gtan/ 336) mtha' brten gcig la kun// ces so// gsum pating nge 'dzin ni/ snum zad pa'i mar me lta bu ste// rig pa'i gnyen po dang*/ shes pa rang gsal go ma 'gags par bhai pa ste/ spangs bya ma rig da zad nas/ gnyin po bhai byed du kyi 'du shes zad cing*/ rga shi'i bar du zad nas/ de ltar rims pa ltar/ gnyen po teng nge 'dzin stobs su gyur pas/ las dang nyon mings pa'i zhen pa gnyis 'gags/ lta bas shes bya bden pa bzhi zad par byas nas/ bsam gtan la brtsod pas/ lam lnga sa brgyad man chad non pa'o/ sbyi chings las/ mar me bzad pa lta bu ni/ ma rig zad nas 'du shes zad// de nas rga shi'i bar du ste// de ltar zhen pa gnyis 'gags pa// bsam gtan yin par rgyal bas gsungs// ces so// bzhi pa spyod pa ni/

gzhon shes 'ga' byed pas 'phags te/ stod la me 'bar ba dang*/ smad 337)/la chu 'brul pa la sogs rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung gis sgo nas don mdzad par gsungs so// lnga pa tshul khrims ni/ nyan thos kyi skabs bzhin no// spyi chings las/ spyod pa tshul khrims nyan thos dang*/ mthun par 'jug la khya par du// gcig bur gnas pa bsgrub par byed pa'o// ces pas/ bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal gyis/ gcig pur gnas pas/ kha na ma mtho ba spangs shing*/ dge bcu so thar gyis sdom pa tshul bzhin du bsrangs nas/ khrus dang gtsang sbral 'bad cing*/ yid bzhin mchog thob kyis 'bras bu bsgrub par byed pa'o// sbyi chings las/ gcig pur gnas pas sgrub byed pa'o// ces so// drug pa las yun ni/ bskal pa chen po brgya'i bar du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpal thams cad mnyes par byed cing*/ rgyal ba'i bka' las 'byung ba ltar/ mkhas/ 338) pa'i longs spyod la sbyangs pas/ tshogs spyod kyis rnams tshogs lam chen pos/ skal pa chen po brgyī gsum gnyis tsam gcig nas sbyor lam non/ tshogs chung gsum cha non par gsungs/ chos rnams la rim gyis ldogs pas gyur kyang*/ sems can gyis don byed pa'i smon lam rgya cher ma btab pas/ smon las tsam la brten par byed do// spyi chings las/ skal pa chen po brgyī bar// rgyal ba'i bka' la rab sbyangs pas/ chos rnams rim gyi rtogs gyur kyang*/ smon lam rgya cher ma btabs pas/ ces so// bdun pa 'bras bu la gnyis te/ 'bras bu thob tshul dang*/ gzhan don mdzad tshul lo// dang po ni/ sku bse' ru lta bu/ gsung ye mi gsung*/ thugs rnam thar sgo gsums lam/ bden bzhi dang rten 'bril gyis don rtogs pa la rgyun du gnas so// spyi chungs las/ 339) /'bras bu thob ka'i skye ba la// dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sten pas// chu zla la sogs rkyen rnams sam| |rtog tshig nyams su blangs pa'i tshe// bden pa mthong zhing srid pa zad// yid bzhin bde mchog sa la gnas// ces so/

gzhan don mdzad tshul 'di/ 'dod khams kyis brten can yin pas/ bsod snyoms la 'jug pa ni// gcigou ra rgyu zhing lus kyis rdzu 'phrul gyis gzhan don byed cing*/ lus kyis chos bston te/ bangon rtog rgyan las/ gang gang don ni gang gang la// ci ltar ci ltar nyan 'dod pa/ de de*/ don de dang de// sgra med kyang ni de ltar snang*/ ces dang*/ spyi chings las/ slad kyis 'gro don mdzad pa'i tshe// rigs kyis sprul da sna tshogs kyis// sangs rgyas byang chub mi bzhugs pa'i// bar skabs dag du donamadzad pa'i// 340) gsum gis chos 'chad mi mdzad pas// rang sangs rgyas su nges par grags/ /ces so/ gsum pa lung gis zhabs bsdu ba ni/ dgongs 'dus las/ 'di kun rten cing 'brel 'byung las// bdag med chos gcig med mthong bas// brjod med sprul pa'i chos rnams ston// ces gsungs so// theg pa thams cad kyis shan 'byed nyi 'od rab gsal las/ rang sangs rgyas kyis theg pa rnam par bzhag pa'i le'u ste| brgyad pa'o// ༈ //gsum pa dbang po tha ma'i rab gyang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la gsum ste/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ lung gis don bsdu ba'o// dang po ni/ rang gzhan don gnyis sbyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa ni/ srid mtha' la mi gnas shing*/ sku gsum gyis 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'o/ mdo sde rgyan las/ shes pas srid la/ 341) /mi gnas shing*// snying rjes zhi la mi gnas pa// mya ngan 'das dang 'khor mi gnas/ ces gsungs pa las/ de lasu yang*/ rgyu reng nyis/ lam tshogs gnyis/ lta ba bden gnyis/ 'bras bu sku gnyis su'ang bshad de/ rgyud bla ma las/ gter dang ljon pa'i shing bzhin du// rigs ni rnam gnyis zhes bya ste/ thog med rang bzhin gnas pa la// yang dag blang ba mchog yin no| |ces gsungs so// gnyis pa bye brag rgyas par bshad pa bdun te/ gang zag dang 'jug sgo thun mong du bstan pa dang*/

lta ba| ting 'dzin/ spyod pa/ sgom pa/ lam yun/ 'bras bu'o/ dang po ni/ dbang po ni/ dbang po tha ma'i rab/ dbu' ma sbyi'i'ajug sgo ni/ kun rdzob kyas bden pa dang don dam pa'i bden pa'i sgi nas 'jug pa'o// sbyi chings las/ bden pa gnyis po 'jug 342| pa'i sgo// ces so// gnyis pa lta ba la gsum ste/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ bye brag rgyas par bshad dang*/ lta ba bsdus tebastan pa'o// dang po ni/ 'go nas 'byung ba'i dbu ma'i dag gis lta ba ni/ lang dkar gshigs pa'i mdo' las/ rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyis don rab du 'byed pa'i ris kyi sa dang*/ bdag med gnyis kyi rnam par mi rtog pa ka gnas pa bco brgyad pa'o/ de nyid las don rab 'byed pa'i bsam gtan dang*/ de bzhin mi dmigs bsam gtan dang*/ ces so// skabs su 'di theg pa che chung gi rnam par bzhag pa la gnyis te/ theg pa che chung gi khyad par bzhag pa dang*/ theg chen gyi mtshan nyid bstan pa'o/ dang po ni/ nyad thosakis theg pa de las gzhan don gyis thabs mkhas pa la tshang pa'i phyir dang*/ rang nyid gcig pu zhi bar gyir pa'i lam gyis 'bras bu thabs mkhas 343) /pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung ba las 'gal ba'i phyir dang*/ nyan thos kyis theg pa de rgyas kyis thabs ma yin zhing*/ gang thabs ma yin pa la 'bad kyang 'dod pa'i 'bras bu mi 'byung ba'i phyir dang*/ nyan thos kyi sde snod las byung chub sems dpal slab par byas pa ma bstan pa'i phyir dang*/ nyan thos kyis theg pa gang yin pa de theg chen du mi gyur ta/ mdo' sde rgyan las ma tshang ba dang 'gal ba dang*// thabs med de ltar ma bstan te// nyan thod kyi ni theg pa ni/ theg chen chos zhes bya ba min// ces so/ gzhan ni 'gal ba rnam pa gsum ste/ bsam pa dang*/ bstan pa dang*/ sbyor pa dang*/ ston pa dang*/ dus 'gal pa'o// de dag kyang rim pa bzhin/ nyan thos kyis theg pa rang gcig pu mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa dang*/

mdo sde las kyang de kho na ston pa dang*/ 344) sbyor bas kyang de kho na la 'jug pa dag*/ chul khrims la sogs bson nams kyis tshogs dang*/ gang gi bdag med tsam rtogs pa ye shes kyis tshogs te/ tshogs gnyis kyi bstan pa rgya chung ba dang*/ myur pa srid pa gsum du grol shes pa'i tshul gyis dus kyang thung pa'i phyir ro// theg pa chen po las ni thams cad de las zlog pa ste/ sems can la tshad med pa bsam pa'i snying rje dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sde snod rgya chen po bstan pa dang*/ sbyor ba kyang gzhan la 'jug la 'jug pa dang*/ thabs la mkhas pa dang ma bral ba'i pha rol du phyin pas bsdu ba'i bsod nams dang*/ ye shes kyis tshigs rgya che ba dang*/ dus kyang bskal pa grangs med gsum la sogs bar rjod par bshad pas/ phan tshun 'gal phyir/ theg pa dman pa nyid ni dman pa kho na yin pas/ theg pa chen po ma yin pa kho na'o// de yang mdi' sde rgya las/ bsam pa dang ni bstan pa dang*// 345) /sbyor ba dang ni ston pa dang*// dus 'gal phyir na dman pa gang*// de ni dman pa kho na yin// ces so// gnyis pa theg chen po'i mtshan nyid ni/ mdo' sde rgyan las/ dmigs pa chen po nyi dang ni// de bzhin bsgrub pa tha dag dang*// ye shes brtson 'grus rtsam pa dang*/ thabs la mkhas par gyur pa dang*// yang dag bsgrubs pa chen po dang*// sangs rgyas 'phrin las chen po ste// chen po bdun dang ldan pa'i phyir/ theg chen zhes ni nges par brjod// ces gsungs pas/ sde snod rgya chen po la dmigs pa rgya che ba dang*/ rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa la 'jug pas sgrub pa chen po dang*/ sa dang po la sogs pa nas bdag nyis kyis stong pa mngon sum du rtogs pas yi shes che ba dang*/ grangs med gsum du tshogs gnyis la rtag tu sbyir bas brtsoms pa che ba dang*/ 346) gzhon nu 'khor bar gnas kyang*/ de'i nyes pa ma gos pas/

thabs mkhas pas che ba dang*/ stobs dang mi 'jig pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa yang dag pa sgrub pa che ba dang*/ 'khor bar gnas kyis bar du mdzad pa rgyun mi chad du ston pas 'phris cen po ste/ chen po bdun dang ldan pa'i phyir na theg pa chen po zhes bya'o/ de la dang po lnga ni/ 'dis 'gro ba lam gyes theg chen yin la/ phyi gnyis ni 'dir 'gro bas 'bras bu theg pa chen po'o// gnyis pa bye brag rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis te/ sems tsa ma pa dang*/ dbu' ma'o// dang po ni gnyis te spyi'i gzhi dang*/ so so'i lta ba'o// spyi'i gzhi ni/ spi chings las/ gang yang bden pa gnyis smra ba// rnam rig gnas kyis lta ba yin// ces pa/ kun rtags dang*/ yongs grub gsum mo// dang po ni/ run shan te ba'i sems tsam rgyan las/ kun 347) /rtags dang ni gzhan gyis dbang*// yongs su grub pa 'di rnams ni// rtags dang rgyud ma skyes pa dang*// mi 'gyur phyir na go rim bzhin// ces so// dang po kun rtags la gnyis te/ mtshan nyid cad pa'i kun rtags dang*/ rnam grangs kyis kun rtags so// snga ma ni/ mtshan nyid chad pa'i kun rtags te/ med pa'i 'dzin pa yin te/ ri bong gis ra la sogs pa med pa'i chos bzhi dang*| mu stegs pa'i bdag du 'dzin pa'o rnams so// gnyis pa ni/ snang la zhen bcas kyis rtog pa ste/ rdzas gcig la yang*/ rigs drug gis mthong snang drug gu du mthong ba la sogs pa'i snang tshul rnams so// de yang sems tsam gsum pa las/ rnal 'byor dag gang gang gis| dngos po gang gang rnams rtags pa/ de nyid kun du rtags pa yi/ ngo bo nyid de de med do// ces dang*/ snang ba bcun pa las/ 348) rdzas sna rnam pa gcig la yang*/ log mthong brgyad dang yang dag dgu// cir yang snang ba'i ngo bo nyid// ces so// gnyis pa gzhan dbang la yang gnyis te// ma dag pa dang*/dag pa'o// snga ma ni/ ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis/

skad cig ma snga ma las phyi ma 'byung ste/ gzung 'dzin gnyis su snang zhing ma dag pas/ 'khor ba'i rkyen du snang ba rnams so// gnyis pa ni/ shes rab kyis rkyen gyis/ skad cig snga ma las phyi ma skyes pa yin te/ gzung 'dzin bdag gzhan gnyis su 'dzin pa dag cing*/ lam gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i rin pa rnams so// de nyid las| gzhan dbang don gyis mtshan nyid ni// gzhan gyis dbang gis ngo bo nyid// rnam rtog yid bzhin rten las 'byung*// ces so/ gsum pa yongs grub la'ang gnyis te/ 'gyur med yongs grub dang*/ phyin ci ma log pa'o/ snga ma ni/ gshis mying yang gnyis med kyis 349) /rang rig rang gsal ba yin te/ sems can rnams kyi rgyud la rang bzhin gyis rtogs bral med par gnas shing| rgyun chad med par gnas pa yin te/ phyi ma ni/ skad ceg rang gsal la spangs bya blo bur gyis dri ma dang bral ba yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'o// de nyid las/ yongs su grub pa'i mtshan nyid ni// grub na de la snga ma'o// rtag du med par 'gyur ba gang*// de ni dus rnams kun la yod// ces so// drug po de dag bden pa gnyis su bstag pa yin te/ bden pa gnyis kyis bzhag tshul dang*/ mtha' dang bral tshul lo// snga ma ni/ kun rtags kun rdzob kyi bden pa yin la/ gzhan dbang dang yongs grub gnyis don dam pa'i bden pa'o// de la'ang gzhan dbang ni chos can don dam pa'i bden pa dang*/ yongs grub ni chos nyid don dam pa'i bden pa'o// bden pa gnyis kyi mtshan 350) nyid ni/ yang dag rig pa brtags cing spyad na mi bden pa kun rdzob/ brtags cing spyad na bden pa don dam pa'i bden pa'o// de gnyis ni spyir rang du'ang bden pa gnyis kyi mtshan nyid du'ang 'gro'o// gnyis pa mtha' dang bral tshul ni/ kun rtags dngos par mi bden pas sgro 'dogs kyis mtha' sel/ yongs grub chos nyid rgyun chad med pas bskur 'debs kyi mtha' sel/

gzhan dbang la rtag pa'i skye ba med la rten 'brel gyis skye ba yod pas gnyis ka'i mtha' sel yang yongs grub la bdag gnyis kyi stong pas sgro 'dogs kyis mtha' sel/ gzhan dbang nichos nyid yin cing rgyun chad med pas bskur ba'i mtha' ba'i mtha' sel/ kun rtags rten 'brel tsam du 'byung bas/ med pa'i mtha' sel/ dngos por ma grub pas/ yod pa'i mtha' sel// gnyis pa bye brag so sor 'dod pa la gnyis te/ rnam bden pa dang rnam rdzun pa'o// 351) /snga ma ni/ yul du snang ba rnams/ nang shes pa'i ngo bor bden pa yin te/ lang kar gshegs pa las| don yos ma yin sems yod de/ phyi rol don mthong log pa'o// ces dang*/ g.yu thang las/ yul ltar snang ba 'di dag kun| |rab rib sku gzugs rmi mthong ltar// shes pa 'khrul pa'i gzugs brnyan phyir// de yang de'i ngo bor 'dod// ces dang*/ la shan las/ rnam rig skad cig ngo bo nyod// dngos po gnyis snang phyir tsam ste// rma lam la sogs ci lta bar// dngos po thams cad skad cig ma'o// ces so// de la dbye na gsum/ snang ba dkar dmar sna tshogs su snang yang*/ bden shes pa gcig gi ngo bor bden pa dang*/ rnam pa'i grangs ji snyed yod par shes pa'i grangs kyang de snyed du yod par 'dod pa dang*/ rnam pa dang shes pa sgo nga bkas pa ltar 352) tha dad du 'dod pa'o/ dang po ni/ yul snang dkar dmar sna tshogs su snang yang*/ nang shes pa gcig gis ngo bo yin te/ dper na rmi lam snang tshul bsam gyis mi khyab kyang*/ shes pa gcig gis ngo bor bden pa bzhin no// gnyis pa ni/ rnam pa'i grangs ji snyed par bden la/ shes pa'i grangs yang de snyed bden pa yin te/ rnam grangs ma 'dres par gsal ba'i phyir ro// gsum pa ni/ kun rdzog phyi yul dang nang shes pa phan tshun du bden la/ gzung 'dzin dus mnyam pa'o// de gsum yang ngo bo skad cig gi rang gsal dang*/ phyi rol gyis snang ba yin par mthun pa'o// de yang mdo sde nas don mthun par gsungs te/

snang tshad sems su gcig pa'i cha nas kyang*/ gcig du yang bden la/ de nyid ma 'dres pa sna chogs su snang ba'i cha nas/ rnam pa dang shes pa'i grangs ltar yang bden/ de nyid yul shes gnyis su snang ba'i cha nas/ 353) /ranam pa dang shes pa ltar yang bden gsungs so// gnyis pa rnam rdzun pa ni/ phyi'i yul mi bden la/ nang shes pa yang mi bden te/ nam mkha' la skra shad 'dzag pa ltar bzung ba tsam rdzun par 'dod pa'o// de yang lang gshegs las/ ce ltar rab rib can dag gis// skra shad la sogs 'dzin pa ltar// med pa dag kyang snang ba 'gyur// byis pa'i 'dzin pa rnams blod ces pa dang*/ 'di dag rnam par rang rig tsam ste// yod da ma yin don snang phyir/ dapher na rab ri ba can dag la// skra shad la sogs med mthong bzhin// ces so// de la bye brag du gnyis te/ dri bcas dang*/ dri med do// snga ma ni/ sems dang snang ba 'di gcig pa yang ma yin tha dad pa yang ma yin te/ gser dang g.ya' ltar 'dod pa'o// phyi ma ni/ snang sems 'brel ba med cing*/ snang ba rdzun pa yin la/ rang rig rang gsal shel ltar 354) dag cing*/ brtag par dka'o// yang bden pa stong ba'i snong ba gcig sangs rgyas kyi sa na yod par 'dod do// gnyis pa ni/ dri bcas med par 'dod pa'i dri med de/ g.yu' thang las/ rang rig gnyis med shel ltar dag /de nyid dam pas yod par smra/ ces so/ de yang paka phyir lta ba'i yul du snang ba thams cad kun brtags yin la/ nang sems las byung ba'i rgyu rkyen bskyed pa ni/ gzhan dbang ngo/ don mying ba gnyis med kyis rang rig rang gsal ni shin tu brtags par dka' bas yongs su grub pa'o/ la shan las/ gcig shes cha shas rnam pas stong*// nyi shel chu zla me long sogs// brtag par dka' ba'i ye shes nyid// de ltar rgyud du rang gnas pa'o/ ces pa dang*/ spyi chings las| phyi rol gang dang gnas 'di kun// yul rnams sems kyis 'khrul smra zhing*// sems nyid dus mtha'i skad cig ma// skad cig

355) /mi rtag rgyun gyi gnas// ces gsungs so// gnyis pa dbu ma la gsum ste/ mdo sde spyod pa'i dbu ma dang*/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma dang*/ rab tu mi gnas pa'o// dang po las gsum ste/ kun rdzob kyis mtshan nyid dang*/ don dam pa dngos smra dag nas stong nyid du bstan pa dang*/ bden pa gnyis kyi 'dod tshul lo// kun rdzob kyi mtshan nyid ni/ yul gyi dngos po dang*/ sems so so'i rkyen gyis snang bas na kun rdzob ces bya ste/ snang ba bcu pa las/ mdo sde kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam// yul sems log nas snang ba ltar// ces so// gnyis pa ni/ yul tshogs drug la sogs rnam par snang ba phra rags rdul cha drug tu phye ste/ phra rdul kun rdzob phyogs cha drug du gzhal bas/ nyan thos bye brag pa ltar gzhigs na dngos po med de/ stong nyid spros bral don dam du 'dod de/ sems 356) nyis thog mtha'i skad cig ma de la/ dus gsum gzhig nas dngos med de// de la rkyen gyis skyes pa la/ bdag po'i rkyen yid/ dmigs pa'i rkyen yul/ 'jug pa'i rkyen dbang po/ de ma thag pa'i rkyen thams cad mtshogs pa'o// rgyu'i rkyen ma rig pa/ lhan ceg skyes pa'i rkyen las dang nyin mongs pa dag gis/ snod bcud phyi snod nang bcud gnyis su snang ba'i tshe rten 'brel gyes med bzhin du snang bas na/ kun rdzog sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid tsam du snang ba'o/ g.yu' thang las/ mdo dam pa'i don du gnyis su med/ mdo sde dbu ma kun rdzob du// yul dems rshun pa sgyu ma tsam// snang ba yul sems so sor 'dod// don dam pa'i don du gnyis su med// ces dang*/ spyi chings las/yul rnams phra reg rdul cha de// phyogs char gzhig na dngos po med// sems nyid thog mtha'i skad cig ma// dus gsum gzhig nas rang bzhin med// rkyen ni gnyis dang bzhi 357) /dag gis// snod bcud gnyis su snang ba'i phyir// kun rdzob sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid tsam// ces so// gsum pa bden pa gnyis kyi 'dod tshayan ni// de ltar kun rdzob dang don dam ḍaden pa gnyis snang ba yang*/

de nyid gzhan du brjod du medo pa'i tshul du 'dod de/ de rnams kyi mdo sde spyod pa'i lta ba'i brag gtan la phab pa'o// gnyis pa rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu' ma la gnyis te/ 'dod pa bstan pa dang zhabs bsdu ba'o// dang po la gsum ste/ don dam dang kun rdzob gnyis/ de gnyis ngo bo gcig la bzlog pa tha dad du bstan pa'o// dag po ni/ rnal 'byor spyod ba'i dbu' ma kha cig/ phyi nang snod bcud thams cad bden pa gnyis su snang ba las/ phyi snod ni/ shes pas btags ba'i 'khrul pa tsam du snang ste sems rang bzhin skad cig ma dang*/ dus gsum gyis cha shas dang bral ba'i stong nyid spos bral du 'dod pa de nyid don dam 358) pa'i bden pa yin te g.yu' thang las/ nag pa rnal 'byor dbu ma ni// kun rdzob rdzun pa tsam du yang*// yul sems gnyis med yul snang sems| |kun rdzob rnam rig ci lta bu// don dam ma skyes stong pa lta// ces dang*/ sbyi chings las/ kha cig phyi nang snod bcud dag /bden pa gnyis su gnas ba la// snod ni sems kyis 'khrul pa ste// sems ni skad cig dus gsum bral// de nyid don dam bden pa yin// ces pas/ dbu' ma de nyid don dam cir yag ma grub cing*/ mtha' dang bral ba mthun pa'o// gnyis pa kun rdzob ni/ don dam pa de nyid martogs pa'i snang ngor/ kun rdzob sgyur ma tsam du yag ma 'gags te/ sems tsam rnam ḍaden pa dag yang mtshungs/ yul du snang dus nyid nas yang*// ngo bo nyid kyis ḍaden pa grub ste/ sems nyid rang gis mtshan nyid dus gsum skye 'gags med pa'i skad cig ma/ de nyid khun rdzob ltar snang ba 359) /yin te/ spyi chings las/ kun rdzob sgyur mar ma 'gags te// 'khrul med 'khrul pa'i yul du snang*// sems nyid dus gsum skad cig ma// 'gags pa med pa kun rdzob yin/ ces so// gsum pa ngo bo gcig la bzlog pa tha dad ni/ de ltar bden pa gnyis kyi bye brag so sor gtan la phab kyang*/

ngo bo gcig la zlog phyogs tsam gyis tha dad pa yin la don la dbyer med do// sbyi chings las/ bdon pa gnyis kyi bye brag kyang*// sdog phyogs kyis ni tha dad pa'o// gsum pa rab du mi gnas pa la yang gnyis te/ lta ba dang*/ 'bras bu'o// dang po la yang gnyis te/ kun rdzob tu 'khrul pa ma zad bar snang ba mi khegs pa dpe' dang bcas pa dang*/ don dam par 'khrul pa dag nas yul bems thabs/ stong nyid spros bral du gtan la phab pa'o// dang po ni/ sems nyid don dam pa mtha' bral de nyid ma rig 'khrul pa'o rgyu rkyen 360) gyis nyid snang bag chags kyis mthu' ltas pas/ dper na mig nad can gyis snang ngor rab rib mthong ba ltar du yul phyi rol gyis snang ngor/ nang gis shes pa dang*/ dbang po dang bcas pa 'di rnams/ don dam par bden par ma grub kyang*/ 'khrul pa spyi mthun gyis blo ngos la bden pa ltar du snang ste/ nang du 'khrul pa'i bag chags ma zad kyis bar du/ phyi rol gyis snang ba rnams su yang khegs pa mi gyur ba bzhin no// dbu' ma la 'jug pa las/ rab rib mthu'i skra shad la sogs pa// ngo bo log pas gzhan dbang rnam dag pa// de nyid gang zhig bdag nyid ming dag pas// mthong ba de bzhin de nyid 'dir shes kyis// ces dang*/ spyi chings las/ ma rig 'khrul pa'i bag chags kyis// meg la rab rib snang ba bzhin phyi rol nang dang gnas 'di rnams// mi bden bden ltar kun du snang*// 'khrul pa'i bag chags ma zad tshe// nam yag kharags par 'gyur/ 361) /ba min// ces so// gnyis pa ni/ don dam pa 'khrul pa dag nas yul sems thams cad stong nyid spros bral du gtan la phab pa ste/ dbu' ma rab du mi gnas pa de nyid lam rim par 'grod na 'bras bu thob tshul ni/ dper na/ mig nad sang dus phyi rol du skra shad la sogs rab rib kyis snang ba dngas bzhin du/ don dam nang du 'khrul pa'i rtags pa'i bag chags thams cad zad pa'i tshe na/

phyi rol gyis yul thim pa med pa rang grol/ 'khrul reg gzhan du song ba med par mngon sum dngas pa'o/ spyi chings las/ nad zad rab rib dngas pa bzhin// 'khrul pa'i bag chags thams cad zad// mthun par med bar yul dang bral// gzhan gsum med par mngon 'khrul dang*// ces so// gnyis pa 'bras bu ni/ de ltar ma rig 'khrul pa zad pa'i tshe/ rig pa yi shes nyid kyang zad cing med par smra/ 362) ba yod de/ de la sa bcu rgyun thar ma rig pa dang gnyin po mnyam ldan gyis chos sku thob ste/ rang rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i ye shes kyang med par 'dod do/ 'o na 'gro don ci ltar 'byung zhes na/ bsod nams kyis tshogs la 'byung ba'i gzugs dang*/ gzhan snang gis ye shes ni/ sngon gyi smon lam gyis stobs kyis gdul bya rang rgyud dag pa rnams la/ 'bad rtsol med par gang la gang 'dul du 'byung ba rnams so// spyod 'jug dang dbu' ma la sogs pa las bshad pa'o/ spyi chings las/ 'khrul rig mnyam du zad smra ba// dbu' ma'i lta ba kha cig bzhed// ces so// gzhan yang thal rkya ba kha cig sangs rgyas la rang rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i ye shes med par 'dod de/ slob dpon zla ba grags pas/ shes bya'i bud sheng skam po sreg pa'i me// zhi ba de'i tshul gyos rgyal rnams chos sku ste// de tshe skye ba med cing 'gag pa 363) /med*/ sems 'gags pa ste sku'i mngon sum mdzad// ces pa'i rjes su 'brang nas// ma rig pa dang bcas pa'i rig pa la| rig pa phyi ma skyed pas thob kyang rig brtsams las rig pa phyi ma skyed pas/ rgyun mtha'i dus gnyis par/ ma rig pa la sogs pas rig pa la sogs te/ rig pa phyi ma skyed pas thob kyang rig brtsams las rig pa phyi ma skyed pas/ rgyun mtha'i dus gnyis bar/ ma rig pa la sogs pas rig pa la sogs te/ sems dang sems 'byung gis 'jug pa thams cad rgyun zad pas na/ dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa 'a blo bur gyis dri mas kyang dag pa mngon sum du byas pa la chos sku zhes bya'o/

'o na gzhan gang las 'byung zhes na/ sngon byang chub sems dpa'i gnas skabs na| yun ring por smonalam btab pa'imathu' dang*/ gdul bya rang rgyud pa'i snang ngo la/ gzhan snang gis ye shes gzugs sku 'byung ste/ spyod 'jug las/ ci ltar nam mkha'i lding gis ni// mchod stong bsgrub nas 'das gyur pa// de 'das yun ring lon kyang de// dug la sogs 364) pa zhi byed bzhin// ces so// de na rang snang gis ye shes med ces zer ro// 'di la gsum ste/ ye shes med par 'gag pa dang*/ yod par bsgrub pa dang*/ de la mi mthad pa spangs pa'o// de dag dgag pa la bzhi gsate/ drim sems kyi rang bzhin du thal ba dang*/ dbyings rkyang las bsgrub pa dang*/ de la mi mthad pa spangs pa'o// de dag dgag pa la bzhi ste/ dri ma sems kyi rang bzhin du thal ba dang*/ dbyings rkyang las don gnyis 'byung bar thal ba dang*/ ye shes med na 'phrin las mi 'byung ba mi thad ba'o// den ni/ ma rig pa las log nas rig pa log na/ dri ma sems kyis rang bzhin du thal/ sems dang dri ma gcig par zad pa'i zad ba'i phyir ro// rtags khas blangs khyab pa yod de/ dri ma zad pas rig pa zad na/ de'i rang bzhin 'gyur te/ nag papa dang sol ba bzhin no// 'dod par mi nus te/ rgyang 'phel pa de dgags mi nus par 'gyur te/ nyes pa blo bur dag ldan dang*/ yon tan rang bzhin nyid ldan phyir/ ces so dang*/ dges rdor las/ sems can 365) /rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid// 'on kyang blo bur dri ma sgribs/ dri ma de bsal sangs rgyas nyid// ces sogs mdo' rgyud thams cad dang 'gal ba spangs dka'o// gnyis pa ni/ chos nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang*/ rgyu rkyen rig pa'i bden gnyis 'gal lam mi 'gal/ dang po/ ltar na mthong lam chos nyid mngon sum du mthong ba nas 'phags pa'i lam thams cad du/ kun rdzob rtogs pa'i blo je 'phra la bar thal/ gnyen po shes rab stobs je cher 'gro ba'i phyir rtags lung gis grub/

'gal zlo stobs je cher 'gro bas/ gcig shos je zad chung zad la 'gro bas khyab/ snang mun bzhin no/ 'dod na snang bcas bson nams kyis tshogs je chung je zad la 'gro bar thal/ de'i rgyu snang bcas rtogs pa'i blo je zad la 'gro ba'i phyir/ 'dod na mi nas te/ bslab tus las/ 366 stong nyid snying rje'i snying po ca na// spyod pas bsod nams dag par 'gyur// ces dang*/ mdo sde rgyan las/ bson nams ye shes rang bzhin gyis| |dge ba'i phal ba de phan no// ces pas/ tshogs gnyis ma'i gal zhing 'phel ba gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang yon tan rgya phrag bcu gnyis la sogs snang bcas kyis ye shes gong du rgya cher 'gro bar gsungs gsum pa ni/ khyod 'dod pa'i sangs rgyas la don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa med par thal/ mkhyen brtse ye shes med pa'i phyir/ rtags khas blangs khyab pa yod de/ de dag ye shes yin pa'i phyir ro// 'dod na/ rgyud bla ma las/ dngos po'i sku ni stobs la sogs// bral ba'i yon tan rnams dang ldan| |ces pa 'gal lo// bzhi pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las thams cad ye shes kyis bdag rkyen la mi ltos 367) /par thal/ ye shes med pa'i phyir ro/ rtags dang khyab pa khas blangs/ 'dod na/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ rnam pa thabs cad mkhyen nyid la// chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin// ces pa dang/ ye shes nyid chos kyi sku'i 'phrin las de/ rnam pa nyi shu bdun du brjod// ces pa ye shes las 'phrin las 'byung bar gsungs pa dang 'gal lo// de dag ni rgyang 'phen pa dag 'chi bas tshe ring pa rgyun chad par 'dod pa dang*/ nyan rang dag lhag med kyi mya ngan las 'das pa na rig pa rgyun cad par 'dod pa dang*/ thal rkyag pa dag pa bcu' rgyun mtha' na rig pa rgyun chad par 'dod pa'i log rtog rnams dgag zin no// gnyis pa ye shes yod par bsgrub pa la gsum ste/ rgyu dang*/ ngo bo dang*/ byed las gsum gyis sgo nas bsgrub pa'o// dang po ni rgyu'i sgo nas bsgrub pa skal pa grangs med gsum la sogs/

368) par tshogs gnyis mthar phyin te/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes skyed par nges so// sher phyin las/ skad cig gcig dang ldan pa'ishes rab kyis// rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa ngon sum du byed do// ces so// gnyis pa ngo bo'i sgo nas sgrub pa ni/ gzugs sku khyad par can 'di/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa'i phyir ro// sher phyin las/ bdag gis dngos po'i sku ni mnyes pas/ sher phyin gyis pha rol du phyin pa dang thabs mkhas pa'i rgyu las byung ba ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis rten du 'gyur pa'o// ces so// gsum pa byed las kyi sgo nas bsgrub pa ni/ dngos po phyogs mthar tug med pas| dus gsum mthar tug med/ shin tu lkog gyur don shin tu phra ba rten 'brel zab cing rtogs dka' ba 'di dag sangs rgyas kyi 369) /ye shes khyis ma lus mkhyen pa yin te/ shin tu lkog gyur la lung tshad ma yin pa'i phyir/ rgyud bla ma las| don 'di las ni rgyal ba las// lhag pa'i tshad ma gzhan su yod// ces dang*/ de nyid las/ gang zhig rgyal las che mkhas pa yang 'jig rten 'di yod min zhing*// ma lus mchog ni tshul bzhin kun mkhyenaci bzhin gzhan min pa// ces dang*/ mdo' las/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis 'di mi mkhyen pa'am mi gzigs pa'am/ thugs su mi chud pa gang yang mi 'da'o// ces so/ gsum pa tha mi dad pa spangs pa ni/ sangs rgyas gzugs sku tha dad la ye shes yod dam med/ yod na rgyud du mar 'gyur te/ sku tha dad pa ltar ye shes kyang tha dad pa'i phyir/ ye shes med na yod pa'i dam nyams so// ces gsungs so// gcig char ba la gsum ste/ 370) lta ba dang*/ bhai pa lam gyi yun no// dang po la gnyis te/ kun rdzob du chos thams cad rten cing 'brel bar 'byung mthun par snang ba dang*/ don dam rang bzhin med pa mtshan nyid gsum ldan du ldan pa'o// dang po ni/

gcig char du 'jug pa'i dbu' ma ni/ phyi'i snodadang*/ nang gi bcud kun gang du kun rdzob sgyu cam du snod kyis tshul du snang ba'am/ don gyi rang bzhi na gang du yang grub pa med pas sgyu ma'i rta dang*/ glang po lta bu thams cad kyis rang rang gi dge sdig la sogs las dang bag chags mthun par snang ba ni/ bde' sdug la sogs so sor tha dad du snang ngo// ces pas/ yum rgyas pa las/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa ni/ mtha' gnyis su mi 'gyur ba'i pha rol pa rol du phyin pa'o// ces gsungs te| kun rdzob chos can snyen pa/ chos nyid don la g.yos gang med de/ kun rdzob rten 'byung ci ltar yang snang bas med pa'i mtha'/ 371) /sel/ de nyid dngos por ma grub rtag pa'i mtha' sel lo/ don dam rang bzhin ngo bo nyid kyis stong pas yod pa'i mtha' sel*/ rnam pa thams cad kyis mchog dang ldan pas med pa'i mtha' sel lo// des na chos dbyings 'od gsal 'phel 'gri ba med par gnas par med mtha' sel/ don dam dngos po mtshan ma gang gis kyang stong pas yod pa'i mtha' dang bral/ kun rdzob dang don dam ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad pas gnyis mtha' dang gcig mtha' sel lo// bden chung las/ don dam tha dad med tshul gyis// chos can med cing chos nyid med// stong pa nyid las tha dad ni// cung zad yod pa ma yin no// ces dang*/ yum las/ 'di ni gzugs so// gzugs stong pa'o// zhes gzugs rnams bkrun par mi bya'o// ces so/ sor mo 'phreng ba las/ lun dga' ra ba na dge 'dun mi bzhugs pa la/ kun dga' ra 372) ba stong pa zhes bya'o// kun dga' ra ba ni med pa ma yin no// de bzhin du/ chos nyid la bdag dang bdag gis stong pa la/ chos nyid stong ba zhes bya'i| chos nyid med par 'gyur ba ni ma yin no// ces dang*/ yum rgyas pa las/ shes rab kyis pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ mtha' gnyis su mi gyur ba'i rol du phyin pa'o// ces pas/

shes rab kyis pha rol du phyin pa ni/ yod med rtag par gnyis ka'i mtha' yin te| dbu' ma las/ yod ces bya ba'i mtha' yin te// de bzhin med bya ba yang mtha'// gtsang dang mi gtsang gnyis ka'i mtha' yin te// de phyir gnyis kyis mtha' ni rnams spangs nas/ mkha' pas dbus la gnas pa yongs mi byed// ces so// de nyid gtan la 'bebs par byed pa la/ yod med rtag chad kyis mtha' lhung na gol ba yin te/ dbu' ma las/ med pa po ni ngan 'gror 'gro// yod pa po ni bde 'gror 373) /'gro// yong dag can ni yongs shes pas// gnyis la mi rten thar bar 'gyur// ces dang*/ bden chung las| stong pha nyid la lta nyes na// shes rab chung rnams phung bar 'gyur// ces pa la sogs rgya cher gsungs so// gnyis pa gsum gtan la gsum ste/ mnyam gzhag dang*/ rjes thob/ nyams su len tshul lo/ dang po ni/ skye 'gags gnas gsum smra brjod las 'das pa'i don/ mtshan nyid gsum ldan gyis don dam pa de nyid nyams su len pa'i tshe/ dus gsum gyi rtogs pa'i rjes phyir mi 'brang cing*| ci bzhin pa nyid kyi ngang mnyam par gzhag pa ni/ dper na sprin dang bral ba'i nam mkha' lta bu ste/ spyi chings las/ bsgrub tshe mnyam par gzhag pa ni// nam mkha' 'ata bu spros dang bral// ces so// gnyis pa ni/ rjes shes sgyu me lta bu'i ngang nas spyod yul thams 374) cad dang bral stong nyid snying rje'i can de'i ngang nas/ ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la pha rol phyin drug la sogs gang la gang 'dul gyis spyod pa la gnas pa yin te/ spyi chings las/ rjes la sgyu ma lta bu yi// zhen chags bral ba'i spyod pa ni// kun rdzob snying rjes gnas pa yin// ces so// gsum pa nyams su len tshul ni/ dus ci srid bar du smon pa dang 'jug pa sems bskyed nas bzung ste| tshogs sbyor mthong phyin dang lnga rim pa ltar/ chos nyid don dmagazhal bya dang*/

gzhal med gtan tshigs gtan la phab nas/ gcig char ba'i rnal 'byor pa des/ lta ba chos nyid bden pa'i don rtogs shing*/ bhai pa de don nyams su blangs nas tshe gcig lus gcig la don dam pa'i bden pa gcig char du rtogs nas/ yang dag pa ci lta ba'i don la mnyam par 'jog cing*/ 'bras bu mngon du byeng pa yang 375) /yod de/ spyi chings las/ sems bskyed nas bzung mtha' thug par/ gzhal dang bhai pa nyams su blangs tshe gcig don dam bden pa mthong*// dbu' ma'i lta ba kha cig bzhed// ces gsungs pas/ de ltar rtogs pas grol ba'i rgyu mtshan dang*| de'i don la bhai gnas tshul dang*/ rtogs pa'i don mngon du gyur nas sangs rgyas pa'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ de ltar rtogs nas grol ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ gzugs nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar du/ gnyis su med cing grol ba med pa yin te/ yum rgyas pa las/ gzugs nyid rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid do// rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid gzugs so// gzugs las rnam pa thams cad nyid ma yin no// rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid las gzugs gzhan ma yin no// ces thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis bar/ 376) du gsungs so// sdud pa las/ gzugs dang 'du shes tshor ba dang ni sems dpa' dang*/ rnam par shes pa ma bcings ma grol ba yod ma yin// de ltar byung chub la grub zhums pa'i sems med pa// 'di ni gang zag dam pa rnams kyis go cha'i mchog /ces gsungs so| |gnyis pa ni/ de ltar gnyis su med cing bcings grol med pa'i don rtogs/ bhai pa yang cir snang bhai bya bhai byed med par chos nyid kyis bhai par yin cing*/ mi bhai pa'i bhai pa zhes bya ste/ yum bar ma las/ shes rab kyis pha rol tu phyin pa ni shin tu zab ste/ de ni sus kyang bhai par mi bgyid/ cer yang bhai par mi bgyi'/ gang du yang bhai mi bgyi'o// de ci'ipyir zhes na/ chos nyid dmigs su ma mchis pa ste/

shes rab kyis pha roka du phyin pa'i bhai pa ni/ nam mkha' bhai pa'o/ chos nyid thams cad bhai pa'o/ yongs su 'dzin pa 377) /ma mchis pa bhai pa'o/ chos thams cad zhes dang*/ kun nas bhai pa'i mdo las/ 'jam dpal gzugs ting nge 'dzin du bhai par bya'o// de bzhin du/ sgra dang dri dang reg bya dang*/ chos dang nyon mings pa thams cad rang bzhin du rtogs par bya'o| |ces pa dang*/ gsang ba mtha' yas pa'i mdo' las/ sems ngo shes pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ ci ltar byas kyang bhai pa'i ngang*| |gnyug ma'i don gnas pa yin// ting nge 'dzin gyis nyams su bshad// ces gsungs so// gsum pa ni/ de ltar rtogs shing dgongs pas nyon mongs pa la sogs pa'i ching ba mtha' dag las grol nas/ lam gyis rim pa med par sangs rgyas bar gsungs te/ gong gis lung rnams dang*/ mdo dang pha rol du phyin pa'i gzhung rnams nas shin tu yang rgyas par gsungs nas de rnams su yang lta bar bya'o// 378) gsumapa lta ba bsdus te bstan pa la gsum ste/ bden gnyis tha dang du 'dod pa dang*/ thabs kyis lta spyod do/ dang pi ni/ dbu' ma de dag gi lta ba bden gnyis su dbye ba yin te/ kha cig kun rdzob spyid mi bzod pa yin la/ don dam las zlog pa ste snang ba dang stong pa dbyer med kyis chos thams cad kun rdzob spyad mi bzod pas snang ba med pa dang*/ dbyer med kyis chos thams cad spyad bzod yin la de phyir bden pa gnyis dngos 'gal yin pas/ chos can dang chos nyid kun rdzob dang don dam yin zhes smra'o// spyi chings las/ de dag la sogs bden pa ni// rogs su dbye ba byed pa dang*/ ces so// gnyis pa ni/ de dag kun gyis kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bur 'dzin pa'i mtshan nyid tsam las/ sbyin pa la sogs pha rol phyin pa drug/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi/ chos spyod rnam pa bcu la sogs pa'i spyod pa byang chub sems dpa' 379) thabs kyis zin pa'i lta ba yin te/

spyi chings las/ kun rdzob sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid tsam// sbyin sogs da rol phyin pa las// spyod pa byang chub lta ba yin// ces so// gsum pa ting nge 'dzin la gnyis te/ mnyam gzhag dang rjes thob/ zhabs bsdud dang bcas pa'o// dang pi ni bsam gtan ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par tshe na/ rnam par rtog pa'i sprin tshogs dngas nas chos nyid nam mkha' kha cig pa lta bu spros pa dang bral bar bzhag pa'o// spyi chings las/ bsam gtan mnyam bar gzhag pa'i tshe// nam mkha' lta bu spros dang bral// ces so// gnyis pa ni kha cig dngos po rnams la rig pa bden pa'i dngos po khegs kyang*| snang ba sgyu ma tsam mi khegs pas/ snang la rang bzhin med pa tsam ni don dam pa'i bden pa'i bdem pa yin lo/ de la med par sgros 380) btags pa ni/ sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid tsam du dngos po la zhen pa med pa'i tshul du 'di 'atar du snang ba'i chos thams cad sems nyid rang gsal bar 'dod de/ de'i ngang la sems can thams cad bde ba dang 'phrad 'dod pa'am/ sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod pa'i byams dang snying rje rnams sbyong bar byed pa ni theg pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin yin te/ spyi chings las/ rjes la sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid tsam// zhan med tshul gyis gsal bar smra// byams dang snying rje rnams sbyongs ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i bsam gtan yin// ces gsungs pas/ gong gis gcig char ba'i bhai pa de las rgal ba'i gang zag kha cig gang snang ba la ngo sprad nas khrid par byed de/ nad gdon la sogs sems la gang gzan pa skye med stong par ngo sprad cing rtsal sbyangs nas/ lam nges med du grol ba yang mdo' dang pha rol phyin pa las gsungs so// 381) bsdud pa las/ rgyal ba'i dngos po shes rab pha rol phyin pa 'di rigs sngags che// sems can khams mang mya ngan sdug bsngal chos zhi byed// ces pa la sogs gsung ste/ rigs kyis drangs don nyams su len cing sa dang lam gyis rim pa la sbyor ba ni/

sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi rim par bya ste/ sbyor ba ni/ byang chub mchog du sems bskyed cing smon 'jug gnyis kyi ci byad sems can gyi don du 'jug pa'o// dngos gzhi ni/ tshogs gnyis sam mnyams rjes gnyis kyi lan yin te/ dge ba bcu dang*| /bsdu' ba'i dngos po bzhi dang*/ sbyin pa tshul khrims bzod pa la sogs pa'i bson nams kyi tshogs dang*/ bsam gtan shes rab gnyis ye shes kyis tshogs so// brtson 'grus ni gnyis ka'i grogs byed do// mnyam rjes gnyis ni mnyam gzhag rnam par 382) mi rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ rjes byang chub kyis spyod pa dge ba'i las la 'bad pa ste/ 'jug dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad sems can gyis don du bla ni med pa'i byang chub du bsngo' ba'o// bzhi pa spyod pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa ste/ tshad med bzhi sogs rnam dkar gyis spyod pa rnams la zhen 'dzin med pa'i tshul gyis/ rang 'dod med pa'i spyod pa ni/ 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'ispyod pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yin no// sbyi chings las/ sbyin sogs rnams par dkar ba'i las// zhen med tshul gyis spyod pa ni// byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yin// ces so/ lnga pa tshul khrims la gnyis te/ rang gzhung gis sdom pa dang*| so tharaspyi'i bsrung tshul lo/ dang po ni/ theg pa chung spyi'i rtsa ba bzhi dang*/ nyes byas bzhi bcu zhe drug la sogs pa 383) /mdo' du ma nas bshad pa'o// gzhan yang rgyal po'i rtsa ltung lnga/ blon po'i lnga/ las dang po'i rtsa ltung brgyad de bco brgyad do// spyi'i rtsa ltung bzhi las bdag stod gzhan sman ma rtogs pa gsum ste/ nyi shu rtsa gcig yod/ yang na de'isteng nas byang chub kyis sems dor ba/ sems can blos dor ba ste rtsa ba gsum las rgyal po dang blon po'i rtsa ltung bcu*/ thun mong lngar rtsi/ blon po'i gro 'joms pa thun mong ma yin pa gcig dang drug ste bcu dgu/

rang 'dod smon pa rtsa ba nyi shu bzhi ltar rtsi ba dang bzhi bcu zhe drug gzhan yang*/ bsdom pa'i bye brag mtha' yas pa dang*/ spang blang gis slab pa rnams ni bsrung ba'i tshul khrims yin te/ theg pa chen po dbu' ma'i rang gzhung gis tshul khrims so// spyi chings las/ rtsa ba bzhi dang nyi shu dang*// bsdom pa'i bye brag mtha' yas 384) pa| |bsrung ba'i tshul khrims yin par stan// byang chub sems dpa' rang gzhung gis 'o// ces so// gnyis pa ni/ thun mong gos bsdom pa bye brag du dbye na/ rang don gzhan don gnyis kyis bsrung tshul mtha' yas kyang*/ brten gang zag gos khyad par dang*| snod dbang po'i tshul gyis byang chub sems dpa'i yan lag so sor thar pa'i sdim pa yin pas*/ mi nyams pa bsrung dgos tshul lo| |spyi chings las/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa ni// bye brag rnam pa mtha' yas kyang*// brten nas snod kyis tshul gyis phyir// byang sems yan lag sdom pa yim// ces gsungs so// drug pa lam yun ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa chen po'i lam yun chos mngon pa'i grangs skuis gnas gzhan drug cu rtsa bzhi las 'das pas// tshogs sbyor gnyis la grangs med gcig /ma dag pa bdun 385) /la grangs med gcig /dag pa sa gsim la grangs med gcig dang grangs med gsum gyis lam 'grod pa la/ smon 'jug sems skyed nas bzung ste/ mthar sangs rgyas kyi bar sgrib gnyis rim gyis sbyangs shing bsod nams dang*/ ye shes kyis tshogs rdzogs pa'i tshul dang*/ sa lam rim gyis bgrod nas bcu gcig kun du 'od kyis 'bras bu thob par 'dod do// spyi chings las/ grangs med skal pa gsum dag gi// sems skyed nas bzung sangs rgyas bar// sgrib sbyangs ye shes rdzogs tshul gyis// bcu gcig kun du 'od kyis sa// ces gsungs pas/ theg pa chen pi'i lam la lnga ste/ lam gyi gzhi' byang chub mchog du sems skyed pa dang*/

thun mong gis lam phyogs mthun su ma cu so bdun dang*/ khyad par gyis lam yar par pyin drug dang*/ lam gyis sa 386) mtshams lam lnga sa bcu dang*/ theg chen gyi lam gyi nges par 'byung tshul lo// dang po ni/ sems skyed la gnyis te/ sems skyed kyis rang bzhin bstan pa dang*/ de ci ltar nyams su len pa'i tshul lo// de la gsum ste/ rgyu/ ngo bo/ 'bras bu'o// dang pol gsum ste/ chags pa'i brten/ nyer len gyi rgyu/ lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen no// dang po la gnyis las lus kyi brten ni lha mi'i lus phun sum tshogs pa yin te/ mdo' las/ gang tshe rkang gnyis gtso bo yis// chos kyi rnam grang 'di bshad pa// de tshe lha mi stong phrag brgya'// byang chub mchog du sems skyed do// ces so// gnyis pa sems skyed kyi brten ni skyabs 'gro khyad par can yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ theg pa mchog phyir dkon mchog skyabs rab song ba gang*// ces so// gnyis pa nyer len gyis rgyud 387) /la gsum ste/ che chung bya ba sems can gyes ngang tshul shes pa'i snying rje yin te/ brgyad stong 'grel chen las/ de la thog med rig nus pas// snying rje'i sa bon rab sad cing*// sbyor dang bsam pa phun tshogs las// byang chub sems 'di yongs su bzungs| |ces so// gnyis pa rgyal ba sras bcas la/ dang ba'i dad pa khyad par can la skye ba yin te/ dkon mchog sgron ma las| rgyal dang rgyal ba'i chos la dad gyur cing*// rgyal sras rnams kyis spyod la dad byed pa// byang chub bla na med la dad gyur na// skyes bu rnams ni sems ni skye ba'o// ces so// gsum pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'bras bu thob par 'dod pa la skye ba yin te/ bslab btus las/ byang chub smon pa'i sems ni sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba bya'o// ces so// gsum pa lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen ni/ 388) yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten nas/

chog phun sum tshogs pa la skye ba yin te/ sdom pa nyi shu pa las/ bla ma bsdoms la gnas shing mkhas// nus dang ldan la blang bar bya'o/ gnyis pa ngo bo la don dam dang kun rdzob du sems skyed pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas brgya' las mi nyung ba'i zhal mthong bas/ lung gi chos thos 'dzin pa dam pa dang*/ skal pa brgya' las mi nyung bar bsod nams dang ye shes kyis tshogs gsogs pas sgrub pa'i chos 'dzon pa bsgrub pa dam pa dang*/ mnyam gzhag na rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes bskye' zhing rtogs pa'i chos 'dzin pas rtogs pa dam pa ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rdzogs chen sangs rgyas rab mnyes byas*// bson nams ye shes tshogs rab bsags// chos la mi rtogs ye shes ni// skye phyir de ni dam par 'dod// ces so// de ni mthong lam 389) /gyis ye shes skye bas don dam sems skyed yin no// 'dir theg chen byang chub du sems skyed pa'i ngo bo la gsum ste| mtshan nyid/ sgra don/ rang bzhin no// dang po ni/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pa ni/ smon pa sems skyed yin la| rgyu las 'jug par 'dod pa ni 'jug pa sems skyed yin cing*/ de la mi mthun pa'i phyogs spangs ba ni byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyis bsdom pa yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ spong pa'i sems 'di thob pa la/ tshul khrims pha rol phyin gsungs te// ces so// gnyis pa sgra don ni/ sems can gyis don du byang chub thob par 'dod pa ni sems bskyed dam/ mya ngan 'das kyis bsil ba thob par byaid pa ni/ tshul khrims mi dge ba bsdom zhing dge ba bsag pa'i bsdom pa'o// gsum pa rang bzhin la gnyis te/ mtshan bzhi'i ngo bo dang*/ dbye' ba'o 390) dang po ni/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa/ dge ba skyes pa/ grogs sems 'byung*/ byang chub la dmigs pa ni sems skyed kyis ngo bo yin no// gnyis pa dbye' ba la gsum ste/

ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na smon 'jug gnyis yin te/ zhi ba lhas/ byang chub sems de mdor bsdus na// rnam pa gnyis su shes bya ste// byang chub smin pa'i sems dang ni// byang chub 'jug pa nyid yin no// ces so// gnyis pa sa mtshams sgo nas dbye' ba la bzhi ste/ tshogs sbyor na yod pa mos pa spyod pa'i sems skyed/ sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar la yod pa/ lhag bsam dag pa'i sems skyed de/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sems skyed de ni sa rnams la// mos dang lhag bsam dag pa dang*// rnam par smin ba bzhin du 'dod// de ni sgrib pa spangs pa'o// ces so// gsum pa grogs kyis sgo nas dbye' na nyi shu yod de/ mdo' sde rgyan las/ de 391) /yang sa gser zla ba me// gter dang rin chen 'byung hanas 'tsho/ rdo rje ri sman ba shes gnyin dang*// yid bzhin nor bu nyo ma glu// rgyal po mdzod dang lam po che// gzhon pa rkod ma'i chu dang ni// sgra snyan chu bo sprin rnams kyis// rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis so| |ces gsungs pas/ dpe nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi grogs nyi shu rtsa gnyis bstan la/ grogs kyi mtshan nas grogs can nyi shu rtsa gnyis ston pa yin te/ de dag gis don rgyas par bshad na mdo' gzhung nas gsal/ 'dir bsdus te ngos bzung na/ gzhan don byang chub thob 'dod kyis 'dun pa dang ldan pa lta bu dang*/ phar phyin drug la slab ba ni gser lta bu/ byang chub kyis so bdun la slab par 'dod pa'i bsam pa ni zla ba lta bu/ mkhyen gsum gyis sbyor ba dang ldan pa ni me lta bu/ sbyin pa'i yin tan dang ldan pa ni gter chen po lta bu/ tshul 392) khrims dang ldan pa ni rin po che'i gter khung rnyed pa lta bu/ bzod pa dang ldan pa ni gting mig yo' ba rgya' mtsho lta bu/ brtson 'grus dang ldan pa ni rdo rje lan lta bu/ bsam gtan dang ldan pa ni ri bo chen po lta bu/ shes rab dngaldan pa ni sman bzang po lta bu/

thabs mkhas pa dang ldan pa ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen lta bu/ smom lam dang ldan pa nor bu lta bu/ stobs dang ldan pa nyi ma lta bu/ ye shes kyi phar phyin dang ldan pa ni dri za'i rgyal po rab dbyags kyis glu dbyangs snyan pa lta bu/ mngon shes khyad par can drug dang ldan pa ni rgyal po lta bu/ bdag gzhan gyis don 'bad med 'byung bas mdzod lta bu/ byang chub phyogs kyis chos dang ldan ni lam po ches lta bu/ gzho gnas lhag mthong dang ldan pa ni rta cang shes lta bu/ gzung spobs pa dang ldan pa ni rkod ma'i chu lta bu/ chos 393) /kyi dag: ston dang dang ldan pa ni rnga bo che'i sgra lta bu/ 'grod pas gcig pu'i lam dang ldan pa chu bo lta bu/ chos kyi sku dang ldan pa ni sems skyed pa ni sprin lta bu'o// gsum pa 'brasabu la gnyis te/ nyams pa'i nyes dmigs/ thob pa'i phan yon/ dang po ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ nyams bcas dman dang bsrungs dang de bzhin ston pas smad// ces dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ gal te de ltar dam bcas nas// las kyi bsgrub par ma byas na// sems can de dag kun bslus pas// bdag gis 'gro bci 'drar 'gyur// ces pa dang*/ brgyad stong 'grel chen las/ byung chub sems dpa' sun 'byin rigs par bya'o// byang chub sems dpa' sri dar du rigs par bya'o// ces dang*/ bsdud pa las/ sems skyed de ni phas 'pham bas kyang shin tu lci// ces gsungs pas/ dren pa 394) nyer bzhag las/ cung zad bsam nas ma byin na yi dgas su skyes/ dam bcas nas ma byin na dmyal bar 'gro// ces so// gnyis pa phan yon gyis 'bras ba la gsum ste/ skyes thob kyi 'bras bu ngo mtshar ba dang*/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu don che ba dang*/ mthar thug gis 'bras bu 'tshang rgya' ba'o// dag po ni// ming dang don 'pho' ste/ sems skyed thob phyin chad byang chub sems dpa' dang rgyal ba'i sras zhes bya ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che// blo ldan nyis dag gsaka ba'i mchog /rgyal sras rgyal bu'i bzhi dang ni// rgyal byed rgyal ba'i myu gu dang*// ces so// don 'pho ba ni/ sems skyed phyin chad 'jig rten gyis lha chen rnams kyi tshur la phyag 'tshal ba'i 'os su 'gyur te/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems dpa' par gyur nas skad cig gis ni/ srid 395) /pa'i rtson rar bsdom pa'i nyams thag rnams// rgyal ba ranams kyi sras zhes rab brjod cing*// 'jig rten lha mir bcas pa'i phyag byar 'gyur/ ces so// gnyis pa gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu la gsum ste/ rang don/ gzhan don/ don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa'o// sngar gyis sdig pa zad cing*/ phyin chad bsdom par 'gyur pa yin/ spyod 'jug las/ de ni dus mtha'i me bzhin sdig can rnams// skad cig gcig gis nges par bsreg par byed// ces dang*/ mdo' sde rgyan las/ blo ldan sems mchog skye ma thag du yang*// mtha' yas nyes pa bskyed la sems rab bsdom*// ces dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ dge ba gzhan rnams chu shing bzhin du ni// 'bras bu byung nas zad par 'gyur ba nyid// byang chung sems ni ljon sheng rtag par yang*/ 'bras bu 'byin pa mi zad 396) 'phel ba 'gyur// ces so// gnyis pa gzhan don ni/ spyod 'jug las/ 'gro ba'i 'chi bdag 'joms byed pa'i// bdud rtsa mchog kyang 'di bzhin no// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel ba yi// mi zad gter yang 'di yin no// 'gro ba'i nyon mongs gdung sel ba'i// sems kyis zla ba shar ba yin// 'gro ba'i mi shes rab rib dag// dpyid 'byin nyi ma chen pi yin// ces so/ gsum pa rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don ni/ spyod 'jug las/ 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa dmyes mdzad yin*/ sems can smin par byed pa yang 'di nyid yin// rang don yang dag bsgrub pa yang ni de nyid yin// ces dang*/ mdo' sde rgyan las/

skye bo rmongs pa rang gis bde don brtson/ de ma thob par rtag du sdug bsngal 'gyur// bstan pa gzhan gyis don la brtson pa ni// gnyis ka'i don byas mya ngan 'da' bar 'gyur// ces so// 397) /gsum pa mthar thug gis 'bras bu 'tshang brgya' ba ni/ sems can thams cad kyis don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya ba yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ gser 'gyur rtsi'i rnam pa mchog lta bu// mi gtsang lus 'di blangs nas rgyal ba'i sku// rin chen rin thang med par 'gyur pas na// byang chub sems zhes bya ba rab brtan bzung*// ces gsungs so// gsum pa nyams su len tshul sbyor dngos rjes gsum la sogs rang rang gis gzhung nas 'byung ba bzhin nyams su len no// gnyis pa las phyogs mthun la bzhi ste/ so so'i dbye' ba dang*/ rigs bsdu' ba/ khyad par byed chos dang*/ sgro don no// dang po ni bdun yod pa las/ thog mar dren da nye bar bzhan pa bzhin/ rig tshor/ sems/ chos dren pa nye bar bzhag pa'o// byang chub sems dpa' lus 398) tshogs bzhi mi gtsang ba la sogs sgyu ma lta bu bhai la/ spyi chings las/ mtshan nyid mi dmigs pa bhai pa'o// chos spyi dang rang gis mtshan nyid shes par byed pa shes rab yin te/ 'di dag gis don rtogs pas dran pa la gnas pas/ nye bar bzhag des bya'o/ sa mtshams tshogs lam chung du nas yod do// gnyis pa yang dag pa'i sbongs ba bzhi ni/ sdig pa ma skyes pa ni skyed/ skyed pa spong*/ dge ba ma skyes pa skyed| skyes pa mi nyams shing 'phel bar byed pa'o// de yang sbyor ba'i dus su mdun pa skyed/ dngos gzhi la 'bad/ mi skyo ba'i brtson 'grus rtsams// bying ba'i gnyen por lhag mthong gis sems rab du 'dzin/ rgod pa'i gnyen por gzhi gnas la yang dag par 'jog/ mnyam pa thob nas btang snyoms su 'jog pa ste/ mdo' las/ mi dge' skye ba spangs pa'i phyir// 'dun pa bskyed 'bad brtson

399) /'grus rtsams/ sems rab du 'dzin/ yang dag pa rab du 'jog go// ces pas/ 'og ma gsum la yang sbyar bar bya'o// de ltar spang bya spang zhing gnyen po skyed pa brtson 'grus yin te/ yang dag spong ba brtson 'grus yin/ ces so// sa mtshams tshigs lam 'bring por nas so/ 'grus rtsams/ sems rab du 'dzin/ yang dag pa rab du 'jog go /caras pas/ 'go ma gsum la yang sbyar bar bya'o// de ltar spang bya spang zhing gnyen po skyed pa brtson 'grus yin te/ yang dag spong ba brtson 'grus yin/ ces so// sa mtshams tshogs lam 'bring po nas so// gsum pa rdzu 'phrul gyis rkang pa bzhi ni/ yang dag pa spong ba'i brtson 'grus sems las su rung ba la skye ste/ de yang lam snga ma'i rjes kyis/ de tsam gyis chog par 'dzin pa'i gnyen po 'dun pa bskyed pa dang*/ phyis nas mi sbyor ba rnam par g.yeng ba'i sems rab tu zhi ba/ bying na so sor spyod pas yang dag par g.yeng 'dod pa ste/ de gzhi dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i ting nge 'dzin la 400) 'dun pa dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ sems pa dang*/ sbyod pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyis spong ba'i yan lag dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis rkang pa zhes bya ste/ rdzu 'phrul ni yod pa bsgyur ba/ med pa sprul pa sogs yin la/ rkang pa ni de thob pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni yin te| rdzu 'phrul rkang pa ting nge 'dzin ni/ ces so/ sa mtshams tshogs lam chen po nas/ bzhi pa dbang po lnga ni/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub yon tan can du shes nas/ dad pa'i dbang po// phar phyin drug spyod pa la spro bas/ nan tan du byed pa brtson 'grus kyis dang*/ thos pa'i chos ma rjed pa dran pa yin dang*/ sems rtse gcig pa ting nge 'dzin gyis dang*/ shes rab du 'byed ba shes rab kyis dbang po dang lnga ste/ snga mas pyi ma la dbang byed kyis/ shes rab kyis chos thams cad la dbang byed pas shes rab kyis dbang po zhes bya ste/

401) /dbu' mtha' las/ thar pa'i cha dang mthun skyes nas// mdun dang sbyor ba gad byed de// dmigs pas brjod par mi 'gyur tam// mi 'phrul rloms par mi byed kyang*// ces so// sa mtshams drod rtse mo nas so// lnga pa stobs lnga ni/ dbang po lnga'i gnyen po 'phrul ldan du gyur ba mi mthun phyogs 'joms par byed/ dad pa dang*/ brtson 'grus/ rjes ngas pa dang*/ rnam par g.yeng ba dang*/ 'chal pa'i shes rab stobs chung bar byed pa stogs zhes byed/ mdo' sde rgyan las/ mi mthun phyogs nyid nyams chung bas// de dag nyid la stobs zhes bya// ces so// sa mtshams bzod pa chos mchog gnyis nas so| |drug pa byang chub kyis yan lag bdun ni/ bdag med mngon sum du rtogs da mthong ngam/ byang chub kyis grogs su gyur bas/ 402) byang chub kyis yan lag zhes bya ste/ dran pa yang dag byang chub kyis yan lag dang*/ chos rab cu 'byed pa/ brtson 'grus/ dga' ba/ shen tu sbyang pa/ teng nge 'dzin ni/ gtang snyoms byang chub kyis yan lag go /de yang shes bya'i chos rab du 'byed pa/ yang dag byang chub kyis yan lag ni/ rang bzhin gyis yan lag ste/ mthong lam gyis ngo bo yin pas/ mthong spong 'joms pa'i phyir glang po che bzhin no// mthong lam gyis rtogs pa mardzogs pa yang dag byang chub kyis yan lag ni/ gnas kyis yan lag ste/ shes bya'i g.yul rgyal bar byed pa 'khor lo lta bu'o// brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyis lag ni/ nges 'byung yan lag ste/ lam myur du 'grod par byed pa rta mchog lta bu'// dga' ba byang chub kyis yan lag ni/ phan yon gyis yan lag ste/ mthong lam 403) /yon tan gyis dga' bas lus sems la phan thog par byed pas nor bu lta bu'o// nyon mongs pa med pa'i yang dag la gsum ste/ lus sems shin tu sbyangs ba yang dag byang chub kyis yan lag ni/ nyon mongs med pa gzhi'i yan lag ste| nyon mongs pa'i rgyu gnas ngan len pa 'joms pa'i phyir btsun mo lta bu'o// ting nge 'dzin byang chub kyis yan lag
