nyon mongs pa med pa'i gnas kyis yan lag ste/ tong nge 'dzin las 'dod pa'i don 'grub pa'i phyir/ khyim bdag lta bu'o// gtang snyoms byang chub kyis yan lag ni/ nyon mongs med pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis yan lag ste/ nyon mongs gtang ba ye shes kyi ngo bo yin pa blon po lta bu'o// de yang mdo' sde rgyan las/ rang bzhin yan lag gnas yan lag /gsum pa nges 'byung yan las ste// bzhi pa phan yon yan lag yin// rnam 406) byi rgod spongs shing*/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis/ mngon par shes khyad par can thob/ yon tan ging las dbang byed pa'i mthun pa'i phyogs kyang gnyen po ni// de yang dbu' mtha' las/ yongs su spyod dang go 'byed dang*/ rnam gsum gzhan yid ches par byed// mi mthun phyogs kyis gnyen pi ni/ lam gyis yan lag 'di brgyad do// rta dang tshul khrims kyi yod byad skad// gzhan la rnam par rig byed 'dod// nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs dbang*// mi mthun phyogs kyis gnyen po ro// ces so// gnyis pa rigs bsdu' ba'i phyir/ tshogs sbyor mthong bhai kyis phyogs chos so bdun pa'o// bcur 'dus pa yang dag gsungs te/ de nyid las/ dran pa nyer bzhan shes rab dang*// yang dag spong ba brtson 'grus te// rdzu 'phrul rkang pa ting nge 'dzin// ming gis sgo nas rdzas bcu'o// dad dang 407) /brtson 'grus dran pa dang*// shes rab ting 'dzin gtang snyoms dga'// rtogs dang tshul khrims shin tu sbyangs| |dran pa nyer bzhan shes ran ste// brtson 'grus yang dag spong zhes bya// rdzu 'phrul rkang pa teng 'dzin no// ces so// gsum pa theg chen gyis khyad par 'phags tshul la/ nyan rang chos phyogs mthun ni/ dmigs pa rang gis lus la sogs pa nye 'tshe ba dang*/ rnam pa mi rtag la sogs gang gis bden pa dang*/ 'bras bu bdag gcig pu sdug bsngal pa'i ched du/ dran pa nyer bzhag la sogs bhai pa nin la/

byang chub sems dpa' ni/ bdag dang gzhan gyis ni lus srogs la dmigs pa rgya che ba dang*/ mi rtag la sogs mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis yid la byed pa dang*/ shes rab dang snying rje 'khor 'das gnyis la mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa thob par bya 408) ba'i phyir du bhai pa ste/ mdo' sde rgyan las/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni// dmigs dang yid la byed pa dang*// mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa ni// thob pa de ni khyad par 'phags// ces so// bzhi pa sgra don ni/ rang rang gis zad pa dang mi skye ba shes pa'i ye shes ni byang chub yin la/ de dang rje su mthun pa'i chos yin ba'i phyir/ byang chub kyis phyogs dang mthun/ pa zhes byas te// mdzod las| zad dang mi skye shes pa ni// byang chub de dang mthun byed phyir// sum cu rtsa bdun de phyogs mthun// ces gsungs so// gsum pa thun mong ma yin pa'i phar phyin la gnyis te/ thun mong gis bsgrub pa'i tshul dang*/ sher phyin bye brag du bshad pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ mtshan nyid/ sgra don/ 'byed ba'o// dang po ni/ srid zhi pha rol du phyin pa'i thabs khyad par can te/ bshes 409)/springs las/ sbyin dang tshul khroms bzod brtson bsam gtan dang*// de bzhin shes rab gzhan rab gzhan med pha rol phyin// 'di dag rgyas mdzad srid pa'i rgya mtsho yi// pha rol phyin pa rgyal ba'i dbang po mdzod// ces so// gnyis pa sgra don ni/ dbul ba dor bas sbyin pa/ gdung ba sel ba tshul khrims/ 'khro' ba bzod pas bzod pa/ yon tan la sbyor bas brtson 'grus/ yid du 'dzin pa bsam gtan/ don dam shes pas shes rab bo// mdo sde rgyan las/ dbul ba dor ba byed pa dang*// bsil ba thob dang 'khro bzod dang*// mchog sbyor ba dang yid 'dzin dang*/ don dam shes pas phyir bshad do// gsum pa la/ mi sage bsngon pa/ dge ba chos bsdud/ sems can don byed tshul khrims so// bzod pa la/

bya dka' khyad du bsad pa/ sdug bsngal ci mi snyams pa/ 410) chos la nges par rtogs pa'o// brtson 'grus la/ go cha/ sbyor chog par mi 'dzin pa'i brtson 'grus so/ bsam gtan chos la bden par byas pa/ yon tan khyad par can mngon par bsgrub pa/ sems can don la dmigs pa'i bsam gtan no// shes rab la thos pa/ bsam pa/ bhai pa las 'byung ba'i shes rab ste/ mdo' sde rgyan las/ g.yeng ba med pa'i sbyin pa dang*/ sa srid mi 'dod tshul khrims dang*// thams cad la ni bzod pa dang*// yon tan kun 'byung brtson 'grus dang*// bsam gtan gzugs dang gzugs med yin// shes rab thabs dang bcas pa ni// pha rol phyin pa drug po la// brten pa rnams kyis yang dag sbyor// ces so// gnyis pa sher phyin// bye brag du bshad pa la yang gsum ste/ thos byung dang bsam byung*/ bhai byung dang gsum mo// dang po ni/ lud dang rig pa 411) /phyin ci ma log dar smra ba'i gang zag la/ shes bya'i gnas lugs gtan la 'bebs par byed pa bka' bstan bcos legs par nyan nas don khong du chud par bya'o// bsam 'byung gis shes bya'o sgro 'dogs bcad pa dang*/ bhai 'byung gis shes rab kyis nyon mongs pa rtsad nas gcod cing drung nas phyin pa ste/ de la yang lung las/ tshul nas thos dang ting 'dzin bas// bhai pa la ni rab du sbyor// ces dang*/ lam rim las/ thos bsam bhai pas lta thar phyin// ces dang*/ gsang sgron las/ dang po thos shes rab kyis phyi nang chos la sgro 'dog gcod/ bar du bsam pa'i shes rab kyis/ de don rgyud la bhai par bya'/ tha mar bhai pa'i shes rab kyis// bdag du 'dzin pa'i nyin mongs zhi// ces so// bzhi pa thun mong ma yin pa khyad par cad gyis lam dang*/ 412) sa mtshamapa la gnyis te/ skyes 'phags thun mong lam lnga dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sa bcu'o// dang po tshogs sbyor mthong bhai mi slobs pa'i lam lnga las/ tshogs lam la gsum ste/

brten gang la skye ba/ rang gis ngo bo// 'bras bu'o// dang po brten ni lus sems gnyis yin te/ mdo' las/ thar pa cha mthun mi nang du// ces dang*/ mdo sde rgyan las*/ bsam gtan ma thob mngon par zhen// ces so// bsod nams cha mthun dang*/ thar pa cha mthun gyis dge ba la brten nas so// gnyis pa tshogs lam rang gis ngo bo la gsum ste/ mtshan nyid/ sgra don dbye'o// dang po ni/ theg pa thun ming gis lam nges 'byung gis tshul khrims kyis thob par bhai zhing*/ bye brag theg chen tshogs lam bdag nyid rtogs pa'i thabs mkhas pa dang bcas pa'o// 413) /gnyis pa sgra don ni/ tshogs gnyis yang nas yang du bsog pa tshogs/ byang chub thob pa'i thog ma yin pa lam/ zhes bya'o// gsum pa dbye ba la gsim ste/ chung du/ 'bring*/ chen po'o// dang po ni/ dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi/ 'bring po sbong ba bzhi/ chen po rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ste/ gong du bshad zin to// gsum pa 'bras bu tshogs lam chos rgyun gyis teng nge 'dzin yin te/ 'di la gsum ste/ rgyu dang*/ teng nge 'dzin gyis ngo bo// de'i byed las so// dang po ni/ rtogs pa dang bcas/ spyod pa dang bcas/ rtogs da med la spyod pa tsam/ rtogs pa yang med la spyod pa yang med/ lta spyod zung du 'brel ba/ rab du 'dzin pa'i rgyu mtshan| gzhi gnas kyi rgyu mtshan/ gtang snyoms kyis rgyu mtshan/ rtag du bya ba/ gus par bya ba/ yid la byed pa ste 'dod khams 414) kyis sems pa rtse gcig pa/ yid la byed pa bcu gcig dang*/ sems 'jog par byed/ kun du 'jog/ mos pa 'jog dul bar/ zhi bar/ nye bar zhi pa/ rgyud gcig du 'jog par byed pa ste/ sems gnas pa'i thabs dgus/ lus sems shin tu sbyangs ba las/ byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis 'dod khams las/ ring du song zhing*/ bsam gtan nyer ldog skyed/ bsam gtan dngos gzhi thob/ mngon par shes pa lnga la sogs pa 'byung*/

sangs rgyas mchod cing sems can smin par byas/ shes rgyud tshogs gnyis gang bas/ chos rgyun teng nge 'dzin skyes pa yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ bsam gtan la thob mngon par zhen// shes sngon bsgrub pa'i sgi nas te// sangs rgyas dpag du med pa la/ mchod pa'i phyir dang mnyam pa'i ba'i phyir// 'jig rten khams ni rnams su 'gro/ 415) /'dis ni sangs rgyas dpag med la// skal pa grangs med bsnyen bkur byas// de la mnyes byas skur bya ba'i// sems ni las rung mchog tu gyur// gnyis pa tshogs gnyis phul phyung las/ chos thams cad skye med du rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis/ tshig don rgya cher 'dzin nus dang ldan te/ 'grel chen las/ gang gis thos pas tshig dang don 'dzin par 'gyur ba'i chos kyi rgyun zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob/ ces dang*/ gtsun na rin chen gyis zhus pa'i mdi' las/ rdzu 'phrul gyis rkang pa bzhi la gnas pa ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyang mthong ngo// de dag la chos kyang nyan to// lha dang*/ klu dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ mi ma yin pa thams cad kyang gtam zer/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems yings su sbyang ba byas pa'i phyir ro// ces dang*/ sangs rgyas sprul pa'i 416) sku la thob ni/ de tshe chos kyi rgyun las ni/ sangs rgyas rnams la gzhi gnas dang*/ ye shes yang ba thob bya'i phyir/ gdams ngag rgya chen thob par 'gyur/ ces gsungs so// gnyis pa sbyor lam la gsum ste/ rgyu/ ngo bo/ 'bras bu'o// dang po la gcig lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen ni/ lus kyis brten ni tshogs lam dang 'dra/ sems kyi brten bsam gtan bzhin yin te/ mdo' sde rgyan las/ bsam gtan bzhi pa shin tu dag thob pa// mi rtog ting 'dzin yongs su bzungs nas ni// ci ltar rnams gnas yid la byed pa yi// mthu' grub pa yi dam pa thob par 'gyur// ces so// gnyis pa nyer bstan gyis rgya ni/

tshogs lam chen po mthar phyin pa'i chos rgyun ting nge 'dzin la bhai pa yin te| mdo' sde rgyan las/ 'di ni sangs rgyas dpag med la// rtag pa med par bsnyen bkur byed/ de la bsnyen kur byed pa yi// sems 417) /kyis las rung mchog du 'gyur// ces so// gnyis pa ngo bo la gsum ste/ mtshan nyid/ sgra don/ dbye' ba'o// dang po ni/ 'jig rten pa'i bhai byung rnam par mi rtog pa'i shes rab mthong lam gyis nyir len du 'gyur ba'o// gnyis pa ni/ chos nyid kyis bden pa mngon sum du rtogs pa mthong lam la sbyor bas sbyor lam/ lhag par mos pas mos pa bskyed pa'i sa/ mthong spang rnam par 'byed pa mthong lam gyis rgyur gyur pas/ nges 'byed yan lag dang*/ nges 'byed cha mthun zhes bya'o// bye brag du mthong lam rnam par mi rtog ba'i ye shes kyis che ba'i snga ltas yin pas drod/ dge ba'i rtsa ba g.yo' ba rnams kyis rtse mi yin pas rtse mo yin pas rtse mo/ chos zab mi la mi sgrag pas bzod pa/ 'jig rten pa'i chos kyi mchog yin pas nyid do// gsum pa dbye' ba la gsum ste/ dbye' ba'i khyad par dang rtogs 418) pa'i khyad par ro// dang po ni/ nges 'byed yan lag bzhir byas te/ spang rtogs thog mar bskyes pas drod/ skyes ba 'phel nas rtse mo// 'phel ba brten pas bzod pa/ brten pa mthar phyin pas chos chog go /de dag gis dmigs yul bden bzhi sgyu ma lta bu/ ngo bo rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ sgro 'dogs chod pa'i shes rab ste/ gzhig nas dang lhag mthong zung du 'jug go/ de yang drod rtse gnyis la dbang po lnga dang*/ bzod pa chos mchog gnyis la stobs lnga ste/ de ci ltar ldan tshul gong du brjod zin to// cha mthun bzhi po re re la yang che 'bring chung gsum yod de/ mdo' sde rgyan las/ de ltar nges 'byed cha mthun ni/ chung dang 'bring dang chen po yin// ces so// gnyis pa rtogs pa'i khyad par la gnyis las/

mnyam rjes dang*/ blo rig kyis khyad par ro// dang po cha mthun mthun gzhi'i mnyam rjes la khyad par 419) /yod dam med na/ mnyam gzhag chos thams cad kyis rnam pa tsam rtogs pa dang*/ rjes thob dmigs yul tsam la khyad par med la/ chos can ngo bo dang 'brel pa'i chos thams cad rgya che chung rtogs pa'i khyad par yod pas mi 'gal lo// gnyis pa ni| cha mthun gzhi'i mnyam gzhag ngo blo rig gang du 'du zhes na/ rnam 'byor dngos su rjes mthun pa dang*/ bcad shes log par 'dod pa yod de/ de dag mi thad pa'i tshul ni/ mkhas pa dag gis dgag yang zin pas/ 'dir brgal len ma smos so// de ltar tshogs sbyor gnyis po 'di rtogs pa dang bcas pas 'jig rten pa'i lam rnam par byang ba dang bral bas so sor skye'o sa/ kun nas nyos mongs ba'i chos rnams dang ldan pas byis pa'i sa zhes byas te/ lam rjes mthun pa dang mos pa spyod pa'i sa btags pa yin te/ mdo' sde rgyan las/ byes da so so skye 420) bo rnams la lam yang med la/ sa yang med/ lam bhai pa yang med na 'bras bu rnam par 'god pa lta ga la yod/ ces so// gsum ba 'bras bu ni/ 'chad par 'gyur ba'i mthong lam nyid do// gsum pa dang bzhi pa mthong bhai gyis lam la gnyis las/ spang bya sgrib pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ gnyen po lam gyis rang bzhin no// dang po la yang gnyis te/ spang bya'i rang bzhin dang*/ ci ltar spang bya ba'i tshul lo// dang po la yang mthong spang gnyis las/ mthong spang la yang shes bya'i sgrib nishugs las shes par bya la/ 'dir mthong spang nyon sgrib la gsum ste/ rgyu| ngo bo/ 'bras bu'o// dang po la bzhi ste/ rgyu'i rkyen nyan thos sngar bhai spangs snga mas bzhag ba'i bag chags bdag rkyen tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i rnam rtog dmigs rkyen gnyis su snang bas/ de ma thag rkyen rig pa snga ma snga ste/ mdzod las phra rgyas spang pa myur bsam 421) /gtan// yul ni nye bar gyur pa dang*// tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed las// nyon mongs rnams ni skye bar gyur| |ces pas/

bag chags 'jog byed ni/ snga mthug med yin te/ mdzod las/ rnam shes snga mas bzhag pa'i nus pa bag chags bzhag par 'dod/ ces so// gnyis pa ngo bo la gsum ste/ mthong byed nye rgyud kyis mtshan nyid/ sgra don/ dbye' ba'o// dang po ni/ nye rgyud gang zhig mthong lam gyis gzhoms byar gyur ba'o// gnyis pa ni/ chos nyid mngon sum du gsar du mthong bas spangs ba ste/ mthong spang yin te/ mdzod las/ ci ltar myug sogs rim skyes nas/ sa bon shug pa bcod da ltar/ de bzhin de nyid mthong ba yi/ mthong spang rnams ni ldog par 'gyur// ces so// gsum pa dbye' ba la gnyis las/ nyan thos ltar na/ 'dod khams la bden pa bzhi la/ sdug bsngal 422) gyis bcu/ kun 'byung 'gog pa gnyis/ 'jig tshogs mthar 'dzin tshul khrims rtul zhugs mchogs 'dzin gsum ma gtogs bdun bdun/ lam bden pa lta ba tshogs gnyis/ martogs pas brgyad dam/ tshogs gnyis su 'gyur te/ mdzod las/ de dang bcu' dang bdun bdun brgyad| |lta ba gsum gnyis ma rtogs so// ces so// khams gong ma gnyis la khong med pas/ de dag dgu dang drug bdun du 'gyur bas nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa gnyis te/ bsdom na nyi shu rtsa brgyad do// gnyis pa theg chen pa ltar na/ lus kyi dbye' ba/ lta ba pa/ lta med pa lta bcu'o// dang po phung po lnga la gang zag gis bdag du 'dzin pa/ 'jig tshogs lta ba phung po lnga la/ rtag pa'am chad pa'i mtha' gcig tu zhen pa/ mthar phyin gyis lta ba/ kun rdzob don dam dang mthun par 'dzin pa log par lta ba/ lta ba ngan pa la bzod par 'dzin pa lta ba 423) /la phyogs 'dzin*/ lta ngan dang 'brel ba'i spyod pa ngan pa la spyod pa bzod par 'dzin pa tshul khrims dang rtul zhugs mchog 'dzin te/ lta ba lnga dang yang dag pa ma yin pa'i yul la mngon par dga' ba'i 'dod chags 'ga' zhig pa kun nas mnar sems pa'i zhe sdang*/ blo gang zag gis kun rdzob gnas lugs ma shes pas ma rig pas/

bdag lta la brten pas khengs pas nga rgyal/ kun rdzob bden pa la som nyi za bas the tshom dang*/ lta min lnga ste/ de ltar bcu'o// 'dod kams la bden pa bzhi dge bcu' ste bzhi bcu| khams gong ma gnyis la khong 'khro med pas so drug bcu gnyis te/ yan lag gis dbye' ba brgyad dang bcu gnyis/ khong 'khro med pa ci'i phyir zhes na/ rgyu gzhi gnas dang ldan pa'i phyir dang*/ 'dis bdag la gnod pa byas/ da lta byas/ phyis byed par 'gyur 424) ba gsum dang*/ bdag gis gnyen rnams la gnod pa byas sogs su dang*/ bdag gis dgra rnams la phan gtags so// 'dogs so// 'dod chags par gyur gsungs te/ mnar sems pa'i dngos po dgu med pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa bras bu ni/ mthong spang nyan thos kyis sa bon las/ ma rig pa mngon 'gyur skye ba/ zag bcas rten 'brel lugs 'byung bar ma chad par/ mthar rga shi dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs 'byung ste/ bsdug pa las/ sems can tha ma 'bring dang mchog 'gyur ci snyed pa// de kun ma ya=rig las byung ḍade bar gshegs pas gsungs// ces so// gnyis pa bhai spang sgrib pa la gsum ste/ rgyu/ ngo bo/ 'bras bu'o// rgyu ni mthong spang dang mthun no// ngo bo la gsum ste/ bhai spag nyon sgrib kyis mtshan nyid/ sgra don/ dbaye' ba'o// dang po ni/ nyon mangs gang zhig bhai lam gyis gzhom byar gyur/ 425) /ba'o// gnyis pa ni/ chos nyid mthong ba tsam gyis spang mi nus pas mngon sum gyis mthong zin goms pas spang bas na/ bhai spang ngo// de nas bden pa mthong bas spang pa mthong spong yin pas/ 'di la bden pa'i sgo nas dbye' ba ma byed pa yin no// gsum pa la 'am drug ste/ 'dod chags/ zhe sdang*/ nga rgyal/ ma rig pa/ 'jig tshogs lta ba/ mthar 'dzin lta ba'o// gnyis pa khams kyis sgo nas dbye' na bcu drug ste/ 'dod khams na drug khams gong ma gnyis la zhe sdang med pas bzhi ste// gsum pa sa tsam dbye' na/

'dod khams kyis sa dang*/ gzugs khams bsam gtan sa bzhi dang*/ gzugs med pa bzhi ste/ khams gsum pa dgu na/ 'dod chags dang*/ nga rgyal ma rig pa/ 'jig tshogs lta ba/ mthar 'dzin lta ba rnams re re la dgu' yod bas/ dgu' 426) po re re la'ang chen po la sogs dgu yod pas/ lnga po re re zhing dgu dgu brgyad cu rtsa gcig pa lnga'o// 'dod khams kyis zhe sdang dgu ste| bzhi brgya dang bcu bzhi'o// gsum pa bhai spang 'bras bu ni/ rigs 'dra phyi ma las/ rigs mi 'dra ba sa dang lam gyis gegs byed pa dang skye ba len pa'o/ gnyis pa gnyen po sbang tshul ni/ yul chos dbyings spros bral mngon su du rtogs pa/ yul can mthong lam rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes mngon sum du 'gyur ba na/ spang bya'i sgrib pa cir yang mi dmigs pas/ spang bya min pa spang rgyu med de/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba cir zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag lta// yang dag mthong ma rnam par grol// ces pas/ klu sgrub kyis/ 'khor ba sbang bar gyur ba yi// myang 'das khyod kyis mi bzhed kyis// 'khor ba mi dmigs pa 427) /yis ni// zho nyid mgon po khyod ni bstan// ces gsungs pa dang*/ ye shes skye ba'i tshe/ mthong bhai gnyis spang bya spang tshul gnad gcig yin la/ bye brag bhai lam dgu'i chung sogs skyes pa'i tshe/ bhai spang chen po'i chen po sogs ldog pa yin te/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sa dgu la ni chen po yi// chen po la sogs dri ma yin// gnyen po chung du la// sogs pa'i lam ni dag pa yin// ces so// 'o na nyen po che rin nas skye bar rigs te/ spang bya che rim nas spang pa'i phyir ro// zhes na spang bu rags pa che bar brjod pa yin gyis/ spang dka' bar brjod pa yin no// dper na gos kyis dri ma 'khru ba bzhin no// gnyis pa lam la gnyis te/ mthong lam dang*/ bhai lam gnyis so// dang po mthong lam la gsum ste/

rgyu/ ngo bo/ 'bras bu'o// dang po ni nges 'byed yan lag bzhi 428) yin cing dngos rgyu chos mchog chen po'i ye shes yin te/ mdo' sde rgyan las/ de nas de ni 'jug rten las// 'das pa'i ye shes bla med pa| |rnam par mi rtog dri ma med// 'dzin pa gnyis dang bral bas thob// ces so// gnyis pa ngo bo la gsum ste/ byang sems mthong lam gyis mtshan nyod dang*// sgra don/ dbye' ba'o// dang po ni/ chos nyid mngon sum gsar du mthong ba'i ye shes rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyis go skabs dbye' bar gyur ba'o// de dag rim pa ltar/ 'jig rten pa'i lam ba dang*/ bhai pa dang*/ thaig pa dang po'i ldog pa gsal nas/ mthong lam du mtshon pa yin no// gnyis pa sgra don ni/ chos nyid mngon sum du mthong zhing sangs rgyas kyis lam gyi thog ma yin pas mthong lam/ sa bcu'i thog ma yin pas sa dang po/ don dam sems bskyed kyis don yin pas sems dang po bskyed pa zhes kyang bya'o// gsum pa dbye' 429) /ba la gsum ste/ gang zag gang la skye/ skad cig du la spyad la/ gnas lugs kyis 'thad pa bsam pa'o// gling gsum gyis skyes pa bud med dang*/ 'dod khams kyis mi dang*/ lha rigs drug kho na skye ste/ skyo shas che zhing shes rab gsal ba'i phyir ro| |ngan song gsum la mi skye ste/ rnam par smin pa'i las kyi sgrib pa chen pos sgrib pa'o// gzugs khams dang gzugs med pa'i lhal mi skye ste/ sdug bsngal gyis tshogs med pa snyoms par 'jug pa la srid pas skyo shas chung ba'i phyir ro// sgra mi snyan pa la yang mi skye ste/ skyo ba med pas khams gong ma dang mtshungs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/ chos mchog chen po'i rjes si chos nyid bden pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes bya rdzogs kyis skad cig ma gcig la skye zhing*/ de yang byang chub sems dpa' mthong lam chen po rdzas skad cig gcig la

430)skye ba yin te/ chos nyis gsar du rtogs pa dang las med pa'i phyir dang*/ mthong spang gcig char spang pa'i phyir ro// bsdud pa las/ gang gis de ltar mthong ba de'i chos kun mthong*/ ces dang*/ rig pa drug cu ba las/ chos shes pa'i 'og du ni/ 'di la rnam par dbye yod na// rnam par mi mkhas de yis ni// rkyen las byung ba'i don ma mthong*/ ces pa dang*/ mthong ba 'di la sbyar ma thag du ni// 'jig tshogs lta dang tshul khrims brtul zhugs dang*// thos bsam dang ni nyon mongs gsum po dag /gcig char spang ste 'phags ba'i bde na mthong ba// ces dang*/ 'grel chen las/ bden pa rnams kyis bden par rtogs pa ni gcig yin pa'i phyir ro// de bas nas dang po'i skad cig ma dang po'i skad cig ma dang po mthong ba'i lam yin no// gsum pa 'thad pa bsam pa ni/ dbu' ma pa'i lugs don dam par mthong ba'i lam skye bar 431) mi 'thad de/ mdo' las/ byang chub sems dpa' mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa'o// ces gsungs ba'i phyir dang*/ 'phags pa rnams chos thams cad 'dus ma byas kyis rab tu phye bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gal te de ltar na mdo' bstan bcos rnams las/ skad cig gcig dang bcu drug la sogs par skye bar bshad pa dang mi 'gal lam zhes na/ mi 'gal te/ dngos por smra ba rnams rjes su bzung ba'i phyir/ dgongs pa can yin te/ dgongs gzhi ni rten cing 'brel ba 'byung ba yin la/ dgongs pa ni dngos por la mngon par zhen pa rnams bzhugs pa'i don du yin zhing dngos po la gnod byed ni/ bdag dang gzhan dang gnyis dang rgyu med pa las mi skye ba'i phyir te/ rtsa shes las/ bdag las ma yin gzhan las min// gnyis las ma yin rgyu med yin// dngos po gang dang gang la yang*// 432) skye ba nam yang yod ma yin// ces so// 'o na rten nas skye ba ma yin nam/ zhes na/ ma yin te/ rgya la pos zhus pa'i mdo' las|

gang zhig rkyen las skye ba de ma skyes// de la skye ba'i rang bzhin yod ma yin// rkyen las rag las gang de stong ba nyid// ces dang*/ rtsa shes las/ gang gis rten cing 'brel ba 'byung*/ 'gags pa med pa skye med pa// ces gsung pa'i phyir ro// mthong lam byang chub lam gyis yan lag bdun ni brjod zin to// gsung pa mthong lam mthob pa'irtags bsam 'das yon tan ni/ 'og du lam gyis skabs su ston par 'gyur ro// gsum pa bhai lam la gnyis te/ 'jug rten pa dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bhai lam mo// dang po la gsum nyer zlog dang*/ dngos gzhi'o// dang po ni sa gang ma'i bsam gtan 'grub pa rgyu gnyis te/ 'phen byed dang*/ rdzogs byed/ mig yi' ba'i/ 433) / las so// dang po ni yin la byed pa drug ste/ mtshan nyid rab du rigs pa/ mos pa las byung ba/ rab du dben pa/ dga' bas bsdud pa/ dpyod pa sbyor ba'i thabs yid la byed pa ste/ thar pa'i lam la dod sbyar na/ sbyor mtha'i 'bras bu yid la byed pa ni/ dga' gtan dngos gzhi'i sems yin pa ma rtogs so// dang po ni/ nyon mongs bas lus sems sdug bsngal rags| de'i stogs kyi tshe thung ba khams 'og ma'i mtshan nyid do// de las zlog pa khams gong ma'i mtshan nyid du thos bsam dgyis rig pa rtse gcig tu yid la byed pa ste/ thar pa'i lam dang dod sbyar na tshogs lam gyis dod do// nyis pa ni/ de ltar yid la byas pa las gong ma'i sa dang rjes mthun pa'i rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye ba ste/ sbyor lam gyis dod/ gsum ni de sbyangs pas 'doms 434) kyis nyon mongs pa che gsum gyes dbyin pa'i rtse gcig pa skye ba ste/ mthong lam gyis dod do// bzhi pa ni/ gong ma'i nyin mings pa 'bring gsum spangs pa'i lus sems shin tu sbyangs pa'i phyir/ bdag bde' thob pa'i teng nge 'dzin skye ba ste bhai lam sa drug pa'i dod do// lnga pa ni/

de ltar bhai ba las sa 'o ga ma'i nyon mongs pa spangs sam snyams na bde' skye mi skye dpyad pas/ chung gsum skye bar sher nas rtse gcig gnas pa ste| sa brgyas kyis dod do// drug pa ni chung gsum spong byed kyis ting nge 'dzin bhai pa ste/ bar chad med pa'i lam gyis dod do/ bsam gtan dang po yin la bye pa ci lta bar gnyis pa nas srid rtse'i bar hyis yid la byed pa drug gam bdun gyi 'grub par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa rdzogs byed ni/ yid la byed pa de dag la de'i yin tan dran pa'i gus pa dang*/ rtag du byed pa'i sbyor ba rgyun du bhai pa'o// de yang che 'bring gis gsum ste/ 435)gnyis ka dang mi ldan pa chung du/ gang rung gnyis dang ldan na 'bring po// gnyis ka dang ldan pa chen por bhai pa'o// bsam gtan gong ma ldan ma rnams kyis nyer zlog la yang che yang che 'bring bhai chul de bzhin no// gnyis dngos gzhi la gsum ste/ skyon yin gyis bsam gtan dang*/ 'bras bu skye ba'i tshul dang*/ de dag gis byed las so// dang pi ka yang gnyis las/ bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyis ting nge 'dzin la brtan nas/ sred pa/ lta ba/ nga rgyal/ ma rig pa/ the tshom shes che ba'i bsam gtan te| rim pa ltar bsam gyis bde' ba'i myong bar byed pa dang*/ sngon gyis mthu' la rtogs pa la sogs pa'i drug cu rtsa gnyis kun slong ba dang*/ khyad par thob nas sems kheng pa dang*/ de kho ma rtogs pa thar pa 'dod pa bsam gtan thob pa thir pa yin nam ma yin the 436) tshom za ba ste/ de'i phyir nyon mongs pa'i bsam gtan zhes bya ste/ de dag go sa de dang der skye ba'i mtshan nyid la sogs par gyur ro// gnyis pa yon tanacan la bsam gtan dang gzugs med gnyis las/ dang po bsam gtan yan lag bco brgyad las/ bsam gtan dang po yan lag ldan te/ 'dod pas sdig pa dang*/ yin mi bde ba thag sring bas rtogs spyod gnyis gnyin po'i yan lag

dge' bde' gnyis lus dang sems la phan 'dogs pas phan yon gyis yan lag/ ting nge 'dzin la rtogs spyod gnyis gnyes po 'jug cing dga' bde' yi phan yon 'byung bas tshe gcig pa gnas kyis yan lag go/ bsam gtan dang po la dngos kyis rtsam po dang*/ khyad par can gnyis las| dang po rtog pa dang bcas/ spyod pa dang bcas/ ces pa dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ rtog pa med la spyod pa tsam gyis ting nge 'dzin 437) /no// ces so// gnyis pa yan lag bzhi ldan te/ nad rab tu dang ba rtog dpyod thag sring bar byed pa gnyen po/ dga' bde' phan yon rtse gcig pa gnas kyi yan lag go/ gsum pa lnga ldan te/ dran shes shing btang snyoms gsum dga' ba thag sring bas gnyen po'o/ /bde ba phan yon no/ rtseg gcig pa gnas kyis yan lag go bzhi pa bzhi ldan te/ btang snyoms gsum dran pa gnyis bde 'a bya thag sring ba'i gnyen po/ bde sdug gnyis ka ma yin pa yon tan te/ btang snyoms rdzas gcig la bsring ba'i cha gnyen po/ mi gnod pa'i cha nas phan yon no// rtse gcig pa gnas kyi yan lag sngar bzhin no/ gnyis pa gzungs med skye mched mu bzhi ni/ gzhi rag tu dmigs pas 'da' ba yin gyis/ yang dag mi 'dra bas/ 'da' ba ma yin gyis/ thams cad kyang yan lag rtse gcig pa dang 438) btang snyoms su mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ dmigs pa'i khyad par ni/ sbyor ba'i dus na gzugs kyi dmigs pa las 'das nas/ nam mkha' mtha' yas zhes bya ba/ gzung ba'i dmigs pa las 'das nas nam mkha' la dmigs pa'i rnam par shes mtha' yas so zhes bya ba/ 'jig rten pa'i dmigs pa las 'das nas nam mkha' la dmigs pa'i rnam par shes pa ni/ rags pa med cing phra ba med pa yang ma yin mnyam pa'i mos pa sngon du btang nas/ dngos gzhi'i dus su dge ba rtse gcig du gnas pa'o/ gnyis pa 'bras bu skye ba'i tshun ni/ bsam gtan dang po la che 'bring chung gsum du bhai pas/ tshangs ris la sogs gsum du skye la/

de bzhin du gnyis pa la gsum du bhai pas 'od chung la sogs pa gsum dang*/ bzhi sum du bhai pas sprin med 'od la sogs pa gsum dang*/ de yang bsam gtan bzhi pa'i sems 439) /la bsten nas zag med bden pa'i rnam pa can/ zhes pa mnyam gzhag gnyis kyi bar du zag bcas zhidrag kyi rnam pa can zhes pas rjes thob gcig spel ba ste/ zag bcas zag med gsum du 'phel bas/ mi che ba dang*/ drug dang*/ dgu' dang*| bcu gnyis dang*/ bco lnga spel bas rim da bzhin du/ mi gdung ba dang*/ shon tu mthong dang*/ 'go min du skye'o// zugs med la yang gzugs sun phyung bas gzhan med khang gis gnas gzhan med pas pa tha dad med/ 'on kyang che 'breng bhai pas tshe thung dang mthu' che chung du skye'o// nyon mongs pa'ang che 'gring gsum du 'gyur ro// de lta bu'i bsam gtan de dag 'jig rten pas chung zhing dman pas zag pa dang bcas yin la/ nyan rang gi zag med cing 'jig rten pa las rgya che zhing byang chub sems dpa' rnams nyon mongs pa 440) med pa'i rnam byang gis ting nge 'dzin la thabs mkhas pa gnas shing*/ bsam gtan gyis pha rol du phyin pa la dbang 'byor ba yin la/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul gyis 'jug par bshad do/ /gsum pa byed las ni/ bsam gtan bhai pas spang bya mgo' non pa dang*/ tshad med bzhi dang*/ mngon par shes pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dang lam gyis brten byed pa'i las can/ gnyis pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bhai pa la gsum ste/ gang zag la skye ba dang*/ sa gang la brten pa/ rang bzhin nges par bya ba'o// dang po ni/ theg pa chen po ltar na gling gsum gyis skyes pa dang*/ bud med dang*/ 'dod pa dang*/ gzugs dang*/ gzugs med pa'i bhai'o// ngan song dang*/ za ma dang*/ ma ning dang*/ sgra mi snyan dang*/ 'du shes med pa la mi skye ste/ las kyi sgrib chen po'i sgrib pa yin pa'i phyir ro 441)/gnyis pa ni/

nyan thos pa bsam gtan dngos gzhi dang*/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer zlog mi lcog pa med pa dang*/ khyad par can dang*/ gzugs med gsum ste dgu'o// gzhan la mi brten pa ni 'dod pa'i sems las su mi rung tshing srid rtse'i sems mi gsal ba'i phyir ro// theg pa chen po pa ni bsam gtan bzhi da shin tu dag pa la brten la/ 'on kyang ting nge 'dzin gyis rtsal sbyang pa na/ bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ gzugs med bzhi dang*/ 'gogs pa la snyoms par 'jug go/ gsum pa rang bzhin nges par bya ba la gsum ste/ mtshan nyid/ sgra don/ dbye' ba'o/ dang po ni/ rang bzhin med par mngon dum du mthong zin goms par byed ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyis go skabs 'byed pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ mthong lam gyis rtogs zhin bhai par byed pa bhai lam zhes bya'o// gsum pa 442) dbye' ba la bzhi ste/ dbye' gzhi ni/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bhai lam tsam yin la/ dbye' ba'i ngo bo ni/ bden bzhi chos thams cad la dmigs pa'i mnyam gzhag zag med dang*/ sgyu ma lta bu la dmigs pa'i rjes thob snang bcas kyis ye shes che 'bring gi dbye' ba dgu ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ de ni rgyu mchog yin pa'i phyir// chung dang 'bring dang chen po rnams// chung ngu'i chung sogs dbye' ba yi*// rnam pa rnam pa dgur bzhed do// ces so// gcig dag tha dad bsam pa ni/ dgu po dngos po tha dad yin te/ rigs can du skye ba'i phyir te/ bzhi pa grangs nges pa ni/ sa dgu la brten pa'i spang bya che 'bring chung dgur nges pas/ gnyen po yang rim pa dgur nges te// mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sa dgu la ni chen po yi// chem po la sogs drim yis/ gnyen po yang chung ngu'i du la// ོgas pa'i lam zhi dag pa yi// zhes gsungs pa'i 443) /phyir ro// de la bhai spang dang de'i gnyen do ci ltar spong ba'i tshul ni gong du brjod zin to// lnga pa mi slob pa'i lam la yang rnam par bzhag pa bshad mod kyis/

seng ges bzang pos 'grel chen las/ sa dang po'i skad cig ma dag po ni mthong ba'i lam yin no// de las gzhan skad cig ma gnyis pa la sogs pa nas/ rdo rje lta bur brjod pa bar chad med pa'i lam gong ma de ma thag du sangs rgyas kyis kun tu 'od thob pa'i bar 'di dag thams cad ni mcho gis don la sogs pa chos dbyings so sor rtogs pa'i phyir bhai pa'i lam yin par bshad do// ces pas/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis spang bya'i bag chags phra ba spong ba ni/ bhai lam mthar thug pa yin zhing*| spang bya dag pa rnams grol gyis lam du tha snyad byed pa ni/ sangs rgyas yin pa'i phyir ro// brgyad stong pa las/ sangs rgyas 444) bcom ldan 'das rnams ni lam chad pa 'jug pa chad pa spros pa dang srid par 'dren pa yongs su chad pa/ ces pas so// gnyis pas bcu' ni 'phags pa'i gang zag mthong bhai lam gyas bsdus pa byang chub sems dpa' bcu yin pas/ 'di la gsum ste/ thob pa'i rgyu dang*| rang bzhin dang*/ 'bras bu'o// dang pi la gnyis las/ ma thob pa thob pa'i rgyu la sa dang po'i rgyu ni mos pa spyod pa'i sa yin la/ sa bcu rnams kyis rgyu ni/ snga ma snga rnams yin no// gnyis pa thob pa rdzegs pa'i rgyu ni/ sa rang rang gis yongs sbyong thabs shes zung du 'brel ba yin zhing*/ bye brags bcu rdzogs pa'i rgyu ni/ sa 'og ma rnams kyis thabs shes cha pa rang ldan du 'dus pa nyid mthar phyin pa yin no// gnyis pa rang bzhin la gsum ste/ spyi'i ngo bo dang*/ yon tan dang*/ khyad par ro// dang po la gsum 445) ste/ mtshan nyid/ sgra don/ dbye' ba'o// dang po ni/ nam mkha' rang bzhin med par mngon sum du rtogs pa thabs dang zung 'jug rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyis lam gyis brten du gyur ba ni 'thad de/ lam ni bdag med pa shes rab kyis cha yin la/ sa ni zung 'jug gis cha yin pa mi srid pa yin no// rang lugs ni 'dag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab thabs khyad par can dang zung du 'jug pa byang sems 'phags pa'i yon tan byed pa can no// 'on theg pa yangs pa'i cha zer na/

ma nges te theg pa ni sems bskyed la sogs thabs kyi yin pa'i phyir te/ rin chen 'phreng ba las/ nyan thos theg pa de la ni// byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang*// sbyod pa bsngo' ba ma bsten te// thaig pa chen pi ga la 'gyur// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis las/ sa spyi'i sgra do ni/ sems 446) can dpag tu med pa 'khor ba'i phyir ro// yon tan dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa'i rab dga' la sogs de dag la gong nas gong du 'grod pa ldan pa'i phyir| sa zhes bya ste/ dper na sa gzhi bzhin no// mdo sde rgyan las 'byung po dpag med 'jig med 'jigaphyir// dpar du med pa de dag la// phyir phyir gong du 'grod phyir/ de dag nyid no sa 'dod do// ces so// gnyis pa so so'i sgra don ni/ bye brag nyan thos las khyad par 'phags pa'i dga' ba thob ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ gabung chubo yang nye ba dang*/ sems can don bsgrab mthong ba la// rab du dga' ba skyes gyur te// de phyir rab dga' zhes brjod do// ces so/ tshul khrims 'chal ba dang theg dman yin la byed pa'i dri ma med pas/ 'chal tshul 'chol pa'i dri bral phyir/ dri ma med pa'i sa zhes bya/ teng nge 'dzin ga=gyis stobs kyi rang gzhan la brjod bya/ rjod byed kyi 447) /don byed pas/ chos kyi snang ba chen po ni/ byed pa'i phyir na 'od byed pa'o// byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i bdag med kyis shes rab kyis sgrib gnyis bsreg par byed pas/ de nyid las/ 'di ltar byang chub phyogs mthun chos// rab tu gsal byed lta bu// de dang ltan phyir sa de bzhin// gnyis po bsreg pas 'od 'phro can// sems can rnams ni smin par byed pa'i tshe// gzhan gyis log bsgrub kyis rang gi sems nyin mongs par mi 'gyur ba de gnyis sbyangs dka' ba/ sems can rnams ni smin byed cing*| |rang gi sems kyang bsrungs ba'i phyir/

blo ldan gyis sbyangs dka' bas/ de phyir sbyangs dka' zhes brjod do/ 'khor 'das gnyis mngon du gyur cung*/ gang la yang mi gnas pas/ shes rab pha rol phyin brten nas/ 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ mngon 448) sum 'gyur bas sa zhes brjod/ mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i sa las ring du song zhing sangs rgyas kyis sa la 'grod pa gcig pa dang 'brel bas/ 'grod gcig lam dang 'brel ba'i phyir/ ring du song pa'i sar 'dod do// mtshan ma dang mtshan nyis pa las rtsol ba'i 'du shes med pas/ 'du shes gnyis kyis mi g.yo' phyir/ mi g.yo' ba zhes nges par brjod/ so so yang dag rig pa bzhi'i blo gros kyis chos ston pa la 'byor bas/ so so yang dag rig blo bzang*/ sa de legs ba'i blo gros yin/ dbyings ye shes dbyer med nam mkha'i lta bu la/ gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin gyis sgo gnyis las// thos pas car sprin lta bu khyab// sprin bzhin gnyis kyi nam mkha'i chos*/ khyab pa'i phyir na chos kyi sprin// ces gsungs so// de las bcur nges pa ni/ spangs bya nyon pa can ma yin pa'i ma rig pa bcu 449) /yod pas/de'i gnyen por sa bcu nges te/ dbus mthas las/ chos kyi dbyings la ma rig pa// nyon mongs can min sgrib pa bcu'// sa bcu mi mthun phyigs rnams kyis// gnyen po dag ni bstan pa yin// ces so/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa rnams kyis lam phar phyin bcu rdzogs par bya ba la ltos pas kyang sa bcur nges pa'o// gsum pa sa thob pa'i yon tan dang*/ bzhi sa'i khyad par rnams 'dir yi ge mang dogs pas ma smos so/ ༈ /spyi don lnga pa theg chen lam gyis nges par 'byung ba'i tshul gnyis te/ thabs kyis nges par 'byung tshul dang*/ dus kyis nges par 'byung tshul lo// dang po ni/ 'bras bu thams cad mkhyen pa de/ rgyu nor ba spyod pa las mi 'byung ste/ dper na 'o ma 'dod pa la rā la mthen pa bzhin no// rgyu ma tshang ba las

450) kyang thams cad mkhyen pa mi 'byung ste/ dper na sa bon la sogs med na 'bras bu mi 'byung ba zhin no// des na gong du bshad pa'i rang bzhin gyis rim dang*/ rgyas gyur gyis rigs gnyis la brten nas rgyu tshogs gnyis dang*/ lta ba bden pa gnyis dang*/ lam lnga sa bcu mthar phyin te/ 'bras bu sku gnyis la sogs thob pa yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ gter dang ljon pa'i shing bzhin du// rigs de rnam gnyis shes bya ste// thog med rang bzhin gnas pa la// yang dag blang ba mchog yin nam// ces dang*/ lam sgron las/ thabs dang bral ba'i shes rab kyis// ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur bas/ shes rab bral ba'i thabs dag gis// mkhas pa de zhir mi 'gyur// ces dang*/ mdo sde rgyan las/ chos kyi sku de mdor bsdus na// rgyal po ye shes tshogs las 'khrangs// gzugs kyi sku de mdor bsdus na// bsod nams tshogs las yang dag 451)/'khrungs// ces dang*/ shes pas srid la mi gnas shing*// snying rjes zhil mi gnas pa// ces dang*/ don gnyis ldan pa'i sangs rgyas ni// ces gsungs so// gnyis pa dus kyi ges par 'byung tshul ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ dka' spyad dpag med brgya phrag dang*// dpag med dge dge ba bsags pa dang*// dpag tu med pa'i dus dang ni// dpag med sgrub pa zad pa'i phyir// sgrib pa kun gyi dri med pa// rnam pa thams ced mkhyen nyid thob// rin chen snod ni phye ba ltar// sangs rgyas nyid ni sangs rgyas bstan// ces gsungs pas/ byang chub sems dpa' bya ba dka' ba dpag tu med pa spad pa dang*// tshogs nis dpag du med pa bsags pa dang*/ sgrib gnyis ma lus pa zad pas na/ thams cad mkhyen nyid thob pa de la dus dpag tu med pa dgos te/ dbang po rno zhing brtson 'grus myur bskal pa grangs med gsum gyis rdzogs bshad de/ mos spyod kyis sa la grangs med 452) gcig ma dag sa bdun ka gcig

dag pa sa gsum la grangs ned gcig di go /de yang le lo dang ni dge bas bar mchod na/ de ltar ma yin gyis/ gzhan du na grangs med gsum gyis rdzogs pa'i nges pa med de/ spyod 'jug las/ de ltar ltang ba stobs ldan dang*// byang chub sems stobs ldan pa gnyis// 'khor med ba res kyi 'dren byed na// sa thob la yun ring thogs// ces so// grangs med ni/ 'grangs du med pa'i grangs med ni ma yin te/ grangs kyi gnas gzhan drug cu gcig pa'i ming yin te/ mdzod 'grel las/ gcig bcu brgya stong kri 'bum dang*// byi bas ya dur phyir dgu'// gnas gzhan rkyang pa dgu' zhes bya// ther 'bu phrag phrig rab bkram dang*// gtams 'phrigs mi 'phrugs khyar phyin dang*/ spra sding*/ ded 'dren/ mtha' snang dang*/ rgyu rigs/ 'do 'dzes/ dbang po dang*/ legs phyin/ rtags 'gro/ byi rdul dang*/ rgya stag stogs 'khor/ bde' shes dang*/ rnam 'byung*/ 453) /stobs/ migs grangs med de/ thog ma ma rtogs chen por sbyar/ brgyad ni bar las ma snyed do/ de ltar gnas gzhan drug cu'o// brgyad mtshang pa ni/ bsod nams stobs rin po che'i mdo' las/ don nathun ming ni tshad med pa bzhi la gnyis gnyis su byas pas kha bskang du rung ngo| |ces gsungs pa yang 'dug go /bdun pa 'bras bu ni/ spyi chings las/ sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa ni// mthar phyin pa yi 'bras bu bzhed// ces gsungs pas/ de ltar spang rtogs mthar phyin pa'i sangs rgyas la/ nyonan mongs pa dang sdug bsngal dang*/ mtshan ma la sogs pa'i 'ching ba tha dag dang bral te| bdag dang bdag gis stong pas/ yod pa'i mtha' las grol/ gsal 'grib med par thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur bas med pa'i mtha' las grol/ ces dang*/ rgyud bla ma las/ 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub// gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs med pas// mkhyen dang brtse dang nus pa/ 454) ldan| |don gnyis ldan pa'i sangs rgyas nyid// ces pas 'bras bu sku gsum dang*// mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje dang*/

mdzad pa'i 'phrin las so// snga ma ni/ tshogs brgyad sku gsum du gnas gyur pa yin te/ gser 'od dam pa las/ 'jugapa'i rnam par shes pa gnas gyur pas sprul pa'i mngon du 'gyur ro// kun gzhi la gnas pa'i yid sbyangs pas longs spyod par rdzogs pa'i sku ston no// kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa sbyangs bas chos kyi sku thob bo// de ltar na/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa zhes bya'o// sprul pa'i sku ni sangs rgyas thams cad dang spyod pa mthun no// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni sangs rgyas thams cad dang dgongs pa mthun no// chos kyi sku ni sangs rgyas thams cad dang sku mthun no// ces so// de ltar sku gsum dbyer med pas gdul bya rnams la gang 'dul gyis don mdzad/ bsdud pa las/ sum cu rtsa gsum 455) /mtshan dang mthun stobs pha mtha' yas// sems can rnams la chos rab ston pa sgrog par byed// ces sogs gsungs/ gnyis pa ye shes ni/ yum las yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgya ni/ chos thams cad la sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes brten pa'o// ces dang*/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sangs rgyas rnams ni mngon sum spyin// kun du thog med gzings par 'jug /ces so// de yang chos can ci snyed pa'i mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang*/ chos nyid ci lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang*/ dbyer med mkhyen pa'i ye shes so// dang po ni/ yum rgyas pa las/ rnam pa thams cad du ma mthong pa'am ma thos pa'am/ ma shes pa'am/ khong du ma chugs pa gang yang med do// ces pa dang*/ yum bar ma las/ de bzhin gshegs pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ phyogs bcu 'jig rten gyis khams kyis sems can de dag gos sems bsdus pa dang spros 456) pa ni/ chos nyid kyis yan lag ci lta ba bzhin du rab tu mkhyen to// sems can de dag gos sems 'dod cags dang bcas pa la/ 'dod chags dang bcas pa zhes bya bar yang dag par ci lta ba bzhin rab tu mkhyen to/

de bzhin du 'dod chags dang bral ba dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug go/ sems yang ba dang*/ dge ba dang*/ bstan du yod da dang*/ bstan du med pa dang*/ 'khro ba dang*/ 'du ba dang*/ bkrams pa dang*/ btsum pa la sogs pa yang dag par cu lta ba bzhin du rab tu mkhyen to// ces pa dang*/ yang 'das pa'i chos la ma chags ma mthong ba'i ye shes gzigs pa 'jug go// ma 'ongs pa'i chos la 'jug do/ da lta'i chos la 'jug go// ces so/ gnyis pa ci lta ba mkhyen pa ni/ yum bar ma las/ gang zag pha rol gyid de la 'gro ba dang*/ skye ba dang*/ 'gags pa dang*/ gnas pa dang*/ gnas pa la gzhan du 'gyur ba mi gzigs so// ma nir ba de bzhin nyid dang*/ 'gyur ba med pa dang*/ mtshan ma 457) /med pa/ byed pa med pa/ spros pa med pa/ dmigs pa med pa/ yang dag pa ci lta ba bzhin rab tu mkhyen to// ces so// gsum pa ci snyed mkhyen pa ni/ ci snyed pa nyid co lta bar mkhyen pa yin te/ bsdud pa las/ ye shes 'chi med dam pa de la gzhan med thabs bcas dang*// 'di ni nam mkha'i kams dang mtshungs te tha dad med// ces dang*/ yum bar ma las/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i ye shes la mkhas pa dang*/ ces so// gsum pa brtse ba'i thugs rje ni/ sangs rgyas nas sems can thams cad la thugs rjes ma bzung ba gcig kyang med cing*/ 'khor ba ma stong gis bar du thugs rje chen pos skyob pa yin te/ gser 'od dam pa las/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni spyod lam rnam bzhir ye shes kyis ma bzung ba med do// chos thams cad la thugs rje ma gzigs pa med do// sems can thams cad la phan pa dang*/ bde bas ma 458) bzung ba med do// ces pa dang*/ yum bar las/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis thugs rjes chen pos/ sems can mtha' yas pa yongs su smin par byas pa la/ gzigs pa rtogs par 'byung ba ste/ de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rjes 'byung ba zhes bya'o// zhes gsungs so// bzhi pa 'phrin las kyis don mdzad pa ye shes kyis mdzad pa yin zhin ye shes kyis mdzas pa yin zhing*/

de yang 'bad rtsol med pa dang*/ rgyun mi chad par don mdzad pa'o// ye shes kyis mdzad pa ni/ yum las/ sku'i 'phrin las thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing*/ ye shes rjes su 'brang ngo*// gsum gis phrin las thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing*/ ye shes rjes su 'brang ngo// thugs kyi 'phrin las thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing*// 'bad rtsol med par dom mdzad pa dang*/ rgyun mi chad par don mdzad pa ni khog dbub kyis skabs nas brjod zin to// gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyis yon tan gyis bye 459)/brag mdo' rgyud du ma nas bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs kyang*/ 'dir bsdus te brjod pa ni/ mdo' sde rgyan las/ nyon mongs med dang smom mkhyen dang*// mngon shes so so yang dag rig /rnam pa thams cad dag bzhi dang*// dbang bcu dag ni stobs bcu dang*// mi 'jigs pa ni bzhi dag dang*// bsrung pa med pa rnam gsum dang*// dran pa nyer bzhan rnam gsum dang*/ snyel ba mi mnga'i chos dang ni// bag chags yang dag bcom pa dang*// skye ba thugs rje chen po dang*// thub pa kho na'i ma 'dres chos// bco brgyad bshad pa gang yin dang*// rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid dang*// ces sogs gsungs so// de rnams kyis dbu ma'i don bzhad zin to// theg pa thams cad kyis shan 'byed nyi 'od rab gsal las/ dbu ma'i theg pa'i rnam par bzhag pa'i le'u ste/ dgu pa'o/// /
